izzyondroid:org.meowcat.edxposed.manager.name: EdXposed Manager
izzyondroid:org.meowcat.edxposed.manager.description:
EdXposed is a framework for modules that can change the behavior of the system and apps without touching any APKs, and supports Android 8 to 11. That’s great because it means that modules can work for different versions and even ROMs without any changes (as long as the original code was not changed too much). It’s also easy to undo. As all changes are done in the memory, you just need to deactivate the module and reboot to get your original system back.
 There are many other advantages, but here is just one more: Multiple modules can do changes to the same part of the system or app. With modified APKs, you to decide for one. No way to combine them, unless the author builds multiple APKs with different combinations.
 EdXposed Manager is the GUI allowing you to manage your EdXposed settings, modules, etc.
 Note: the app's repo is no longer maintained, so there won't be further updates here.

fdroid:com.example.poleidoscope.name: Poleidoscope
fdroid:com.example.poleidoscope.summary: A kaleidoscope based on complex polynomials. Trippy.
fdroid:com.example.poleidoscope.description:
Did you ever wonder what the world looks like through a 
holomorphic function? 
No? Wondering what a 'holomorphic function' is in the first place? 
Don't worry! You don't need to know any of this to use the app. 
Just touch the screen and see the math at work! 
The Poleidoscope shows a rectangular domain of the plane of complex numbers. 
The user sets up roots and poles of a rational function on the screen 
and this function is then used to deflect the live camera picture. 
Holomorphic functions are examples of so-called 'conformal mappings' which 
are prominently featured in the works of contemporary artists such 
as M.C. Escher. The Poleidoscope provides a live experience of similar 
pictures. 
For those more involved in mathematics the app is a way to visualize 
complex polynomials and rational functions and give a feeling for 
several topics in complex analysis such as differentials of holomorphic 
functions, Rouche's theorem, ramifications, local normal forms, etc.

Todosian reads and writes your existing .md files directly. There is no database import, no account, and no built-in sync.

- Connect a folder using Android's Storage Access Framework (SAF)
- Each Markdown file becomes a category
- Todos use standard Markdown checkboxes: - [ ] and - [x]

- Add / edit / toggle / delete todos
- Create / rename / delete categories (files)

- Offline-first and privacy-focused (no analytics)
 Notes 
- Todosian modifies your Markdown files directly. Keep a reliable backup of your vault/folder.
- Todosian is independent and not affiliated with Obsidian or the Obsidian Tasks plugin.

fdroid:io.github.ebraminio.bouncy.name: Bouncy
fdroid:io.github.ebraminio.bouncy.summary: A tiny bouncing ball that plays musical notes when it hits the walls.
fdroid:io.github.ebraminio.bouncy.description:
Bouncy is a simple, joyful little app: fling a ball across your screen, and
watch it bounce off the walls — playing a cheerful musical note each time it
hits.
Every bounce produces a tone from the diatonic scale, so the ball essentially
plays a little tune as it moves around. A visual effect (powered by Android's
AGSL shader language) that changes by each wall hit.
That's the whole app. No levels, no score, no accounts — just a ball, some
physics, and a bit of music.
Features:
* Fling the ball with a swipe and watch it go
* Each wall bounce plays a note from the diatonic musical scale
* Smooth, realistic physics using Android's FlingAnimation
* Visual glow effect rendered with AGSL distance field shaders
* Extremely lightweight: the entire app is under 18 KB
* No internet connection, no ads, no tracking, no permissions

Tap letters on the keyboard to enter a guess. Use the Back key to backspace. When you have finished a guess, tap the Enter key.
Letters which are in the word but in the wrong place will turn yellow. If they are in the right place they will turn green. If they are not in the word they will turn grey. Keep trying until you have guessed the word. The display will scroll up if you run out of guesses.

flathub:net.sourceforge.chromium-bsu.name: Chromium B.S.U.
flathub:net.sourceforge.chromium-bsu.summary: Fast paced, arcade-style, top-scrolling space shooter
flathub:net.sourceforge.chromium-bsu.description:
You are captain of the cargo ship Chromium B.S.U., responsible for delivering supplies to our
 troops on the front line. Your ship has a small fleet of robotic fighters which you control from
 the relative safety of the Chromium vessel. This is an OpenGL-based shoot 'em up game with fine
 graphics.
 Your mission:
 Do not let ANY enemy ships get past your fighters! Each enemy ship that makes it past the
 bottom of the screen will attack the Chromium, and you lose a fighter.
 Use your fighters as weapons! Crash into enemies to destroy them before they can get past
 you.
 Strategic suicide is a powerful tactic! When the Chromium launches a new fighter, it releases
 a high energy burst which destroys all enemies in range.
 Self-destruct to preserve your ammunition! A double-right-click will cause your current fighter
 to self-destruct. Before the ship blows up, it ejects its ammunition so that the next fighter
 can pick it up.

firefox-addons:2647934.name: Private Notes
firefox-addons:2647934.summary:
Private Notes gives you safe, fully encrypted place for your Top Secret notes! 
Ideal for storing recovery codes, WiFi passwords, access tokens, server configs...
firefox-addons:2647934.description:
Private Notes allows you to write password-protected, fully encrypted notes.
Your notes can be synchronized with encrypted (again!) Firefox Sync. engine with other devices.
 Ideal for storing the most sensitive information, like Recovery codes, Wi-Fi passwords, server configs, etc... 
 Privacy and permissions: 
 There are no permissions - this addon can't make any remote requests or submit any data!
 All data are always encrypted and then synchronized by Firefox build-in End-to-End encrypted "Firefox Sync" engine (yes, data are double encrypted!).
 Your password is NOT stored at all. It's hashed using advanced PBKDF2 function with 100k iterations and strong salt.
 Unlocked notes and decryption keys are never stored on drive - they stay in the system RAM memory (not accessible by any other app and cleared when browser is closed).
 Even if someone gains physical access to your PC, he won't be able to access your notes nor password. This is one of the safest place ever created! 
 Top features: 
 Encrypted notes - all your notes are always stored encrypted!
 Auto-lock - will help you keep your notes locked when you leave your PC
 Automatic backups - each device creates encrypted local backups of your notes. Plus Firefox Sync engine keeps encrypted backup in Firefox cloud.
 End to End encryption - all transferred data are again encrypted thanks to Firefox Sync between your Firefox browsers.
 No need to create additional account - Firefox Sync will handle everything
 Advanced Text Editor - supports many advanced text features
 Code highlight for many popular languages and configs
 Compression - all notes are compressed to save space
 To synchronize your encrypted notes between devices: 
 enable Firefox Sync feature - just login to your Firefox account using toolbar icon
 enable "Add-ons" synchronization - in the Firefox Options page ("about:preferences#sync") on the "Sync" tab check "Add-ons" checkbox
 Limitations of Firefox Sync engine: 
 No Android! Firefox Sync cannot synchronize addons data on Android :(
 Firefox Sync can handle only 100KB of data - so you can't store huge notes. However thanks to build in compression, you should be able to store more than 100,000 characters of text.
 Single note only 8KB size limit - each note can have only up to 8,000 characters - again thanks to compression this should be more.
 Slow synchronization - sometimes it takes several minutes to synchronize your new notes to / from the cloud. You can trigger sync. manually from your account toolbar menu.
 Support independent developer: 
 I'm full-time add-on developer and your donations is my only income. There are no ads in my add-ons!
 Please support my work by:
 Buy me a coffee 
 PayPal donation 
 Be my Patron 
 Thank you! :) 
 Your donation will help me keep this add-on working in future versions of Firefox!
 Recently added features: 
 The list of changes in last versions is available here

bluejetty:00021266:ios.name: Equestrian App
bluejetty:00021266:ios.summary: The Equestrian App manages day-to-day horse activities like stall management, boarding, leasing rules, training plans, veterinarian exams, farrier visits, invoicing, ride tracking, a marketplace, and so much more. We all want the best for
bluejetty:00021266:ios.description:
The Equestrian App manages day-to-day horse activities like stall management, boarding, leasing rules, training plans, veterinarian exams, farrier visits, invoicing, ride tracking, a marketplace, and so much more. We all want the best for our horses, so we built The Equestrian App to be that exclusive, one-of-a-kind tool you can rely upon everyday for your horses healthcare and well-being. Just think of it as Microsoft Office, but for your Horses.
It's about connecting people, horses and the community that cares for them.
People • Our goal is to connect everyone in the care and enjoyment of your horse within one easy to use app
Horses • The app logs your horse's activities and care, all while connecting them to your equine service providers
Community • The app connects the entire equine industry and lifestyle in one place
Features:
- Journals: A news feed of your horse's activities and health; connected to others that help in their care.
- My Horses: Manage everything about your horse's health, activities, and records. Think of this as your electronic, on-demand file cabinet that you wish you had with you at all times.
- Contacts: From riders and farriers, to vets and more, your horse can stay connected with them all.
- Get Connected: Follow friends or become an equine influencer. Ten's of thousands of equestrians around the world will help you get noticed.
- Expenses: Track all your expenses! Basically anything that you do for the horse and barn you can now track it.
- Photos: Capture and share important moments with your horse. It could be a great trail ride you discovered early that morning.
- Activities: Journal a list of activities for you and your horse. We have an extensive list of horse care topics that can be journaled.
- Ride Tracker: Track all your rides and capture the where you rode, the distance, time and speed for each horse.
- File Upload: Want to upload a health certificate or an important documents for your horse. Now you can scan and upload those important documents to each horse.
- Discounts: We have partnered with many Premium Equine Brands in providing unique discounts for Equestrian App members.
- Printing: You bet, now we have some great reports that you can print out of the system.
- Barn Chat: Message your equestrian friends important information right within the app.
- Equine Businesses: We now support many features to run your equine business and connect to your customers in-app for free (Trainers, Lessons, Farriers, Bodywork and Boarding).
- Horse Shows and Awards: Track your progress and results at all your horse shows. Now that wall or drawer of ribbons is easily searchable and available within the app.
- Business Profiles: Are you an equine business? You can build out your business profile and promote it in our search. It's a great way to get new business and be in front of the largest community of equestrians in the world.
- Weight Tracking: Simply capture and view a horses weight over time
- HorseTag: Use your phone to scan and quickly lookup horse information
- Vaccinations: One screen to enter and track your horses vaccinations
- TODOs: Track tasks and assign them to others in the barn.
- Horse Transfer: If you're selling or transferring a horse, you can do that in one tap to another member of the app.
- 4-H Horse Program: If you're in 4-H, we have your record books and horse certificates in the app.
Not an Equestrian App member yet? Registering is free and easy! Join the tens of thousands of members already enjoying The Equestrian App every day for the management and enjoyment of their equestrian lifestyle!
Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy terms: https://equestrianapp.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00017095:ios.description:
Naughty or Nice: Santa’s Official Christmas App
Make Christmas magical with Santa’s number one Naughty or Nice app. Discover who is on Santa’s list, get a call from Santa, and bring festive fun to the whole family. Since 2010, this app has been spreading holiday cheer with laughter, joy, and a touch of North Pole magic.
Find Out Who’s Naughty or Nice
Are you on Santa’s good list this year? Scan yourself, friends, or family and see the results instantly. Each scan uses Santa’s secret algorithm from the North Pole to reveal if you’ve been naughty or nice. You might even get a special call from Santa himself, straight from his workshop.
Key Features
Naughty or Nice Scanner: Scan yourself or friends to reveal your holiday status. Perfect for kids, families, and parties.
Santa Calls You: Get a personalized call from Santa and make every moment magical.
Make Santa Videos: Create and share festive clips with Santa.
Christmas Countdown: Watch the days, hours, and minutes tick down to Christmas morning.
Where Is Santa: Track Santa’s journey around the world in real time.
Letters and Wish Lists: Write letters to Santa or create a wishlist to share.
Extra Features
Secret override code to set results to naughty or nice.
Safe and secure with no personal data collected or stored.
Family friendly design with cheerful holiday graphics.
Six magical Christmas features in one app.
Why Users Love It
The one, the only, the ORIGINAL – App Developer Magazine
Perfect holiday entertainment – Macworld
Completely entertaining – TopEntertainmentApps.com
We love your app – AppAdvice.com
Subscription Information
The Naughty or Nice app is free to download and includes optional in app purchases or subscriptions for full access. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or turn off auto renew anytime in Account Settings.
Terms of Use and EULA: https://naughtyornicescan.com/EULA/
Privacy Policy: https://naughtyornicescan.com/PRIVACY/

bluejetty:00022064:ios.name: Network Radar
bluejetty:00022064:ios.summary: Whether for troubleshooting, security, or simple curiosity, it’s always helpful to know which devices are connected to your network. Network Radar is a powerful yet easy-to-use network scanning and management tool for iPhone and iPad that g
bluejetty:00022064:ios.description:
Whether for troubleshooting, security, or simple curiosity, it’s always helpful to know which devices are connected to your network. Network Radar is a powerful yet easy-to-use network scanning and management tool for iPhone and iPad that gives you detailed insights into all devices on your network.
As Network Radar scans, it instantly displays newly discovered devices. For each device, you can view comprehensive information such as IP address, DNS names, mDNS name, open ports, response time, and more. You can also create scans with custom IP ranges. All scans are saved and can be revisited later — even when your device is no longer connected to that network.
Take advantage of the built-in network utilities, including Ping, Port Scan, Whois, and DNS lookups (forward and reverse). These tools work not only within your local network but also with external IP addresses and domains.
Network Radar is not limited to your local network. Specify custom start and end addresses to scan any reachable segment of any network from your device.
With its intuitive user interface, Network Radar is simple to use across all your iOS devices. It’s a modern, efficient app designed for iOS with minimal impact on your network.
By the way, Network Radar is also available for macOS — check it out!

bluejetty:00041855:ios.description:
Print from your iPhone to an AirPrint printer on your Wi-Fi network. Documents, photos, PDFs, emails, web pages and scans go to paper in a few taps, with no drivers and no cables.
Works with AirPrint-compatible printers. At first launch, pick your printer model and allow local network access, so the app can find printers near you.
WHAT YOU CAN PRINT
• Documents: PDFs and other files from the Files app
• Photos from your library
• Emails and attachments: share them from Mail and print
• Web pages: open any site in the built-in browser and print it
• Files from Google Drive and Dropbox
• Contacts
• Text you copied to the clipboard
• Camera shots: take a photo and print it right away
SCAN DOCUMENTS
• Scan paper documents with your iPhone camera, with flash and filters
• Scanned documents are kept in My Files, sorted by date
• Print a scan or share it
EDIT BEFORE YOU PRINT
• Edit photos and documents right in the app, then send them to the printer
READY-TO-PRINT TEMPLATES
• 91 templates to print at home: 30 coloring pages for kids, 10 coloring pages for adults, 20 mandalas and 31 planners
PRINT SETTINGS
• Paper size: A3, A4, B5 and more
• Orientation, page range and number of copies
• Double-sided printing, if your printer supports it
• Scale, margins, mirror printing and black and white
HOW TO START
1. Connect your iPhone and your printer to the same Wi-Fi network.
2. Open the app and allow access to devices on your local network.
3. Choose what to print, set the options and print.
Not sure your printer supports AirPrint? See Apple's AirPrint page: https://support.apple.com/en-us/102895
PRO ACCESS
Printing from cloud storage, the document scanner and the photo and document editor are part of PRO. Start with a 3-day free trial.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings at any time.
SUPPORT
Questions or a printer that won't connect? Open Settings in the app for answers to common questions, or write to us at support@yardex.co.
Privacy Policy: https://yardex.co/smart-printer/privacy
Terms of Use: https://yardex.co/smart-printer/eula

bluejetty:00145412:ios.description:
Brick It. Blast It. Love It!
Block Puzzle Blast, or simply Brick Blast, is a popular, relaxing, brain-boosting puzzle game with no time limits—just pure drag, drop, and blast fun! It's a vibrant and addictive block puzzle experience with a playful, colorful twist. Whether you're chasing high scores in Blast Score or unlocking treasures in Blast Quest, every move brings satisfying fun.
Key Features
- Block Puzzle with Lego compatible style. 
- No Wi-Fi or internet needed—play anytime, anywhere!
- Progressive difficulty: puzzle patterns become more challenging as you play.
- Stay sharp with daily challenges and fresh puzzles every day!
Game Modes
- Blast Score Mode: Endless puzzle fun with no pressure. Focus on strategy and relaxation. Perfect for both casual and competitive players.
- Blast Quest Mode: Level-based gameplay with evolving challenges. Collect gems, unlock special blocks, and complete unique missions. Navigate obstacles and limited moves in themed puzzle layouts.
How to Play
- Place Bricks: Choose from 3 colorful pieces and place them on the 10x10 grid.
- Clear Lines: Complete full rows or columns to score points.
- Combos: Clear multiple lines at once for bonus points!
- No Rotations: Pieces can’t be rotated, so plan wisely.
- Game Over: The game ends when there’s no room for new pieces.

bluejetty:00088285:ios.description:
Since 2015, millions of readers have turned to SuperSummary to understand and discuss books with confidence. Our expert-crafted literature guides and reading tools help book clubs, avid readers, students, and teachers get more from every chapter.
WAY MORE THAN BOOK SUMMARIES
SuperSummary helps you keep up or brush up on the plot with free book summaries on nearly 15,000 classic and contemporary titles. 
Need more than a synopsis? Our ever-expanding content library features in-depth analysis of novels, nonfiction, poetry, plays, and more, all available through SuperSummary Essentials:
• Dig into every detail with comprehensive literature Study Guides on over 10,000 classic and contemporary books.
• Spark engagement and comprehension with 1,000+ classroom-ready Teaching Guides packed with activities, essay prompts, and more.
• Never run out of insights with 100+ new Study Guides each month, including celebrity book club picks and trending titles.
WHAT’S INSIDE A SUPERSUMMARY STUDY GUIDE?
Our Study Guides are in-depth resources created by literature professors, publishing industry alums, authors, and other subject-matter experts. Our Guides help you:
• Gain key context about a book’s author, historical relevance, and more
• Refresh your memory with a complete book summary
• Follow and interpret plot points through chapter-by-chapter summaries and detailed analysis
• Get to know each major character or key figure, including their character arc and role in the text
• Understand the book’s recurring themes, symbols, and motifs
• Unpack the author’s intent and craft by reviewing 15+ important quotes with analysis
• Spark meaningful discussions with engaging book club questions 
• Jumpstart essay writing and critical thinking with thought-provoking prompts
BUILT FOR BOOK CLUBS
• Book club prep, handled. SuperSummary gives your group everything it needs in one place:
• Discussion Questions to spark conversation
• Quizzes to refresh your memory before the meeting
• Pick up where you left off with Story Recaps
• Book-Inspired Recipes and cocktails to set the mood
Available on more titles than anyone else—celebrity picks, BookTok favorites, and the classics your group keeps revisiting.
INNOVATIVE FEATURES & INTERACTIVE TOOLS
With SuperSummary Plus, take your experience further with expanded content formats and interactive reading tools:
• Audio narration: Listen to every Study Guide in our library with the convenience of an audiobook. 
• Ask SuperSummary: Get instant, reliable answers to your book questions, backed by our expert-crafted content.
• Quizzes: Challenge yourself with fun, trivia-like questions focused on the full book or specific chapters.
• Discussion Questions: Lead book discussions with confidence with questions tailored by audience, topic, and difficulty.
• Book-Inspired Recipes: Bring books to life with snacks and drinks tailored to your book and dietary restrictions—perfect for sharing!
• Book Activities: Spark creativity with writing prompts, roleplay scenarios, project ideas, and other fun activities tailored to groups or solo reading.
• Timelines: Trace events and character arcs spanning the whole book or specific chapters.
WHY READERS LOVE SUPERSUMMARY
• “Your guides give me insight, depth, and detailed information I can use confidently at my book club discussions.” - Sue, Book Club Member
• “SuperSummary book notes are accurate, very helpful for reviewing, and the app is easy to use. I’ve finished five texts for school, I now have great sets of notes and I’m pleased with my subscription. It is a great value.” - JC, Student
• “Comprehensive book guides and very teaching-friendly. The new AI Book Activities feature is a useful addition. SuperSummary has guides for every book I've taught. It's the first place I go to for teaching guides.” - Stacia, Teacher

bluejetty:00067949:ios.developer: SILFI SOCIETA' ILLUMINAZIONE FIRENZE E SERVIZI SMARTCITY SpA
bluejetty:00067949:ios.summary: Firenzecard app is your exclusive guide to museums in Florence and a handy way to manage all your Firenzecards directly from your smartphone. Browse the offering of more than 60 of Florence’s cultural heritage sites and save your favourites
bluejetty:00067949:ios.description:
Firenzecard app is your exclusive guide to museums in Florence and a handy way to manage all your Firenzecards directly from your smartphone. Browse the offering of more than 60 of Florence’s cultural heritage sites and save your favourites to help plan your visit. You’ll find practical information you need like museum opening hours and locations, as well as helpful tips and more to enhance your experience of the Renaissance city. Furthermore, the Firenzecard app is an essential tool to use Firenzecard Restart, which adds 48 hours to an expired card to visit any museums you missed.
Main advantages:
• Upload your Firenzecard and Firenzecard Restart on your smartphone.
• Use the app to activate Restart within 12 months of your Firenzecard’s expiry for an additional 48 hours of art! This feature is only available via the app.
• Access more than 60 museums in the Firenzecard circuit; the card allows you to visit each one once in 72 hours from your first entry. 
• Children in your nuclear family visit free with Firenzecard! Add the minors, aged under 18, to your card in the app.
• Get complete descriptions of all the Firenzecard circuit museums, with address and opening hours
• Integrated Google Maps as well as static maps for offline use.
• Find a list of current temporary exhibitions free to visit with the card.
Firenzecard is the perfect digital companion for your Florentine visit. Easy and practical, download now for smartphone or tablet, and use “your ticket to art”!

bluejetty:00166094:ios.name: Block Travel : Puzzle Block
bluejetty:00166094:ios.summary: "Block Travel" is a simple and entertaining game that is addictive while enhancing brain training and logical thinking. Remove as many blocks as possible to achieve a higher score. Master the technique of filling rows or columns to make thi
bluejetty:00166094:ios.description:
"Block Travel" is a simple and entertaining game that is addictive while enhancing brain training and logical thinking. Remove as many blocks as possible to achieve a higher score. Master the technique of filling rows or columns to make this puzzle game easier. Activate your brain through various missions in Block Travel!
"Block Travel" offers two exciting game modes, 'Classic Puzzle Mode' and 'Travel Puzzle Mode,' providing endless fun and opportunities to achieve high scores
Classic Puzzle Mode: Drag blocks onto the board to match as many blocks as possible. The game will continuously provide blocks of different shapes and will continue until there is no more empty space on the board.
Travel Puzzle Mode: A challenging mode where you travel around the world! Collect puzzle pieces to complete pictures and earn trophies. Each stage has a new puzzle goal. Complete the objectives and collect trophies!
Features of Block Travel:
- A classic block puzzle game for all ages.
- Comfortable gameplay without time limits and no need for Wi-Fi.
- Playable in airplane mode.
- Lightweight and minimalist game style, playable on most devices.
- Easy to start but challenging to master.
- Hundreds of stages available for unlimited free play. Play to your heart's content!
How to play Block Travel:
- Drag and place the blocks onto an 8x8 grid.
- Fill rows or columns to remove blocks.
- The game ends if there is no sufficient space to place a block on the board.
- Remove multiple blocks at once if possible.
- Blocks cannot be rotated, increasing the challenge and uncertainty. Test your puzzle-solving skills and choose the optimal match when placing blocks.
- No in-app purchases required, and you can continue to challenge yourself by watching ads at the end of the game.
Tips for achieving a high score in the block puzzle game:
- Match multiple rows simultaneously to earn extra points and break puzzle game records!
- Plan the placement of blocks in advance rather than focusing on the moment.
- Choose the best positions based on the shape of the blocks.
- Place blocks rhythmically without rushing, as there is no time limit.
This game is easy to start but continues to challenge you until you master it. Take your time and enjoy the challenge!
When you're filling your leisure time, not sure what to do, or enjoying some alone time, Block Travel is waiting for you.

bluejetty:00140191:ios.name: Gun Shop Simulator 3D Shooting
bluejetty:00140191:ios.summary: Step into the world of arms dealing as a passionate collector-turned-gunsmith in Gun Shop Simulator! This unique simulator lets you create and manage your very own gun store, where you trade, customize, and sell firearms ranging from classi
bluejetty:00140191:ios.description:
Step into the world of arms dealing as a passionate collector-turned-gunsmith in Gun Shop Simulator! This unique simulator lets you create and manage your very own gun store, where you trade, customize, and sell firearms ranging from classic handguns to high-tech, modern weapons. Immerse yourself in the world of weaponry, and watch your business grow as you attract customers from all walks of life—whether they are hobbyists, hunters, or professional security personnel.
Run Your Own Gun Business: Start your journey by stocking your shop with a variety of firearms, including pistols, shotguns, rifles, and military-grade weapons. Organize your inventory with precision, ensuring that everything from handguns to assault rifles is displayed effectively to entice customers. Set your prices wisely, balancing profit with market demands. As your reputation grows, so will the clientele, leading to a bustling business filled with both casual buyers and serious collectors.
Test and Compete at the Shooting Range: Beyond selling and customizing weapons, Gun Shop Simulator offers a fully equipped shooting range where players can put their weapons to the test. You can test any firearm from your personal collection or allow customers to try out guns before they buy. The shooting range isn't just for practice—you can also compete with other players in exciting target shooting challenges. Prove your skill, sharpen your aim, and showcase the performance of your finest creations in competitive scenarios, adding an extra layer of excitement to the game. Whether it’s testing a finely tuned sniper rifle or seeing how a customized pistol handles, the shooting range is the ultimate playground for gun enthusiasts.
Collect and Master: As a passionate gun enthusiast, you’ll have the chance to curate your own personal collection. Unlock rare and historically significant firearms to display in your shop or keep for yourself. These collector’s items can be both highly valuable and fascinating, making your store a destination for gun aficionados. Use the shooting range to not only show off these items but also to compete and prove your marksmanship with them in exciting challenges.
Design and Expand: Your shop is more than just a business—it’s a reflection of your style and success. As you generate more revenue, reinvest it into expanding and upgrading your shop. Build new displays, add security systems, and even offer a custom weapon design station for your customers. A well-designed shop with organized weapon racks, premium lighting, and impressive decor will draw in more traffic and increase your profit margins. And, of course, expanding your shooting range will ensure more players can test and compete with their firearms.
Features:
 Stock your shop with a wide range of firearms, from pistols to military-grade weapons.
 Test and improve your weapons at the shooting range, or compete with other players.
 Expand and upgrade your shop with new features, increasing its attractiveness and functionality.
 Curate your personal collection of rare and valuable firearms.
 Prove your shooting skills in competitive challenges to enhance your reputation.
Are you ready to become the ultimate weapon dealer? Whether you're selling to casual buyers, catering to hardcore collectors, or testing your skills at the shooting range, Gun Shop Simulator is your ticket to success in the competitive world of arms trading. Step into the role of a gunsmith and experience the excitement of building a gun shop empire!

bluejetty:00083788:ios.developer: Beijing Jiayin Network Technology Co., Ltd
bluejetty:00083788:ios.summary: Welcome to the fascinating world of "Cat Cute Tiles: Rhythm Games," a puzzle game that perfectly interweaves the joy of music games with adorable cat games. This is a funny game that transcends the traditional boundaries of rhythm games, pi
bluejetty:00083788:ios.description:
Welcome to the fascinating world of "Cat Cute Tiles: Rhythm Games," a puzzle game that perfectly interweaves the joy of music games with adorable cat games. This is a funny game that transcends the traditional boundaries of rhythm games, piano games, cat games, kpop games and even song games; it plunges you into a whirlwind of rhythm, melody, EDM and the sheer charm of dancing rhythm cats.
"Cat Cute Tiles" is an innovative combination of piano games, cute games, and cat music games. You'll tap and swipe your fingers on the screen to drive the cue cats to play along with charming piano tunes. With genres ranging from classical piano, pop songs to EDM and irresistible Kpop tunes, there's something to please every music games fanatic.
Key Features
- A variety of hot songs for you to choose from
- Electrifying remixes of popular tunes enhanced with delightful "meowing" sounds
- User-friendly guides to lead the way
- Effortless one-touch controls for a smooth gameplay experience
- Gorgeous colors and attractive designs
How to Play
- Tap and hold to hit the falling cute tiles in time
- Keep a keen eye to avoid missing any Cute Tiles within a song!
- Challenge yourself to complete as many songs as possible!
- Amass as much gold as you can to unlock new feline companions
- For the ultimate musical immersion, we recommend using headphones
Expect a cascade of Cute Tiles that come in every shape and size, reminiscent of a captivating triple tiles game or matching games, complete with kitty cats and cute duets. Express your artistic talents and match the beat, be it a classic piano sonata or a catchy Kpop song while controlling these cute cats. It's not just a music game – it's an immersive musical journey.
Here's the good news, this piano game is completely free and can be played without Wi-Fi! Yes! This offbeat blend of rhythm games and cat games can be enjoyed offline, making it one of the most user-friendly free, no Wi-Fi games, offline games out there.
Your journey in "Cat Cute Tiles: Rhythm Games" begins with a simple tap. As these cute tiles fall, tap them to the rhythm of the tune, just like a ballz game. The better you can match the rhythm, the better your score! What's better? The amazing cat music games' "meow meow" bonuses will charm you every step of the way.
As the rhythm games progress, the tempo of classical songs, hiphop, edm songs, pop songs, and Kpop songs challenge your coordination and dexterity. Keep the dance of your fingers going in sync with the cute cats on screen to climb the leaderboards in these exciting song games and cat games.
Whether you are a fan of cat piano games, a lover of cute games filled with kitty cats, or an aficionado of cute tiles – "Cat Cute Tiles: Rhythm Games" is the game for you. With irresistible cute tiles, cats games dynamic, sing games components, and a variety of music from EDM to Kpop, this rhythm game promises a delightful and exciting experience for all.

bluejetty:00170731:ios.name: Peaks: Sleep & Energy
bluejetty:00170731:ios.summary:
That afternoon crash isn't random: it's your rhythm.
Peaks analyzes your sleep to predict exactly when you'll focus, fade, and recover, so you stop fighting your body and start working with it. No manual tracking required, if you already tr
bluejetty:00170731:ios.description:
That afternoon crash isn't random: it's your rhythm.
Peaks analyzes your sleep to predict exactly when you'll focus, fade, and recover, so you stop fighting your body and start working with it. No manual tracking required, if you already track sleep, you're ready.
WHY PEAKS WORKS
Most sleep apps show you what happened. Peaks shows you what to do about it.
Your energy rises and falls in predictable waves driven by two systems: your circadian rhythm (your 24-hour internal clock) and sleep pressure (how long you've been awake). Peaks models both using the two-process model of sleep regulation, the same science behind NASA's astronaut protocols.
The result: a personalized energy curve that updates every morning based on your actual sleep.
WHAT PEAKS TRACKS
Energy Peaks – See exactly when focus is highest. Schedule deep work and important tasks during these windows.
Energy Dips – Know when crashes are coming before they hit. Plan breaks and lighter tasks accordingly.
Sleep Timing – Track when your body releases melatonin so you know when to dim lights and wind down.
Sleep Debt – Every missed hour accumulates. See your running total and how it clears over time.
Recovery Score – HRV and heart rate analysis shows how ready you are for today. Updated every morning.
Vitals – Watch for unusual heart rate patterns that might indicate your body is fighting something off.
Sleep Score – Five components of sleep quality: duration, timing, efficiency, consistency, and debt impact.
BUILT FOR YOUR WORKFLOW
Widgets for Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy, your rhythm at a glance
Apple Watch app with complications for energy predictions
Calendar export overlays peaks and dips on your schedule
Shortcuts integration for custom automations
Smart notifications for peaks, dips, and wind-down timing
CONNECTS TO YOUR DATA
Works with Apple Watch, Apple HealthKit, Oura Ring, and Garmin. No manual logging, if your sleep is tracked, Peaks uses it automatically.
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
All calculations happen on-device. No accounts, no servers, no third parties. Your health data never leaves your iPhone.
Join 100,000+ people planning around their biology.
~ Flo & Clemens from Vienna
Peaks is a wellness tool, not intended for medical diagnosis or treatment.

bluejetty:00041992:ios.description:
Start your own record label. Discover rising stars. Rewrite your legacy in the music industry.
In Music Empire: Rise to Fame, you play as the rebellious heir of a music giant who walks away from the family empire to build something of your own. Every choice you make shapes your future — from signing talent and managing scandals to navigating intense rivalries and complex relationships.
An interactive story with hundreds of decisions
With over 500 choice points, no two paths are the same. Decide who to trust, who to challenge, and how far you’ll go to protect your name.
Chase stardom or stay true to your values
Will you do whatever it takes to rise to the top, or lead your label with integrity? Your choices define your ending — and your legacy.
Business simulation meets music industry drama
Plan tours, close deals with sponsors, manage finances and turn unsigned artists into global superstars. Play smart — or take bold risks that could shake your empire.
Romance, betrayal and power plays
Unexpected encounters — like with Lola, a wealthy socialite with hidden motives — push you into high-stakes personal decisions. Will you follow your heart or focus on your mission?
A cast of unforgettable characters
Work with artists who each carry their own secrets and ambitions. Handle egos, put out fires, and build meaningful connections — or burn bridges.
If you love story-driven games where every choice matters... this one’s for you.
Step into a world where drama, ambition and emotion collide.
Perfect for players who crave immersive storytelling, visual novels, and strategic career simulations.
Ready to build your empire from the ground up?

bluejetty:00034921:ios.description:
The most intuitive and enjoyable way to control your Linn music system; whether you have one or more streamers at your home.
ARTIST VIEW
Searching by artist yields comprehensive results; with artist bios, top tracks, albums, ‘appears on...’, and related artists all contained in a neat, scroll-down list.
STREAM AWAY
All of your favourite high-resolution streaming services – TIDAL, Qobuz, and Deezer – and internet radio services airable, CalmRadio, and TuneIn are fully integrated inside the app. All Linn streamers are also compatible with Spotify Connect. TIDAL Radio and personalised ‘My Mixes’ pull through to Linn app too .
GLOBAL SEARCH
Quickly find what you’re looking for across all your streaming services and stored music content, all from one place.
The revamped global search function allows browsing by artist, album, genre station, or track; and pulls through gorgeous artwork and artist photography in a much-improved and better integrated experience.
DARK MODE
For a more cosy experience, when the lights are down low, dark mode is available via app settings.
NOW PLAYING
An enhanced Now Playing view displays beautiful, large-format album artwork, and includes all transport and volume controls on a single, uncluttered screen.
YOUR PLAYLISTS – ANYWHERE
Your playlists are stored in the Cloud, linked to your Linn account, meaning you always have access to your favourites – from anywhere and at any time – and can cue them up on any Linn streamer on your local network.
UPDATE AND CONFIGURE
Regular, free, over-the-air software upgrades bring performance and feature enhancements to your Linn streamer. It’s easy to ensure your system is always up-to-date with the latest version directly within the app. The ability to manage and rename sources and rooms is embedded in the app settings screens too.
THROW LEGENDARY PARTIES
Own multiple Linn streamers? Take control of every room, all from the same app, on the same iOS device. Link rooms together and enjoy the same music, perfectly synchronised throughout your home.
Linn App is compatible with all Linn Music Systems running Davaar firmware.

bluejetty:00121053:ios.description:
CiberCuba was born with the purpose of being the space of confluence, information and debate of all Cubans. Cuba is not only the archipelago and Isla de la Juventud, it is both the millions of Cubans that inhabit it and the millions that made their usual place of residence from other lands. New times are new solutions and CiberCuba responds precisely to them. It is that delocalized, plural, diverse and, fundamentally, cyber space where all Cubans, regardless of their ideological positions and interests, find a place to find out about what is happening and concerns the island and can, in turn, manifest with comfort and uncensored their views.
Our means of reference are diverse, because we intend to be a mosaic that reflects not only Cuban reality itself but the plural ways of referring to it in the media, so that whoever approaches our portal knows will not find a single orientation, biased and partial. We respect, therefore, the subjectivity of the sources as that of the comments.

bluejetty:00156616:ios.description:
Healthy eating made easy. Your meals planned. Your grocery list ready.
Stop stressing about what's for dinner. Healthy Kitchen is your recipe app, meal planner, and grocery list in one. Browse hundreds of high-protein recipes, import your favorites from anywhere, and plan your week in minutes. Then send your grocery list straight to Instacart. Created with food creator Claire Hodgins, every recipe is easy, realistic, and something you'll actually want to make.
HUNDREDS OF HIGH-PROTEIN RECIPES
Explore hundreds of delicious high-protein recipes for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks, from cozy comfort food to copycat takeout favorites. Filter by quick & easy, budget friendly, gluten free, dairy free, and more, then add any recipe to your week in a tap.
Found something great on Instagram, TikTok, or a blog? Import it in seconds and keep every recipe you love in one place, right alongside your meal plan and grocery list. Your saved and imported recipes plan into your week just like ours.
DONE-FOR-YOU MENUS
Skip the planning entirely. Choose from menus like High Protein, Busy Mom Week, Budget Friendly, Family Favorites, Better Than Takeout, One Pan Wonders, Light & Fresh, and more.
Get a full day of breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks, or just get your dinners covered. Every menu is built around meal prep, smart leftovers, and overlapping ingredients. That means fewer groceries to buy, less food going to waste, and less time in the kitchen.
Swap any meal you don't love, adjust servings for your household, and pick the day you want to start. Add it to your meal plan in one tap. You get the structure, and you keep the flexibility.
GROCERY SHOPPING, DONE FOR YOU
Your meal plan turns into a grocery list automatically, organized by aisle and scaled to the servings you need. Take it to the store, or send it straight to Instacart and get everything delivered to your door. No more forgotten ingredients or last-minute trips.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose a menu or build your own. Start with a done-for-you menu or create your week from scratch.
2. Browse or import recipes. Explore hundreds of delicious, high-protein recipes, or import your favorites from Instagram, TikTok, or any website.
3. See your calories and macros. Every scheduled meal's calories and macros are calculated automatically, so planning around your goals is easy.
4. Get your grocery list. One tap turns your week into an organized list.
5. Shop your way. Head to the store, or order through Instacart for delivery.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE HEALTHY KITCHEN
• No more daily "what's for dinner?" stress
• High-protein meals that go way beyond bland chicken and rice
• Easier meal prep with repeat breakfasts, lunches, and snacks
• Prep reminders so your week stays on track
• Less food waste thanks to overlapping ingredients
• Grocery delivery through Instacart
• Recipes, meal planning, macros, and groceries, all in one place
BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
• Easy, kid-friendly meals the whole family will love
• Customize any recipe and adjust servings for your household
• Save favorites for quick access anytime
• Share one account with your whole household
Every menu leaves room for you. Add your coffee, a side, or your favorite treat. Healthy eating should fit your life and taste amazing.
Built by HealthyKitchen.com and food creator Claire Hodgins. Join 5,000+ members who've taken the stress out of healthy eating and grocery shopping.
Pick your menu. Make it yours. Let's get your week planned.

bluejetty:00149959:ios.description:
TPR: Texas Public Radio App - 
The Texas Public Radio App allows you to listen to Texas Public Radio live, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for all the Texas Public Radio streams at once! You can explore On Demand content, search for stories, bookmark a story for later, and wake up to Texas Public Radio with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from Texas Public Radio even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing – no clicks to start listening.
• Integrated program schedules for every station. You can display up to three of your favorites at a time or flick once to see the schedules for all of your favorite stations.
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to Texas Public Radio in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access public radio programs from multiple content providers (NPR, PRI, APM and Texas Public Radio) easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to national programs, individual story segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The Texas Public Radio App displays the web page associated with the program or story segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Radio Bookmarks
• Save what you were listening to (Live or On Demand) so you can replay, follow-up, or share it later by simply clicking “Bookmark”.
• You can also access the Radio Bookmarks created on your iPhone/iPod on your computer. Just visit tpr.org.
• Compatible with the popular Radio Bookmark device (www.radiobookmark.com).
Search
• The unique “Search Public Radio” feature finds stories or programs across hundreds of stations and web pages and makes it easy to play instantly.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The Texas Public Radio App is brought to you by the people at Texas Public Radio and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.

bluejetty:00186423:ios.summary:
Montessori Preschool, Fun Learning Games for 3-7 Kids
Over 1,000 activities designed by certified Montessori teachers for children ages 3 to 7 — reading, math, science, coding, art, music and more. Your child moves at their own pace and le
bluejetty:00186423:ios.description:
Montessori Preschool, Fun Learning Games for 3-7 Kids
Over 1,000 activities designed by certified Montessori teachers for children ages 3 to 7 — reading, math, science, coding, art, music and more. Your child moves at their own pace and learns by doing. You stay in control of what he/her explores and for how long.
Prepare your child for preschool, kindergarten and early elementary school with hands-on Montessori activities. A favorite of homeschool families looking for early learning that actually works.
WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN
READING & WRITING — From sounds to phonics to full comprehension. In a Montessori classroom, literacy starts before letters: children train their ear with sound games like "I spy," then move on to tracing, spelling and reading.
MATH — Counting, recognizing and tracing numbers from zero to one million, plus a hands-on introduction to addition and subtraction using classic Montessori materials.
SCIENCE — Experiments and discoveries that turn everyday curiosity into real understanding.
CODING & LOGIC — Pre-coding games that build sequencing, reasoning and problem-solving long before a child writes a line of code.
PODCASTS — Audio stories and episodes to listen to. Screen-free learning, for car rides, quiet time or winding down.
DRAWING, SHAPES & COLORS — Free drawing, coloring games and symmetry tools, plus primary and secondary colors and the names of every shape.
MUSIC — Four games to explore rhythm and instruments.
NURSE'S STATION — Help the school nurse care for the children and the school pets: spot the symptoms, choose the right treatment. Logic disguised as play.
NURSERY RHYMES — Sing along to Wheels on the Bus, Head Shoulders Knees & Toes and Old MacDonald.
PRACTICAL LIFE — Watering plants, cleaning a mirror, washing clothes: the everyday gestures Maria Montessori saw as the foundation of autonomy.
LANGUAGES — Switch the whole app between English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Korean and Chinese. Dedicated Chinese and Korean classrooms teach numbers, songs, vocabulary and characters.
3D & AUGMENTED REALITY — Play with the school's hamster and rabbit in 3D or Augmented Reality, depending on your device.
Not another game with a learning label on it. Montessori Preschool follows a real curriculum, built by certified Montessori teachers, with a dashboard that shows you exactly what your child is learning — and controls that let you decide how long they play.
BUILT FOR PARENTS, TOO
- Set a daily time limit, from 10 minutes to unlimited, and the app locks itself when time is up
- Choose exactly which classrooms your child can open 
- Follow progress on a dashboard that tracks every activity and suggests what comes next
- Download the Parent's Guide to support your child's journey through the app.
- Print free seasonal activity sheets for holidays and celebrations
- No ads, no third-party links, nothing your child can stumble into
WHY MONTESSORI
Four principles shape every activity: self-correction, autonomy, self-confidence and adaptability. Children discover their own mistakes and fix them without being told they were wrong — which is exactly how confidence is built.
SUBSCRIPTION
Choose monthly or yearly.
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
PRIVACY
Privacy Policy: https://www.edokiacademy.com/en/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.edokiacademy.com/en/terms
ABOUT US
Edoki Academy's mission is to give children enjoyable early-learning experiences built on solid pedagogy. Many of us are parents and teachers ourselves, and we build the tools we want our own children to use.
Questions or feedback? appsupport@groupebayard.com

bluejetty:00017339:ios.description:
Put your gloves on and step inside the arena because it’s time for the big fight of the night! The Ultra Fighting Bros are ready for a big fighting show! Choose to play the single or multiplayer mode and get ready for some hard-to-beat fun time. Can you win this epic combat? Find out now!
HOW TO PLAY
Each fight is a best-of-three playoff and fighters have 3 lives during each round. Climb the walls of the arena and use strategy to grab your opponent from above and tackle him down, taking a life. A round ends when one of the fighters runs out of lives.
POWER MATCHES
Unlock the Power Version to gain access to the unbeatable Power Matches of the Ultra Fighting Bros. During Power Matches, several items might show up during the fights, making them much more exciting and unpredictable.
Some of the Power Matches items:
• Health - Pick to recover lives
• Freeze - Makes the walls slippery
• Electrify - Electrifies the floor and fighters lose a life on contact
• Blackout - Turns the lights off until the next hit
HIGHLIGHTS
• Fun game inspired by Mixed Martial Arts (MMA)
• Single and multiplayer mode: play against the device or against a friend
• Easy but challenging gameplay
• Power Version with awesome special items and powers
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

bluejetty:00022034:ios.description:
For every moment you need translation — travel, business trips, language learning —
bring along Papago, the smart parrot that speaks many languages.
▶ The Meaning of 'Papago'
"Papago" comes from Esperanto and means "parrot," an animal known for its exceptional language abilities.
Papago currently supports translation across 14 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Spanish, French, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Russian, German, Italian, and Arabic.
▶ Key Features
1) Text Translation
Type the text you want to translate and get real-time results.
2) Image Translation
Just snap a photo and tap the button — Papago automatically recognizes and translates text within the image.
3) Voice Translation
Speak the phrase you need translated and get real-time results.
4) Offline Translation
Use text translation even without an internet connection.
5) Conversation Translation
Have a 1:1 conversation with a foreign speaker — both parties can speak in their own language simultaneously.
6) Handwriting Translation
Just write characters with your finger, and Papago will tell you what they mean.
7) Website Translation
Enter the URL of any foreign website to translate the entire page automatically.
8) Document Translation
Upload a document and get a translation that preserves the original formatting.
9) Edu
Take a photo of study material to create your own notes with text and vocabulary learning features.
10) Dictionary
View additional meanings of words alongside translation results through dictionary information.
Travel with confidence, anytime, anywhere — with your translation partner, Papago!
▶ Required Permissions
· Microphone: Required for voice and conversation translation features.
· Speech Recognition: Required for voice translation features.
· Camera: Required to take photos for image translation.
· Photos: Required to save translated image files to your device.
· Location: Required to view nearby place information from photos captured for image translation.
* To provide voice and conversation translation in Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Russian, and Italian, we use the 'Speech Recognition' permission provided by the mobile OS. When you use voice or conversation translation in these languages with 'Speech Recognition' permission granted, voice data is transmitted to Apple in accordance with Apple's policy. No other information is transmitted.
Like Papago on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/NaverPapago
Follow Papago on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/papago_naver/
※ Requires iOS 17.0 or later
※ Also available on PC/mobile web: https://papago.naver.com
※ Dark mode is supported for comfortable use in low light.
※ Report issues or errors: https://goo.gl/YqHMTi
※ Developer email: naver_market@naver.com
※ Developer phone: 1588-3820
※ Address: 95, Jeongjail-ro, Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi-do, NAVER 1784, 13561

bluejetty:00160683:ios.description:
Welcome to Cooking Games, the ultimate cooking game for kids that transcends the ordinary and ignites boundless creativity! Dive deep into a culinary adventure where you are granted with 8 delightful ingredients, 6 fun-packed cooking tools, and 4 hungry monster customers eagerly waiting to taste your signature dishes. This isn’t just a kitchen; it’s a universe of creativity where your imagination sets the menu.
Embark on a Culinary Adventure
In Cooking Games, there are no boundaries to what you can create. It's one of the best cooking games for kids that allows imagination to be the ultimate chef. Ordinary beef can be transformed into sweet ice cream and the simplest fruits can simmer into a tantalizing soup. This is where food games meet endless possibilities.
Your Kitchen Playground
Step into a kitchen like no other! Equipped with 6 versatile kitchen tools, your child will transition from a novice to a young gourmet in no time. Whether you’re in the mood to fry, slice, or microwave, this is where kitchen games meet sheer excitement.
Tune in to Every Customer’s Whims
Every monster customer is brimming with personality and unique tastes. Sweet or sour? They won’t hold back their feedback! As you learn through play, you'll decipher their taste codes. These learning games not only teach culinary skills but also understanding and empathy.
Features You'll Love
• Real & Fun-Packed Cooking Experience: Perfect for those seeking authentic kitchen games.
• Choose Your Tools & Ingredients: With 8 ingredients and 6 tools, creativity knows no bounds.
• Stress-free Cooking: No rules, pure joy – making it a favorite among games for kids.
• Unique Customer Personalities: Every diner has their own flavor preference.
• Play Offline: A boon for parents; no internet required and absolutely no third-party ads.
• Child-Friendly Interface: Designed with our little chefs in mind.
• More than Just Food: Dive into coloring games, cake making adventures, pizza games, and even baby games all integrated for added fun.
Get ready to embark on an epic culinary journey. Cooking Games is not just another one of the food games or kitchen games – it's where learning through play takes on a delicious twist. Gather your aprons and serve up a feast for our monster customers now!
About Yateland
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00091005:ios.description:
Bora- Where Creativity Meets Technology
Imagine an app that brings together the art of music and the power of artificial intelligence. Welcome to Bora, a revolutionary music creation platform that lets you generate music from pictures, text, and even your mood.
Three features, endless possibilities:
Picture to Music: Upload your favorite images, and our AI-powered robot will transform them into a soundtrack that perfectly captures the mood and essence of the picture. Imagine a romantic sunset scene accompanied by a soothing melody, or a bustling cityscape set to an energetic beat.
Text to Music: Enter your favorite quotes, lyrics, or poems, and our robot will create a musical composition that reflects the emotions and tone of the text. This feature is perfect for writers, poets, and anyone looking to inspire their creative writing.
Mood to Music: Let our robot sense your emotions and create a personalized soundtrack that matches your mood. Whether you're feeling happy, sad, or energized, our app will generate a music piece that resonates with your emotional state.
Features and Benefits:
Generate music in various styles and genres
Experiment with different moods and textures
Share your creations with friends and family
Collaborate with others in real-time
Access a vast library of user-generated content
Explore our curated playlists and discover new music
Join the Music Revolution
Bora is more than just an app – it's a platform for creatives, music lovers, and anyone who wants to experience the magic of music generation. Join our community today and discover the limitless possibilities of AI-powered music creation.

bluejetty:00165728:ios.description:
Introducing Chat AI, the revolutionary new iOS app that gives you access to the power of OpenAI's language model in the palm of your hand! With Chat AI, you can have natural and engaging conversations with an AI-powered chatbot that understands your language like never before.
Whether you're looking for help with homework, need to brainstorm ideas for a project, or simply want someone to talk to, Chat AI has you covered. Our state-of-the-art chatbot is capable of understanding complex concepts and responding in natural language, making it the perfect companion for any conversation.
But that's not all! With Chat AI, you can also customize your chat experience to your liking. Choose from a variety of chat backgrounds and themes, and even personalize your chatbot's name and appearance to make it truly your own.
Plus, Chat AI is constantly learning and improving, so the more you use it, the better it gets at understanding your needs and preferences.
Here are a few examples of features that you can do with Chat AI app:
Homework Help:
Chat AI can assist you with your homework by providing you with quick and accurate answers to your questions. Simply type in your question or problem, and Chat AI will use its advanced language model to generate a response that is tailored to your needs.
For instance, let's say you're stuck on a math problem. You can ask Chat AI to help you solve the equation, and it will generate a step-by-step solution for you. Or, if you need help with writing an essay, Chat AI can provide you with suggestions for improving your writing and even help you generate new ideas for your paper.
Personal Assistant:
Chat AI can also act as your personal assistant, helping you with a variety of tasks such as scheduling appointments, setting reminders, or even ordering food. With Chat AI’s natural language processing capabilities, you can simply ask it to perform a task for you, and it will take care of the rest.
For example, you can ask Chat AI to set a reminder for you to pick up groceries on your way home from work, and it will create a notification for you. Or, if you need to schedule a meeting with a client, you can ask Chat AI to find a time that works for both of you and add it to your calendar.
Virtual Friend:
Finally, Chat AI can be your virtual friend, providing you with companionship and engaging in casual conversations with you. Whether you're feeling lonely or simply want to chat with someone, Chat AI is always there for you.
Disclaimer:
Our app utilizes the power of the Open.ai API, which is based on the open-source GPT-3.5 architecture developed by OpenAI. However, it is important to note that we are a separate entity and have developed our app independently. We do not use any third-party content, and the responses generated by our app are based solely on the interactions with the Chat AI model through the API.
We would like to express our gratitude to OpenAI for providing access to their API, which enables the dynamic conversation and intelligent responses in our app. While we strive to provide accurate and helpful information, the responses generated by the AI Language model should be considered as suggestions and not absolute statements of fact.
To learn more about Chat-AI and explore OpenAI's other projects, we encourage you to visit their official website at openai.com.

bluejetty:00014133:ios.description:
Listen to your favorite DRM-free audiobooks with Bound.
Bound allows you to import audio files from various cloud services and play them back in a beautiful modern interface. Bound will automatically save your listening position so that you never lose your place.
Supported Audio File Types (DRM-free only): .mp3, .m4a, .m4b, .aac
Download
- Dropbox and Microsoft OneDrive.
- Apple Files.
- Web Uploader for importing from your computer via WiFi.
Manage
- Move audio files between books.
- Change cover art.
- Sort based on author, title, recently added, and recently played.
- Rename title and author.
- Choose between a number of fun themes.
- Dark mode support.
Play
- Automatically saves playback location as you progress through the book.
- Independently configure seek forward and seek backward times.
- Chapter support for audio files with embedded chapters (.m4a / .m4b / OverDrive .mp3).
- Change playback speed from 0.5X to 3.0X.
- Smart Rewind when returning to your book after a while.
- Sleep Timer with configurable time or at the end of a chapter.
- Manually bookmark locations that you want to return to.
- CarPlay support.
If you enjoy using Bound, please consider writing a review.

bluejetty:00013720:ios.description:

• Group books with categories, from genres assigned automatically to shelves you create yourself
• Track which books you own and which you’re still hunting for
• Prioritize your backlog so the right book is always next
• Filter and sort by category, ownership, priority, and more
READING STATS
• Set a yearly reading goal and watch your progress
• See books read per year, total pages read, top categories, and top authors
• Find your average book length — and your longest read
AND MORE
• Fast, accurate search powered by Google Books
• Add books instantly with the barcode scanner
• Keep notes on every book
• Back up and restore your library with export & import
• iCloud sync keeps your library on all your devices
With a clean and intuitive design, To Read makes it effortless to organize your reading goals — all for free!

bluejetty:00141685:ios.description:
Embark on a wondrous word quest and puzzle adventure! This addicting game is a relaxing way to exercise your brain, expand your vocabulary, and sharpen your mind. Connect letters, find hidden words, and become a puzzle pro as you progress through hundreds of challenges on your journey.
Calling all brainiacs, quiz whizzes, and crossword fiends! If you love to unwind with a classic crossword puzzle, trivia games, board games, scrabble, boggle, or even solitaire, you’ll find this modern twist on a classic word search a true delight. It's a stimulating mental workout that combines word search and connect puzzle games, offering endless fun.
How to Play:
Your task is to find target words hidden within the letter grid, often related to a common theme. Simply swipe your fingers to connect the letters and form the correct entries. These can appear horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, and some may even be spelled backwards. Uncover all the hidden terms on the board to solve the puzzle and continue your voyage.
Game Features:
- Explore the World: Enjoy a puzzle voyage to beautiful destinations. "Travel" through unique landscapes and collect special badges from each location you discover.
- Massive Level Count: With over 10,000 carefully crafted levels, the fun never stops! This challenging progression will test your skills and help you master the game.
- Offline Play Supported: Enjoy the game anytime, anywhere. No Wi-Fi needed! The adventure is always at your fingertips on your phone or tablet.
- Helpful Hints & Power-Ups: Stuck on a tricky puzzle? No worries! Use boosters and hint tools for clues to quickly get out of a jam and find every word.
- Collect Bonus Points & Rewards: Find extra words to earn bonus points. Collect rewards for your achievements to unlock additional content and power-ups.
- Diverse & Engaging Gameplay: We've introduced a range of mechanics within the classic word search format, ensuring the experience remains fresh and exciting.
- User-Friendly Interface: An intuitive design with smooth interactions allows you to fully engage in the ocean of words without straining your eyes.
This journey promises hours of enjoyment for any seasoned wordsmith or puzzle enthusiast. Pack your bags for an adventure of wisdom and discovery. Are you ready to test your skills and become a word search champion? Download Word Search Journey and begin your puzzle quest today!

bluejetty:00153519:ios.description:
Describe what you're nervous about. This app mentally prepares you for it, in just 10 minutes a day.
THE PROBLEM
You have the skills. But when the pressure is on — the presentation, the exam, the interview, the big game — something takes over. Your mind freezes, self-doubt creeps in, and you perform below what you're capable of.
You've tried deep breaths. You've told yourself to "just relax." It doesn't work, because the problem isn't in the moment. It's in the mental patterns running underneath.
THE SOLUTION
Reprogram uses mental rehearsal — the same technique used by elite athletes, surgeons, and top performers — to train your mind before the moment arrives.
Simply describe your situation, and Reprogram creates a personalized guided mental rehearsal session built specifically for you. No generic scripts. No one-size-fits-all. A session made for YOU and what YOU are preparing for.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Describe your moment: Your presentation, exam, interview, competition, negotiation — anything
2. Get your custom session: Reprogram generates a personalized guided mental rehearsal with vivid detail tailored to your specific situation
3. Listen for 10 minutes: Close your eyes, follow the guided audio, and mentally rehearse your best performance
4. Train your brain: Your mind can't fully distinguish between vivid rehearsal and real experience. Each session builds confidence for the real moment
5. Show up ready: Walk into your moment with trained confidence, not hopeful anxiety
KEY FEATURES
• Custom Mental Rehearsal Sessions — Create a personalized session for any situation in seconds
• Relaxation & Breathwork — Optional preparation modes to deepen your session
• 10 Minutes a Day — Short, effective sessions that fit any schedule
• Backed by Neuroscience — Mental rehearsal activates the same neural circuits as real performance
• Progress Tracking — Build consistency with streaks and daily reminders
• Pre-made Performance Sessions — Expertly crafted sessions for confidence, focus, calm, and peak performance
• Vision Boards — Visualize your goals with custom image boards
WHO IS THIS FOR?
Reprogram is for anyone who needs to perform under pressure:
• Students preparing for exams and interviews
• Professionals with upcoming presentations, pitches, or negotiations
• Athletes and competitors preparing for game day
• Anyone who knows they're capable of more but freezes when it matters
Whether your moment is tomorrow or in three months — Reprogram helps you show up ready.
WHY IT WORKS
Mental rehearsal isn't imagination — it's training. Research from Harvard, Stanford, and the Cleveland Clinic shows that mental rehearsal activates the same neural circuits as actual performance. With daily practice you:
• Override anxiety and self-doubt patterns
• Build confidence through repeated mental success
• Sharpen focus and clarity under pressure
• Train your nervous system to stay calm when it counts
Elite performers don't just practice physically. They train mentally. Now you can too.
BE READY FOR YOUR NEXT BIG MOMENT
Download Reprogram and create your first custom mental rehearsal session. Used by athletes, speakers, students, and professionals to perform at their best when it matters most.
Questions? Contact us at support@reprogramapp.com
Reprogram requires a subscription to access all features including custom mental rehearsal sessions and vision boards. Start with a free trial, then continue with a monthly or annual plan.

bluejetty:00029748:ios.name: WHOOP
bluejetty:00029748:ios.summary: WHOOP is the leading wearable that turns comprehensive health insights into daily action. By capturing dozens of data points every second, WHOOP delivers personalized Sleep, Strain, Recovery, Stress, and health insights—24/7. WHOOP uses tho
bluejetty:00029748:ios.description:
WHOOP is the leading wearable that turns comprehensive health insights into daily action. By capturing dozens of data points every second, WHOOP delivers personalized Sleep, Strain, Recovery, Stress, and health insights—24/7. WHOOP uses those insights to provide coaching based on your body’s unique physiology and recommends everything from when to go to bed to new daily behaviors that will help you reach your goals.
If you’re new to WHOOP, you can try both the wearable and app free for 1 month. Terms and conditions apply.
WHOOP is screenless, so all your data lives in the WHOOP app—for a distraction-free focus on your health. The WHOOP app requires a WHOOP wearable.
How it works:
Healthspan*: A powerful way to quantify your age and slow your Pace of Aging. Backed by leading longevity research, it pinpoints the daily habits that impact your long-term health.
Sleep: WHOOP helps you understand how well you sleep each night by measuring your Sleep Performance. Every morning, WHOOP provides a Sleep score from 0 to 100%. Sleep Planner calculates how much sleep you need to recover, tailored to your habits, schedule, and goals. You can even set a Haptic Alarm that wakes when you're fully rested, or at a specific time, with gentle vibration. Quality sleep is essential for improving your healthspan, metabolic mental resilience, recovery, and performance.
Recovery: WHOOP lets you know how ready you are to perform by measuring your heart rate variability, resting heart rate, sleep, and respiratory rate. You'll get a daily Recovery score on a scale of 1 to 99%. When you're in the green, you're ready for strain, when you're in the yellow or red, you may want to evaluate your training program.
Strain: WHOOP does more than just track your activity–it measures cardiovascular and muscular exertion to give you the most comprehensive view of the demands you put on your body. Each day, Strain Target will provide a Strain score from 0 to 21 and recommend your optimal target exertion range based on your Recovery score.
Stress: WHOOP gives you daily insights to pinpoint your stressors, understand your physiological response, and discover techniques to help manage. Get a real-time stress score from 0-3 and, based on your score, choose a breathwork session to enhance your alertness or increase relaxation.
Behaviors: WHOOP tracks over 160+ daily habits and behaviors—like alcohol intake, medication, and more—to better understand how these behaviors impact your body. WHOOP provides weekly guidance for behavior change and helps set accountability goals with the Journal and Weekly Plan features.
WHOOP Coach: Ask questions about your health & fitness and get highly personalized, on-demand answers. Using your unique biometric data, the latest performance science, and generative AI, WHOOP Coach generates responses on everything from training plans to why you’re feeling tired.
Menstrual Cycle Insights: Go beyond period tracking to better understand your fifth vital sign and get tailored cycle-based insights.
What else you can do in the WHOOP app:
• Dig into the details: See heart rate zones, VO₂ Max, steps, and more trends over time to adjust your behaviors, training, sleep and more based on your goals.
• Join a team: Stay motivated and accountable by joining a team. Chat directly with your teammates in the app, or as a coach, see how your team's training is going.
• Apple Health: WHOOP integrates with Apple's Health app to sync activities and personalize your experience.
WHOOP provides products and services designed for general fitness and wellness purposes. WHOOP products and services are not medical devices, not intended to treat or diagnose any disease, and should not be used as a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. All content available through WHOOP products and services is for general informational purposes only.
Discover the future of health and performance.
*Some availability restrictions apply.

Storyteller is the AI text to speech app that turns any text into lifelike, natural-sounding audio – at a fraction of the price of other voice apps.
Paste, type or scan text and hear it read aloud instantly by 500+ realistic AI voices in 45+ languages. Create voiceovers, audiobooks, narration and multi-voice stories, then download them as MP3.

 • Premium voices for less – studio-quality AI voices without the studio price.
 • 500+ natural voices – male and female voices with adjustable style, pitch and speed.
 • 45+ languages and accents – English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Hindi, Arabic and many more.
 • Read aloud anything – articles, notes, emails, essays, scripts, books and homework.

PERFECT FOR

HOW IT WORKS

SAVE TIME AND MONEY
