bluejetty:00028761:ios.description:
“I, as a Cat Hero, will vanquish all monsters tormenting my master in his dream!"
Fish Cannon? Check.
Cuteness and Bravery? Double Check!
It is a Cat Hero's sworn duty to protect their master from all forms of threat even if it means from their dreams.
However, even the dark of the nightmare can make a hero's fur stand up. But fear not for you are not alone! You will meet friends, companions, and join forces with other Cat Heroes from all over the world on this quest to make sure the master feeds the cat and cleans the hairballs sitting by the corners.
■ Explore the Vast Dreamland in Cute, Quality Graphics
Take on epic raid bosses, stroll along coastlines, fight the monsters of the ocean, and soar into the skies as you journey in this dreamland that is beautifully crafted in cute, quality graphics.
■ Simply Tap to Merge Fishes Endlessly and Grow Stronger
Merge fishes to make your fish missiles stronger. The Magic Tank will fill the fish so don't worry about running out of fish!
■ Meet Companions to Customize your Build for Greater Firepower
Choose from over 40 skills and 50 companions! Befriend Sausage, Bread, Chicken, Wolves, Pirates, and even a Tank Commander to unleash tons of damage. And let’s not forget about the runes that aid your build!
■ Join Forces with other Cat Heroes to Enjoy More Content
Cooperate with your guild to conquer the battlefield and win the siege. Win special gear and more rewards from the guild fights and share the sweet taste of victories with your mates.
■ Wind Down with Diverse Range of Contents for Endless Fun
Even Heroes need to catch a break every now and then. Customize in style with various skins and participate in various engaging minigames to get loads of rewards. Manage your Cat Town or visit someone else’s to either help or interrupt them! And when you are ready to battle again, test your strength in Arena for special rewards!
■ Let it Idle
Go offline and your companions will fight for you. AFK rewards pile up up to 24 hours, so come back any time to upgrade your team!
Join the ranks of Cat Heroes and protect your master’s dreams! Download and play now for free!

Covering math, science, liberal arts, and economics, MathSnap's advanced AI solver equips you to conquer challenges across various disciplines with ease.
【 SCAN AND SOLVE MATH QUESTIONS】
Unlock the power of Artificial Intelligence with MathSnap, the premier math problem solver app designed to revolutionize the way students and math enthusiasts solve and understand the math questions. Join world of MathSnap for checking assignments, preparing for tests, and unraveling the answers of mathematics!
With MathSnap, you'll have access to a comprehensive suite of features and resources tailored to enhance your learning experience:
-Insightful Math Support: Take your learning to new heights by gaining a deeper understanding of the "how" and "why" behind math problem-solving. Our embedded glossary acts as a handy reference, providing reminders for terms and concepts. Uncover hidden math insights and strengthen your grasp of mathematical foundations.
-From Basics to Advanced: Whether you're tackling basic arithmetic or venturing into advanced geometry, MathSnap is your trusted companion on the journey to mathematical answers. We believe in taking one step at a time, guiding you through each concept until you achieve mastery.
【Key Features】
AI Problem Solver: Snap a picture of your problem and witness MathSnap's intelligent algorithms unravel the solution, step by step.
Comprehensive Subject Coverage: Explore in-depth math, science, liberal arts, and now, economics. Whether tackling algebraic equations, unraveling calculus puzzles, or delving into economic theories, MathSnap has your back.
Word Problems & Geometry Mastery: Say goodbye to struggles with complex word problems and intricate geometric puzzles. MathSnap simplifies these challenges, making understanding intuitive.
Free Step-by-Step Explanations: Expand your understanding with free, detailed breakdowns of each problem. MathSnap ensures you comprehend not only the answer but also the process behind it.
Personalized AI Tutor: Get unstuck anytime, anywhere. Ask questions, seek clarification, and receive customized guidance to master topics across various fields.
【Mathematics & Beyond】
Explore a universe of mathematical concepts effortlessly. MathSnap covers everything from basic arithmetic to advanced calculus, trigonometry, and statistics. Simplify polynomials, factorize expressions, perform matrix operations, and unravel probability distributions—all at your fingertips.
【Never Stop Until You Get It】 Encounter a tough concept or a puzzling step? MathSnap's AI tutor is available 24/7 to provide personalized explanations, helping you overcome obstacles and build confidence in your studies.

bluejetty:00133228:ios.description:
Passport Photo Editor is a, online app that makes it easy to create a passport-sized biometric photo. This app is designed specifically for US passport photos and provides a virtual photo booth experience right on your device. With Passport Photo Editor, you can take a picture or upload an existing one, and the app will automatically adjust the size to meet the required specifications for a US passport photo. The app is user-friendly and provides step-by-step instructions to ensure that your picture meets all the necessary biometric requirements.
In addition to its passport photo creation capabilities, Passport Photo Editor is also an ID creator. You can use the app to create an ID card with your photo, name, and other personal information. The ID card is perfect for work or school, and you can easily print it out or save it to your device.
With Passport Photo Editor, you no longer have to worry about taking multiple trips to a physical photo booth or spending a lot of money on a professional photographer. The app is available online, making it accessible from any device with an internet connection. Whether you need a passport photo or an ID card, Passport Photo Editor is a convenient, affordable solution.

Prompt+ can be used with the Zoom Video Conferencing app in multitasking mode on compatible iPad devi
bluejetty:00126024:ios.description:
Prompt+ is a professional teleprompter app that helps you present with confidence. 
Simply read your script as it scrolls up the screen.
Prompt+ can be used with the Zoom Video Conferencing app in multitasking mode on compatible iPad devices. Overlay your script on a Zoom call and read your script as it scrolls next to the camera. You will present with confidence and engage your audience with excellent eye contact.
It's free for scripts of up to 750 characters and works across all iOS devices. For longer scripts, there is a one-off in-app purchase. This app does NOT require a monthly or annual subscription.
* Scroll the teleprompter using voice recognition (iOS 13+) or speed control.
* Mirror your text for use in a physical teleprompter device.
* Display a clock to help you stick to time.
* Import your scripts from Dropbox, Google Drive, iCloud or OneDrive in .doc, .docx, .txt, .rtf or .pdf format. 
* Add Rich Text formatting to make them easier to read.
* Set a countdown to get into position.
* Use in landscape and portrait orientation.
* Adjust the font size, colours, text alignment, and width of the text area.
* Control the script remotely using a Bluetooth presentation control, foot pedal, games controller, external keyboard or even another Mac or iOS device.

bluejetty:00182704:ios.description:
Defend your house from hordes of zombies. Survive, build a time machine, and save humanity. Pixel Combat: Zombies Strike is a pixel first-person zombie shooter with wave battles, shelter defense, and base survival.
Fight through wave after wave, board up the house, place barricades, defend your shelter, and search for resources. Aim fast, move smart, and use the right weapon in every fight. If you like zombie games, action shooters, FPS combat, and survival under siege, get ready for nonstop attacks, dangerous enemies, and intense boss fights.
Explore 40+ 3D locations, complete 110+ missions, and find 120+ secrets and hidden rooms. Every level pushes you to fight harder and play smarter. Enemies grow stronger, bosses use special abilities, and you must change position, manage resources, and hold your base.
Use 60+ weapons to stop the undead horde. Fight with knives, axes, pistols, rifles, shotguns, machine guns, a flamethrower, a minigun, and more. Craft weapons and ammo, strengthen your defenses, and prepare for the next attack.
Secret rooms, rare resources, and rewards help you survive longer and move closer to your goal. Step by step, collect what you need to build a time machine and save the world.
Game Features:
- Pixel first-person zombie shooter with 110+ missions full of action, survival, and intense combat
- House defense and shelter survival against undead waves
- Barricades, base defense, and survival tactics across 40+ 3D battle locations
- 120+ secrets and hidden rooms for players who explore every level
- Boss fights and monsters with special abilities that make every battle more dangerous
- Craft weapons and ammo, use 60+ weapons, and unlock 150+ weapon skins
- Black Ops-inspired zombie action in a pixel world
- Minecraft-style characters and blocky skins, plus 20+ skins for your character
- A time machine story about saving humanity and 80+ achievements to complete
Install Pixel Combat: Zombies Strike, shoot zombies, survive the waves, defend your shelter, complete missions, collect weapons, hold your base, and save humanity in this zombie FPS shooter.
The app offers an auto-renewing subscription, “VIP Gold Status,” which gives players extra rewards without ads. Subscription duration: 1 week.
Privacy Policy: https://avegagames.com/legal/pixel-combat-privacy-policy.html
Terms & Conditions: https://avegagames.com/legal/pixel-combat-terms-conditions.html

bluejetty:00124365:ios.summary:
Bestellen bij bol? Dat is het makkelijkst via onze app. Ervaar het zelf! 
Zo blijf je op de hoogte van korting en mis je geen deals, kun je altijd en overal zonder omweg winkelen in onze winkel, reken je veilig af via de app van jouw bank
bluejetty:00124365:ios.description:
Bestellen bij bol? Dat is het makkelijkst via onze app. Ervaar het zelf! 
Zo blijf je op de hoogte van korting en mis je geen deals, kun je altijd en overal zonder omweg winkelen in onze winkel, reken je veilig af via de app van jouw bank (bijvoorbeeld ING, Rabobank of ABN Amro), en kies je voor uitgebreide bezorgopties; thuis of bij een afhaalpunt van PostNL, Albert Heijn, Bpost of Delhaize. 
Winkelen via de bol app kent tal van voordelen:
Jouw bol, altijd bij de hand
Maak eenvoudig een account aan of log in met je bestaande account. De app biedt ondersteuning voor verificatie met touch id en face id. Veilig en wel zo makkelijk.
Persoonlijke tips
Ontvang persoonlijke tips om het beste uit ons assortiment met miljoenen artikelen te ontdekken. Tips bestaan bijvoorbeeld uit verwante artikelen, acties en aanbiedingen.
Nieuwe dag, nieuwe deal
Elke dag is er een nieuwe deal. Open de app om snel de nieuwste dagaanbieding te bekijken. Als je écht fan bent kun je de aanbieding ook als notificatie ontvangen.
Snel gevonden, die zoekfunctie
Perfect voor wie al (bijna) weet wat ‘ie wilt kopen. De zoekfunctie is direct zichtbaar wanneer je de app opent en doet aanvullingen en suggesties op jouw zoekwoorden.
Handige filteropties
Moeilijk kiezen uit 5000 resultaten? Gebruik de uitgebreide opties om te filteren op bijvoorbeeld categorie (zoals fashion, elektronica en games) of merk (zoals Nike, Adidas, Apple, Samsung, Rituals, Philips Hue, Lego, Pampers, etc.).
Typ op
Geen zin om te typen? Navigeer dan door categorieën (zoals fashion, elektronica of games). Ook beschikt de app over een barcode/qr-code scanner. Handig bij Het Grote Speelgoedboek!
Producten vergelijken
Elk product toont overzichtelijk de omschrijving, specificaties, klantbeoordelingen en verwante producten, zodat jij makkelijk kunt vergelijken. Fan of nog niet zeker over om het product te kopen? Deel dan gemakkelijk via WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter of email.
bol als marktplaats
Via bol verkopen duizenden winkeliers (zoals About You, BCC, Gall & Gall, Etos, etc.) hun artikelen zodat jij als klant profiteert van meer keuze in assortiment, prijs en levertijd. De verkoop verloopt altijd via bol en bij elk product bieden we uitgebreide informatie over de verkopers.
Lijstjes vol verlangen
Bewaar jouw favoriete producten op verlanglijstjes. Je kunt er meerdere aanmaken en als je wilt kun je de lijstjes delen via WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter of email. Handig voor bijvoorbeeld familie en vrienden bij verjaardagen.
Veilig & vertrouwd bestellen
Bestel met vertrouwde betaalopties zoals achteraf betalen, credit card, iDEAL en Bancontact. Afrekenen gebeurt vervolgens via de app van jouw bank (bijvoorbeeld ING, Rabobank, ABN Amro, Bunq, etc).
Bezorgopties
Laat je bestelling bezorgen op de datum die jou het beste uitkomt, ‘s avonds of overdag. Niet thuis? Geen probleem. Kies voor bezorging bij een afhaalpunt van PostNL, Albert Heijn, Bpost of Delhaize.
Blijf op de hoogte
Activeer push notificaties en ontvang meldingen met bezorgupdates en betaalherinneringen. In voor meer? Activeer dan ook meldingen voor acties & aanbevelingen en/of updates van korting op je lijstjes.
Klantenservice
Wij zijn er voor jou, 24 uur per dag en dat 7 dagen per week. Stel je vraag gerust in de chatfunctie van de app. Je ontvangt een melding zodra jouw antwoord klaarstaat. Bellen en/of mailen mag natuurlijk ook.
Retourneren
Neem de tijd want je hebt 30 dagen bedenktijd. Toch niet helemaal wat je wilde? Dan kun je het kosteloos en vaak ook zonder te printen retourneren, bijvoorbeeld bij PostNL, Albert Heijn, Bpost of Delhaize.
Feedback?
Altijd welkom! Voel je vrij om een review te schrijven of deel het in een berichtje naar klantenservice@bol.com.

4. Get free coins every few hours
5. Simple & intuitive card game play interface

Play everyday and see how you match up with other players

bluejetty:00030711:ios.name: Truck Maps Navigation
bluejetty:00030711:ios.summary: Truck Maps is a navigation app designed for professional truckers, bus drivers and RV enthusiasts. Tailored to the unique needs of larger vehicles, it goes beyond traditional navigation with specialized features for a safe and stress-free j
bluejetty:00030711:ios.description:
Truck Maps is a navigation app designed for professional truckers, bus drivers and RV enthusiasts. Tailored to the unique needs of larger vehicles, it goes beyond traditional navigation with specialized features for a safe and stress-free journey.
KEY FEATURES:
- Truck-, Bus-, and RV-Specific Routing
Truck Maps calculates routes optimized for the size and weight of your vehicle, taking into account low bridges, weight restrictions, and other road limitations.
- Customized Vehicle Profiles
Create vehicle profiles with height, weight, length, and other dimensions for accurate route planning. Profiles sync across all your devices.
- Voice-Guided Turn-by-Turn Navigation
Voice guidance announces upcoming maneuvers at the right moment — adapting to your speed. When a second turn follows closely, it tells you about that too. Works seamlessly with Bluetooth and CarPlay.
- Route Customization & Avoidance Options
Specify avoidance options such as toll roads, highways, or certain terrain types to create a personalized route.
- Real-Time Traffic Updates
Truck Maps dynamically adjusts your route to avoid congestion, helping you save time and fuel.
- Detailed Route Information
Distance, estimated travel time, turns, waypoints, weather, and color-coded traffic visualization — all at a glance.
- Road Shields
Familiar road shield icons displayed during navigation, just like real road signs.
ON THE ROAD:
- Live Activities on Lock Screen & Dynamic Island
See your next maneuver, remaining distance, and ETA right on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island — even when your phone is locked.
- 3D Driving Indicator
A beautifully rendered 3D puck shows your exact position and heading on the map.
- Default Navigation App
Set Truck Maps as your default. When other apps open directions, Truck Maps takes over with truck-safe routing.
- Dashcam
Your device's camera doubles as a smart recorder, capturing your drive for added security.
PRODUCTIVITY:
- Frequent Addresses
Your most-used destinations appear as quick-select pills in the search bar for instant access.
- Usage Statistics & Trip Tracking
Track total trips, distance driven, average trip length, and driving time. View destinations on an interactive heatmap and browse charts over customizable time frames.
Download Truck Maps today and experience the road like never before!
Privacy Policy: https://bastian.codes/privacy-policy/truck-maps
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00160779:ios.name: Mario Dal Maso Administradora
bluejetty:00160779:ios.developer: MARIO DAL MASO ADMINISTRACAO E ENGENHARIA LTDA
bluejetty:00160779:ios.summary: Com seis décadas de história, a Mario Dal Maso é especialista em desenvolvimento de soluções, trabalha com excelência na administração e gerenciamento de condomínios, imóveis e patrimônios: comerciais, residenciais e industriais de acordo c
bluejetty:00160779:ios.description:
Com seis décadas de história, a Mario Dal Maso é especialista em desenvolvimento de soluções, trabalha com excelência na administração e gerenciamento de condomínios, imóveis e patrimônios: comerciais, residenciais e industriais de acordo com a legislação e, assim, proporcionando completa assessoria na gestão condominial ao síndico, subsíndicos, conselho fiscal e moradores.
Além disso, a entidade é certificada pelo PROAD (Programa de Autorregulamentação da Administração de Condomínio) e pelo Programa Qualificação Essencial (PQE), que comprovam que a administradora trabalha com ética, profissionalismo e responsabilidade.
Tanto pelo site da Mario Dal Maso quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com a Maro Dal Maso Administradora, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para mariodalmasoapp@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00092165:ios.summary: Create surreal Inception-like videos by choosing from a collection of reality distortion effects and color looks – all with live camera preview. Or take captivating stills using the same effects and looks, both in standard or square format.
bluejetty:00092165:ios.description:
Create surreal Inception-like videos by choosing from a collection of reality distortion effects and color looks – all with live camera preview. Or take captivating stills using the same effects and looks, both in standard or square format.
• Professional Video Effects - Live preview while recording.
• Reality Distortion - Create mesmerizing Inception effects.
• Cinematic LUTs - Premium color grading presets.
• Mirror Reflections - Add symmetrical transformations.
• Photo Mode - Apply effects to still images.
• Social Format - Perfect for Instagram and TikTok.
• Easy-to-Use - Stunning results instantly.
• Import and add effects and looks to videos and photos created with other apps.
Join more than 200.000 creators who trust nception for stunning visual content.
Download now to start creating viral-worthy videos and photos!
• App Store ”Editor’s Choice” in the UK and Ireland. 
• App Store "App of the Day" in 19+ countries.
• Featured in App Store's "Today" 10 times in 55 countries. 
••• Visual examples:
You can find lots of user created examples here:
www.instagram.com/explore/tags/nceptionapp/
Or just search Instagram for "nceptionapp".
••• Contributions:
Share your own creations to #nceptionapp on Instagram. 
There's also a link to Instagram #nceptionapp in the "INSPIRATION" section of the app.
••• Frequently Asked Questions •••
• Can I import images and videos with custom resolutions?
Absolutely. This also works for pictures that you have cropped or edited within the iPhone's native library.
• Why is there no audio in my Nception video?
Nception videos are always recorded with audio. However, the sound is muted by default. You can enable audio for any previously recorded video in the “MY NCEPTIONS” view. Just select your silent video, tap the pencil icon to edit, and then tap on the speaker icon to turn the audio on.
• How do I remove a color look?
Choose your video in “MY NCEPTIONS”, tap edit (the pencil icon), tap the color looks icon and then the reset icon “/“.
• How do I activate slow motion recording?
In the “VIDEO” view, just tap the frame rate icon (24/30/60/120) to select your preferred recording frame rate. The higher the frame rate while recording, the slower the video will appear when played back at a lower frame rate.
• Does Nception support 4K video?
Nception supports 4K in-app video recording at 30 fps on iPhone 7 and later. You can switch between HD (1080p) and 4K (2160p) in the "VIDEO" section.
• Can I backup or clear my Nception Library?
You can access all your original Nception-photos and videos if you connect your iPhone with iTunes. Copy them to any folder you like for backup - or delete them if you want a fast way to clear your Nception Library. Every Nception consists of three files, all starting with the same file name, so just make sure you select all three of them before backup or deletion. And as always, make sure to back up your iPhone before deleting anything.
• Will there be more distortion filters, color looks and other features anytime soon?
Absolutely! We’re constantly updating Nception with new features and enhancements.
Send your suggestions or any questions to support@hugekids.com - we'd love to help you out.
Have fun! :) 
/The Nception Team

bluejetty:00017196:ios.summary:

Spirograph Maker turns the timeless mechanical drawing toy into a digital playground for your iP
bluejetty:00017196:ios.description:
Create mesmerizing geometric art with a single tap.
Released in 2017 with over 110,000 downloads — a math-meets-art tool refined over 9 years.
Spirograph Maker turns the timeless mechanical drawing toy into a digital playground for your iPhone and iPad. Choose your gears, pick your colors, and watch hypnotic patterns bloom across the screen — no drawing skill required.
WHERE MATH MEETS ART
The patterns Spirograph creates aren't accidents — they're governed by GCD/LCM and parametric equations. Watch how the lobe count is determined by n/gcd(n,m), see hypotrochoids and epitrochoids come alive on your screen. A visual companion for middle-school number theory and high-school parametric curves. Whether you're a curious learner, a math enthusiast, or just love beautiful patterns, this is where math becomes mesmerizing.
In 2022, this app was acknowledged in an academic paper on algebraic combinatorics — the smoothness criteria for Positroid varieties (Billey & Weaver, arXiv:2207.06508). From a child's toy to cutting-edge mathematical research — that's how deep these patterns go.
FOUR GEAR SHAPES
Not just circles. Draw with ellipse, rounded triangle (a curve of constant width), and teardrop gears too. Change the gear's shape and the symmetry of the pattern changes with it: circles stay regular, ellipses stretch, triangles beat in threes, teardrops curve organically. A strength slider tunes each shape continuously — from nearly circular to a flat ellipse, or a sharply pointed triangle or teardrop.
KEY FEATURES
- Draw by hand: drag your finger around the gears to roll them and draw the pattern yourself
- Auto-draw mode: tap once and beautiful patterns appear on their own
- Custom color palette with gradient mode for endless combinations
- Adjustable gear shapes and sizes: circle / ellipse / rounded triangle / teardrop, plus tooth count
- Live preview of gear settings
- Undo / Redo (optionally including gear settings)
- Save your creations directly to your Photo Library
- Share to Instagram, Facebook, or anywhere
- Full iPad support — a bigger canvas for finer detail
- Light and Dark mode
WHY SPIROGRAPH MAKER
- A meditative break from a busy day — without leaving your phone
- A visual bridge between middle-school math and university geometry
- Inspired by the classic Spirograph toy, reimagined for modern iOS
- Perfect for parents, students, artists, and math enthusiasts
- Works offline, anywhere
PERFECT FOR
- Winding down before bed
- Sparking creativity with kids
- A short math meditation anytime
- Making one-of-a-kind wallpapers
- Sharing unique art on Instagram
- A short, calm focus break during your day
In Japan, downloads notably spike around the start of new school terms and summer breaks — pointing to a growing use as a learning companion.
Pull out your phone, tap once, and watch sacred geometry unfold. Whether you're a designer, a doodler, a student, or just love beautiful patterns, Spirograph Maker is the simplest way to make art that mesmerizes.
Free to download. Optional ad-free upgrade available.

bluejetty:00013726:ios.description:
The Bible is the book of the Church. Read like you believe it.
Most Bible apps give you the verse. Verbum helps you understand it with over forty free Bibles (including the USCCB’s approved translations) and books, including powerful commentaries, homily prep tools, and writings from renowned theologians and Church Fathers. Create a free account and start exploring:
* Reading Plans: Build a habit with plans you can customize and share.
* Study Assistant: Ask a question, get answers drawn only from your Logos books (limited free uses).
* Smart Search: Search your Bible by verse, topic, or the question you actually have (limited free uses).
* Factbook: Uncover instant background on the people, places, and ideas you run into.
* Notes: Take notes that travel with you everywhere.
Every tool is free to try. If you want to keep going, a subscription gets you more use of AI features like Study Assistant and Smart Search, access to more books, and even subscriber-exclusive free books and discounts. 
This app offers optional subscription plans called Verbum Plus and Premium. If you choose to subscribe,
* Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
* The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least twenty-four hours before the end of the current period. 
* Your account will be charged for renewal within twenty-four hours prior to the end of the current period and will identify the cost of renewal.
* You can manage your subscriptions or turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00175640:ios.name: Locket Widget
bluejetty:00175640:ios.summary: Locket is a widget that shows live photos from your best friends, right to your Home Screen. You and your best friends will see new pictures from each other every time you unlock your phone. It’s a little glimpse of what everyone’s up to th
bluejetty:00175640:ios.description:
Locket is a widget that shows live photos from your best friends, right to your Home Screen. You and your best friends will see new pictures from each other every time you unlock your phone. It’s a little glimpse of what everyone’s up to throughout the day.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Add the Locket widget to your Home Screen
2. When a friend sends you a photo, it instantly appears on your Locket widget!
3. To share a pic back, tap into the widget, take a pic with the camera, and then hit send! It appears right on your friends’ Home Screens
FOR YOUR CLOSE FRIENDS
• To keep things friendly, you can only have 20 friends on the app.
• On Locket, there’s no worrying about follower count, just add your best friends and family and live in the moment.
• With Locket, you’re able to be real and share photos to the people that matter.
REACT TO FRIENDS' PHOTOS
• Send a Locket reaction to your friends to let them know you saw their image.
• They’ll get a notification and you’ll love watching the emojis rain down on your photo.

bluejetty:00157814:ios.description:
Welcome to "Mood Jar" – Your private mood keeper! 
In this super cute APP, every day's mood can turn into adorable little emoticons! Whether it's beaming with joy under a clear blue sky or a tiny bit blue with drizzling rain, just tap lightly and they'll zoom into your very own Mood Jar! 
And if you feel like little emoticons aren't enough to express your myriad thoughts, then use words to paint a vivid picture! Whether it's sweet little secrets or daily little blessings, this is your tiny haven for your heart.
The most magical part is, "Mood Jar" transforms into a super smart stats wizard! It quietly keeps track of your mood journey every month, every year:
On the Mood Calendar, colorful marks tell you when you were a happy little blue fairy and when you turned into a melancholy little cloud.
On the bar chart, the number of records each month jumps off the screen, making your mood fluctuations crystal clear – isn't it super fun?
The pie chart displays the proportion of each mood each month, happy, sad, calm... Each mood has its unique place, the beauty of balance is self-evident.
And it'll help you find the shiniest month of the year, telling you when your smile was brightest, doesn't it feel super rewarding?
Most importantly, when you look back at these little moments, you'll discover that there are so many sparkling instants hidden in life! 
Let's use "Mood Jar" together to carefully collect every heartbeat and every reflection in ordinary days! May this jar full of love not only hold your mood treasures but also fill your heart with warmth and touch when you open it one day in the future, realizing – "Wow, my life is so amazing and sparkling!" 
Other practical features:
1. Quickly and accurately search diary content;
2. Conveniently and quickly export diaries;
3. Customize mood expressions;
4. Switch theme skins;
5. Biometric lock;

bluejetty:00121370:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00121370:ios.description:
GeoShred Control Version 7
GeoShred Control is a standalone MIDI/MPE controller based on GeoShred.
Important: GeoShred Control is a MIDI/MPE controller. It does not make sound and does not include a built-in audio engine. It is designed to control external synthesizers, apps, plug-ins, and hardware instruments. It can also be upgraded*** to the functionality of GeoShred Pro. If you already own GeoShred Pro (green icon), you do not need GeoShred Control, because GeoShred Pro already includes MIDI.
GeoShred Control can also be used to control GeoShred Studio for macOS.
Perform external MIDI and MPE instruments with GeoShred’s expressive playing surface. Move seamlessly between fretless and diatonic playing using GeoShred’s isomorphic keyboard and groundbreaking intelligent pitch rounding.
GeoShred Control is especially expressive with instruments that support MPE (MIDI Polyphonic Expression). It is a powerful iPad and iPhone performance controller, and it can also operate as an AUv3 plug-in that sends MIDI.
GeoShred Control includes an arpeggiator, backing tracks, alternative tunings, world scales and temperaments, and 3D Touch on supported devices. It can be upgraded*** to the functionality of GeoShred Pro, including GeoShred’s powerful physically modeled string instruments.
Awards include:
• 2nd Place Winner, 2022/2025 MIDI Innovation Award for Software
• Gold Medal Winner, 2019 Denny Award
• Winner, 2019 Guthman New Musical Instrument Award
• Winner, 2017 Electronic Musician Editor’s Choice Award
GeoShred Control Features
• Send/Connect so GeoShred for iOS/iPadOS can control GeoShred Studio for macOS
• Fluidly expressive playing surface
• Intelligent pitch rounding
• Diatonic keyboard mode where every key is in the scale
• MIDI and MPE support
• MIDI over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Virtual MIDI, and digital interfaces
• MIDI configuration presets
• iCloud preset synchronization
• 3D Touch on supported iPhones
• Customizable control surface mapped to MIDI controls
• Backing tracks from the Music library
• Built-in arpeggiator
• Alternative tunings
• Support for world scales and temperaments, including Indian ragas, Arabic scales, and Balinese scales
• Easy preset sharing
• Upgrade path to the functionality of GeoShred Pro
If upgraded*, GeoSWAM and Naada instruments may be purchased and performed from the GeoShred keyboard, MPE controllers, conventional MIDI controllers, and wind controllers.
We are dedicated to delivering the highest level of musical instrument experience for our customers worldwide. If you enjoy GeoShred Control, please leave a review on the App Store.
Questions? Contact us at support@moforte.com
Minimum Requirements
iOS 13 or later is required for AUv3 support and GeoSWAM and Naada instruments.
* GeoShred Control must be upgraded to the functionality of GeoShred Pro in order to purchase GeoSWAM and Naada instruments.
** Due to App Store limitations, previously purchased individual instrument IAPs cannot be applied to the purchase of a collection IAP.
*** The Pro upgrade is to the functionality of GeoShred Pro. The app remains GeoShred Control, but gains all Pro features and becomes functionally identical to GeoShred Pro.

bluejetty:00079797:ios.summary: Vet Tix, short for "Veteran Tickets Foundation," is a nonprofit organization in the United States that provide event tickets to currently serving military members, veterans, and their families as a way to show appreciation for their service
bluejetty:00079797:ios.description:
Vet Tix, short for "Veteran Tickets Foundation," is a nonprofit organization in the United States that provide event tickets to currently serving military members, veterans, and their families as a way to show appreciation for their service and to enhance their quality of life. The organization partners with various entertainment venues, sports teams, promoters, and individual donors to offer tickets to a wide range of events, including concerts, sports games, performing arts shows, and other forms of entertainment.
The main goal of Vet Tix is to give back to the military and veteran community by giving them the opportunity to attend events that they might not have been able to afford otherwise. This not only allows them to enjoy recreational and cultural activities but also fosters a sense of community and camaraderie among service members and veterans.
Overall, Vet Tix serves as a platform that connects generous donors and event organizers with military members, veterans, and their families, creating positive experiences and lasting memories for those who have served their country.
Features:
Search Events
Access Tickets
Submit Thank you messages

bluejetty:00156851:ios.name: Pearla Verana - Pro Camera
bluejetty:00156851:ios.summary:
Pearla Verana IV is a professional camera app built for photographers and
filmmakers who need complete control and high-quality results.
Every image starts from the same device-calibrated foundation. RealHUE 2
calibrates color for your spe
bluejetty:00156851:ios.description:
Pearla Verana IV is a professional camera app built for photographers and
filmmakers who need complete control and high-quality results.
Every image starts from the same device-calibrated foundation. RealHUE 2
calibrates color for your specific iPhone, and the Pearla Wide Gamut working
space sits behind Log, RAW, HDR, film emulation and custom profiles, so color
is stabilized before the image is shaped, and the result holds through grading,
finishing and delivery.
PearlaRAW captures 14-bit RAW stills and records 14-bit RAW video internally on
every supported iPhone. Burst at up to 25 fps in 14-bit RAW or 40 fps in 12-bit
RAW with pre-capture, or use the intervalometer across any capture pipeline.
Shutter Priority mode locks your shutter speed while ISO adjusts continuously.
Pearla's film emulation engine adds luminance-aware grain and halation in real
time up to 4K60, with detailed tonal control and custom recipes designed to
replicate the look and feel of classic film stocks. For Log capture, Pearla
supports Apple Log 2, S-Log3, LogC3, C-Log3, F-Log/F-Log2, V-Log, N-Log, L-Log,
D-Log, I-Log and Blackmagic Film Gen 5, with waveform and false color
monitoring and tone mapping controls.
A built-in RAW editor lets you grade RAW photos and video shot in Pearla and
export to Photos or Files as Log or as finished deliverables. Photo and video
settings stay separate, external drives and HDMI output are supported, and
files are directly accessible through the built-in media manager.
For many shoots, Pearla's real-time audio mixing replaces the external
microphone. Dialogue lifts clear of the scene at capture, on the iPhone's own
mics. It is non-destructive, so you can always adjust to your liking or pull
the original audio.
Pearla also includes a speech-activated teleprompter, customizable presets on
custom buttons, a customizable Quick Menu, remote capture from a second iPhone,
and Tilta Nucleus-M support.
Whether you're shooting for a client, documenting everyday life, or building a
personal archive, Pearla is designed to support a focused, intentional creative
process.
Subscription pricing and terms:
A subscription is required to use Pearla.
Pearla offers an auto-renewing yearly subscription to provide you with
unlimited access to all features while you maintain an active subscription.
Pearla requires an iPhone device running iOS 18 or later.

bluejetty:00128645:ios.description:
Mit der SpardaSecureGo+ App haben Sie die Möglichkeit, alle Banking- und Kreditkarten-Transaktionen innerhalb einer App schnell, einfach und sicher freizugeben. Für Kunden der Sparda-Banken Augsburg, Baden-Württemberg, Berlin, Hamburg, Hannover, Hessen, München, Nürnberg, Ostbayern, Südwest und West.
DIE APP IM ÜBERBLICK:
• zentrale App zur sicheren Freigabe von Kreditkartenzahlungen & Transaktionen im Banking
• sehen – bestätigen – freigeben: bequeme Direktfreigabe statt TAN
• neues, ansprechendes & nutzerfreundliches Design, bekannt aus dem Online-Banking
• hoher Sicherheitsstandard
• bis zu drei Geräte gleichzeitig für Banking-Freigaben nutzen
EINE ZENTRALE APP FÜR FREIGABEN
Die neue SpardaSecureGo+ plus App ist die zentrale Freigabe- und Sicherheits-Anwendung für Authentifizierungen und Freigaben für alle digitalen Kanäle.
DIREKTFREIGABE STATT TAN
Für Transaktionen mit Kreditkarte und im OnlineBanking bzw. in der neuen BankingApp müssen keine TANs mehr eingegeben werden. Mittels bequemer Direktfreigabe werden die Zahlungen im Handumdrehen bestätigt. Mit wenigen Klicks zum Ziel.
sehen – bestätigen – freigeben
Für Zahlungen über eine Banking-Software (FinTS) oder bei bereits bestehenden Online-Banking-Anwendungen (über den Internet-Browser) kann es zur Anzeige einer TAN kommen, welche wie gewohnt eingegeben wird.
NUTZERFREUNDLICHKEIT UND DESIGN
Unser Ziel ist es, ein einheitliches Nutzererlebnis auf allen Kanälen zu schaffen. Die SpardaSecureGo+ plus App reiht sich im selben Design wie das neue Online-Banking ein. Ein einheitliches und wiederkehrendes Design fördert die intuitive Bedienung.
HOHER SICHERHEITSSTANDARD
Um ein hohes Maß an Sicherheit zu gewährleisten, erfolgt die gesamte Kommunikation verschlüsselt. Die Ausführung von Transaktionen ist mit Ihrem selbstgewählten Freigabe-Code oder per Touch-ID/Face-ID gesichert. 
BIS ZU DREI GERÄTE GLEICHZEITIG FÜR FREIGABEN NUTZEN
Über die Geräteverwaltung können Sie selbständig bis zu drei Geräte registrieren (für Banking). Ist die SpardaSecureGo+ plus auf den Geräten freigeschaltet, können Sie Freigaben auf jedem aktiven Gerät tätigen.

bluejetty:00129652:ios.description:
Duplica – Share Your iPhone or iPad Screen Remotely
Whether you’re across the office or across the world, Duplica lets you mirror your iPhone or iPad screen in real time, with no cables, no viewer apps, and no limits. All you need is an internet connection.
Remote Mirroring. No Downloads. Full Compatibility.
Duplica streams your iOS screen to any device using just a web browser—no installation required.
Supports:
• Mac, Windows, Linux
• iPhone, iPad, Android
• Smart TVs and Chromecast (same network)
Perfect For:
• IT support and remote assistance
• Product demos and live presentations
• Remote collaboration and meetings
• Online teaching, tutoring, and training
Why Choose Duplica:
• Simple and secure one-click sharing
• Works via a browser—no app required on the viewer’s side
• High-quality streaming with low latency
• Quick setup, ready in seconds
Limitations:
• Some third-party apps may block screen mirroring, resulting in a black screen. This limitation cannot be bypassed.
• Chromecast streaming works only within the same Wi-Fi network.
• Currently supports one receiving device at a time.

bluejetty:00039713:ios.name: Cogni
bluejetty:00039713:ios.summary:
Learn to feel better and get to know yourself using Cogni!
Cogni is the easiest, quickest and fun way for you to write down your thought records. These records are widely used in Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (CBT), but they can be useful e
bluejetty:00039713:ios.description:
Learn to feel better and get to know yourself using Cogni!
Cogni is the easiest, quickest and fun way for you to write down your thought records. These records are widely used in Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (CBT), but they can be useful even for non-therapists.
BENEFITS:
  • Easy to learn and use
  • Your notes are always with you!
  • Practical and easy to record your emotions
  • Record emotions with few touches on the screen
  • You don't even need to write if you don't want to
  • Take notes wherever you are
  • All your records in one place
  • Get more out of your therapy sessions
  • Never again forget to report something to your therapist
For those who do not yet know, Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (or simply CBT) is a type of psychotherapy, as well as psychoanalysis and other types of therapy. CBT has been growing a lot around the world, due to the practical treatment approach and the excellent results it has achieved.
Among several techniques used by psychologists who practice CBT, one of the most commonly used techniques is the Dysfunctional Thinking Record. And that's what Cogni is for!
It works like this: Whenever you feel some remarkable emotion, you take note of the situation that caused it, as well as the thoughts you had at the time and the actions you took as a result of this emotion.
Over time, your records begins to reveal patterns of behavior that you and your therapist can identify and work with.
Even if you do not have a psychologist or do not yet do therapy, recording your thoughts can be very helpful as a way of self-learning.
And perhaps one day you decide to consult a psychologist, you will have a rich history that your therapist can use to guide you!
You will learn to know yourself better and control your emotions better, achieving a more balanced and happy life!
FEATURES:
  • Drag gesture to indicate your mood
  • List of selectable feelings
  • Marking for strong thoughts
  • History of thoughts
  • Sending reports to the therapist
  • Emotions chart
So, you want to learn to feel better?
Get started with Cogni right now!

• Easy-to-understand gameplay

• Play anytime, anywhere

bluejetty:00095316:ios.description:
SYNTH ONE J6 (Inspired by Juno-6 & Jupiter series*)
Trusted by over 250,000 iPhone & iPad musicians, Synth One J6 is now on Mac too!
Pro Quality. Actually Cool. And Yes, Totally Free.
Synth One J6 delivers lush pads, deep basses, classic keys, and vibrant leads that feel truly alive.
No ads. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases (unless you want to leave a tip). 
CREATED BY VOLUNTEERS
Musicians, Educators, and Sound Designers over 4 years. Synth One J6 is used in Schools and Higher Education institutions across the world. 
Just pure, expressive sound designed for creators of every level.
EASY TO USE
The interface is intuitive and welcoming. Each function has a dedicated slider or knob.
Simple for beginners and deep enough for pros. 
WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT?
Major accessibility improvements and Voice Over have been added throughout the app to make Synth One J6 a much more enjoyable instrument for blind and visually impaired musicians.
LEARN THE EXCITING STORY:
audiokitpro.com/synthonej6
Inspired by legendary synths like the Juno, Jupiter, and DeepMind series. It's not a clone. It's a new classic: built from the ground up with a custom, non-vibe coded sound engine. You’ll hear the warmth, the punch, the vibe. 
INSTANT INSPIRATION
With over 400+ presets, a classic step sequencer, dual arpeggiators, analog-style filters, tape delay, reverb, chorus, 3 LFOs, and real-time FX control, your creativity will never hit a wall.
FEATURES:
∙ 400+ Presets and Features Included, 
∙ Pro Version Included, Nothing to Buy!
∙ Microtonality and World Scales
∙ Accessibility and Voice over for the Blind and Hearing Impaired
∙ Lush, Expressive Vintage Synthesizer Sound
∙ FX: Glorious Reverb, Analog Tape Delay, Chorus, Crush, and more.
∙ 3 LFOs, over 60+ possible destinations, almost everything can be modulated! LFOs can even modify other LFOs
∙ Control it with a MIDI Keyboard, MIDI Learn to map your controls to the app
∙ Classic Arpeggiator & Vintage-style Step Sequencer, with extra features
∙ Dual Assignable Touch Pads, manipulate FX in real time!
∙ Preset Sync between iPhone, iPad & Mac! Create a sound on one device and continue working with it on another.
∙ Created by volunteers to support music education and access for all
PLUGIN ON iOS and MAC:
∙ iOS: Works as a Plug-in Instrument in GarageBand and Logic for iPad, AUM, Cubasis, and MORE!
∙ Mac: Tested in Ableton, GarageBand, Logic, and more!
WORKS BY ITSELF
∙ “RECORD” button: Easily record your synth and sound fx, then export wav fileNo other apps needed!
PERFECT FOR CLASSROOMS AND... STUDIOS
Synth One J6 was built for musicians of all levels, with an interface that is intuitive for beginners and deep enough for pros. Especially great for schools and students who may not have access to paid apps.
BUILT BY MUSICIANS, SHARED WITH THE WORLD
MADE FOR MUSIC. MADE FOR EVERYONE. 
Music should be for everyone. That is why Synth One J6 is truly free. No fees. 
Please help us share it. Tell a teacher. Tell a student. Tell anyone who’s dreamed of experiencing a vintage synthesizer but lacked the opportunity.
Because music belongs to everyone.
* LEGAL NOTICES
This app has no affiliation or endorsement from Roland Corporation. It is not a clone of the Juno-6, Juno-60, Juno-106, Jupiter-8, or any other synthesizer. While we were inspired by the sound and legacy of these iconic instruments, this is an original creation, built from the ground up.
All product names, trademarks, and images mentioned are the property of their respective owners and are used only to describe the inspiration behind this app and for purposes of reference. Their inclusion does not imply any association, affiliation, or endorsement.
This project is free and was created solely to promote music creation and education.
We sincerely respect the incredible work of Roland and other manufacturers in shaping music history.

Musicians, Educators, and Sound Designers over 4 years. Synth One J6 is used in Schools and Higher Education institutions across the world. 
Just pure, expressive sound designed for creators of every level.

EASY TO USE
The interface is intuitive and welcoming. Each function has a dedicated slider or knob.
Simple for beginners and deep enough for pros. 

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT?
Major accessibility improvements and Voice Over have been added throughout the app to make Synth One J6 a much more enjoyable instrument for blind and visually impaired musicians.

LEARN THE EXCITING STORY:
audiokitpro.com/synthonej6

Inspired by legendary synths like the Juno, Jupiter, and DeepMind series. It's not a clone. It's a new classic: built from the ground up with a custom, non-vibe coded sound engine. You’ll hear the warmth, the punch, the vibe.

bluejetty:00116646:ios.description:
Are you ready to become the true Coffee Master?
Step into the most intense coffee rush challenge yet! In Coffee Master: Color Block, you’ll slide, sort, and brew your way through a fast-paced slide puzzle full of colorful chaos. This is not just another coffee game—it’s a caffeine-fueled block jam where every move counts.
Welcome to the coffee world you never saw coming.
Step into the ultimate coffee jam as the new Coffee Master! Your mission is to slide colorful blocks across the grid, guide them to matching gates, and fill the cup trays with perfect precision. Complete each coffee pack and deliver it before chaos brews. Whether you’re sorting lattes or mastering each coffee stack, this fast-paced slide puzzle will challenge your reflexes and deliver endless coffee mania satisfaction.
TOP FEATURES:
Slide puzzle meets coffee sort: A perfect blend of sliding logic and satisfying coffee games action.
Strategic caffeine-powered levels: Master each stage of the jam puzzle and boost your barista brain.
Bright visuals & smooth animations: Dive into a world of color blocks and beautifully brewed layouts.
Relaxing yet addictive: A chill vibe with the excitement of a coffee mania – perfect for short sessions or long gameplay binges.
HOW TO PLAY:
Slide color blocks toward their matching gates.
Fill the cup trays by matching color correctly.
Complete each coffee pack by filling all slots.
Once a tray is full, it gets delivered automatically.
Plan your moves to avoid block jam and master the coffee sort.
Can you keep up with the coffee rush?
From smooth espresso swirls to chaotic color block jam, Coffee Master: Color Block is the ultimate sorting test for every puzzle lover and coffee games addict. Whether you're chasing the perfect coffee stack or surviving the next jam puzzle, this is your chance to rule the café floor.
Don't hesitate any longer. Join the coffee chaos now. Only true masters survive the rush.

Plus, add multiple smartphone cameras and everyone at the gam
bluejetty:00035472:ios.description:
Using just a smartphone, a GoPro or Mevo camera you can live stream your games, practices and more, allowing family and friends to join and watch live at NO cost to the viewer. 
Plus, add multiple smartphone cameras and everyone at the game can save highlights just after they happen, replay them seconds later and share them instantly. 
• No Cost for Viewers and No Login Required: Friends and family can watch your games live for no fee. In fact, they don’t even need to create an account! Share a link to your team’s landing page, so anyone can quickly watch your games or practice sessions.
• Private Events: Add a pin code to your events to keep your games or practices restricted to the audience you want, whether that’s just parents, coaches or players.
• Add the Score in Real-Time: With our crowd-sourced scoreboard feature, parents can update the score throughout the game. The scoreboard is shown on the live feed, on the individual clips and on the game replay.
• Instant Highlights During the Game and After: With just the press of a button, Sporfie saves your highlights AFTER you’ve seen it happen, whether you’re at the game from the sidelines, watching the live stream remotely, or watching the full-game replay. 
• Start Streaming with Just Your Mobile Device: With just one smartphone camera filming the action, anyone who joins can enjoy the game without having to film and still save their own personal highlights instantly.
• Replay the Full-Game from the Cloud: The entire game’s footage is saved in the Cloud, so you can replay, save highlights and download the action anytime.
Also available: 
Want to capture hands-free? Using the Sporfie CLIPR button, you can now leave your smartphone in your pocket or bag and wirelessly capture the action in one click!

bluejetty:00081876:ios.description:
One of the most addictive Rummy Based Conquian Card Game.
BONUS COINS
-Get upto 25,000 coins as a Welcome Bonus into conquian card game, and get even more coins by collecting your EVERY DAY COIN BONUS.
Conquian is a two-player rummy type game and is played with standard playing cards.
The Pack of Colonel Rummy
A standard pack of 52 cards with all the tens, nines and eights removed, leaving a total of 40 cards in the deck with conquian card game.
Rank of Cards with Conquian
The jack and seven are considered to be in sequence. The rank of an ace is low only so that the sequence A, 2, 3 can be formed, but not A, K, Q.
Object of the Conquian Rummy
Each player tries to form matched sets consisting of groups of three or four of a kind, or sequences of three or more cards of the same suit.
The Deal with Conquian
Each of the two players is dealt 10 cards. The remaining cards form the stock; no upcard is turned.
The Coon Can Play
After the deal is completed, the non-dealer turns up the top card of the stock. The player does not put it into their hand but must immediately meld it, along with cards from their hand, or discard it.
Melds or Spreads are as in regular Rummy - matched sets of three or four or a sequence of three or more cards of the same suit.
On Each player in turn thereafter must either take the top discard and meld it (placing the meld face up on the table), or turn up the top card of the stock and meld or discard it.
Keep track of what cards have been played
- Try to memorize what other players have in front of them and what’s already been discarded.
Discard cards that force your opponent to meld
- Try and pick the card that’s most inconvenient for your opponent. If you can force them into taking a card in a meld, it can force them to discard a card and limit their options during later turns.
CONQUIAN CARD GAME FEATURES
Leaderboard - Get competition with worldwide players with Conquian. Game Center is helping to find out player's top positions on the Conquian Leaderboard.
Timer Bonus - Get Time Based Bonus rewards for game coins and power elements to the conquian game.
Daily Bonus - Get easily daily bonus with conquian game.
Quests - Get on Weekly basis available deals to get an extra game coin bonus with conquian game.

Have fun.

bluejetty:00035277:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00035277:ios.description:
ĐẤU THẦN TUYỆT THẾ - Xứng tầm Tân Vương game nhập vai xuất thế
 Tuyệt phẩm game mobile MMORPG tiên hiệp mới nhất trên thị trường đã có mặt tại Việt Nam.
 Đồ họa 3D siêu việt, hiệu ứng mãn nhãn, gameplay đa dạng và hấp dẫn, cốt truyện lôi cuốn, xứng đáng là game MMORPG 3D hàng đầu hiện nay.
 Dựa trên tuyệt tác ngôn tình tiên hiệp “Từng Thề Ước - Thượng Cổ Tình Ca”, tựa game Đấu Thần Tuyệt Thế mở ra một thế giới thần thoại đầy huyền ảo, nơi thần - ma - yêu - nhân không ngừng tu luyện và tranh đấu để giành lấy lãnh địa, xưng bá khắp cõi hồng hoang. Đây là thời kỳ đầy hỗn loạn nhưng cũng không kém phần lãng mạn bởi cảnh sắc như tiên như mộng, bạt ngàn linh thú, kỳ hoa dị thảo cùng những mối tình thiên cổ rung động đất trời.
 Đến với Đấu Thần Tuyệt Thế, bạn sẽ được đắm chìm vào một cuộc phiêu lưu mới trên con đường tu tiên, gặp gỡ kết giao với nhiều tiên hữu khác để cùng chiến đấu trong những màn PK nảy lửa, và biết đâu tìm được một nửa đích thực của mình.
 [Tuyệt bản tiên hiệp - Tinh hoa tiên hiệp hội tụ]
 - 7 class nhân vật cùng hệ thống ngoại quan đồ sộ lên đến hàng trăm loại tiên dực, tiên kỵ, tiên sủng, thần binh,...giúp bạn thoải mái sáng tạo nhân vật. 
 - Độc Tôn Lĩnh Vực: tự kiến tạo nên Lĩnh Vực của bạn, không ai có thể xâm phạm.
 - Triệu hồi Thượng Cổ Dị Thú: sở hữu những linh thú có 1 không 2 trong lịch sử.
 - Tiên Linh: Hóa thân vào các nhân vật huyền thoại như Nữ Oa, Tôn Ngộ Không,...
 [Tuyệt sắc đồ họa - Mãn nhãn mọi góc nhìn]
 - Hồng Mông Thần Tàng, Quy Khư Mộng Diễn: Hàng chục set đồ thời trang cực kỳ hoành tráng chỉ có được khi dày công sưu tập, đặc biệt có thể kết hợp tạo nên 7749 phong cách.
 - Đồ họa 3D siêu việt, zoom cận cảnh chất lượng cao, hiệu ứng skill ngoạn mục giúp bạn trải nghiệm sắc nét vẻ đẹp hoàn mỹ trong từng khung hình.
 [Tuyệt đỉnh PK - PK đỉnh thống lĩnh tam giới]
 - Hệ thống PVE - PVP chiến trường tranh bá đa dạng và hoành tráng, cung cấp nội dung khiêu chiến liên tục, đặc biệt là Tranh Bá Tinh Đồ liên 2-8 server tranh đoạt cứ điểm vô cùng kịch tính.
 - Hệ thống kết nghĩa 5 huynh đệ đồng sinh cộng tử cùng nhau tu tiên, làm nhiệm vụ, săn boss,...cực kỳ khác biệt và mới lạ.
[Tuyệt tác tình duyên - Đắm chìm vào thế giới tình duyên đầy cảm xúc]
 - Tính năng tình duyên vô cùng phong phú bao gồm bồi dưỡng tình cảm, phụ bản tình duyên, tặng hoa, khóa đồng tâm, bảo bảo…giúp cho bạn và nửa kia ngày càng thắt chặt tình cảm - ”Đấu Thần Tuyệt Thế - Không lo bị ế”
Quyết định phát hành trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số 1091/QĐ-BTTTT ngày 22/06/2023
Link giấy phép: https://giayphep.abei.gov.vn/g1/131169

bluejetty:00078627:ios.description:
Oh hello there! Welcome to Voilà AI Artist, a special little app that turns your photos into stunning pieces of art such as i3D Cartoon , Renaissance Painting, Hand Drawn Caricature by combining Human's creativity and Artificial Intelligence's capabilities.
Have limitless fun!
- Get yourself painted as 15th century, 18th century and 20th century paintingss
- Turn your selfie into 3D Cartoon out of animated movies
- Get your very own Royalty Cartoon drawing , or maybe a Baby Cartoon version of yourself
- Have a little LOL-tastic moment, getting your photo drawn as a hilarious caricature
And many more to come :)
About Voilà AI Artist
Voilà AI Artist is the first product created with love by WEmagine.ai , a team of 2 founders, creative and technology enthusiasts who love to create something wonderful by combining the best of Human and AI 's best capabilities. 
We care about your privacy
We take your privacy seriously and will make sure to update you with transparent and clear updated TOS and Privacy Policy. 
-- Our app does NOT collect nor store any face data including any biometrics data
-- All photos uploaded by users are through permissions and IMMEDIATELY destroyed in the cloud after processing
-- We are using Google Cloud and Amazon Web Services as our backend and servers are hosted in US 
Privacy Policy : https://www.wemagine.ai/privacypolicy
Be sure to check out our Terms of Use
Terms of use : https://www.wemagine.ai/terms-of-service
Voilà AI Artist Pro
For added functionality, try Voilà AI Artist Pro subscription service completely free for 3 days and enjoy no watermark and no ads. If you love it, keep it for as little as $2.99 per week. If you prefer a monthly subscription, our price is $5.99 per month and $29.99 per year for yearly subscription.
*These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
*Your Voilà AI Artist Pro subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your membership and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
Let's keep in touch
Instagram : Instagram.com/VoilaAiArtist
Facebook : Facebook.com/VoilaAiArtist
Twitter : Twitter.com/VoilaAiArtist
Pinterest : Pinterest.com/VoilaAiArtist
Please enjoy Voilà AI Artist and share the masterpiece of you and your loved ones!
Created with love, Voilà AI Artist team at wemagine.ai

bluejetty:00129523:ios.summary:
Breeze OnDemand is a new way to get around — an App based ride service that’s smart, easy, and affordable.
With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will connect you with a ride headed your way.
How it works:
bluejetty:00129523:ios.description:
Breeze OnDemand is a new way to get around — an App based ride service that’s smart, easy, and affordable.
With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will connect you with a ride headed your way.
How it works:
- Book a ride through the App on your phone.
- Get picked up at your location.
- Share your ride with others.
- Save money and reduce carbon emissions.
What we’re about:
IMMEDIATE.
The driver will pick you up within 30 minutes of your confirmed reservation and take you to your destination. 
AFFORDABLE.
Our low price make it easy to get around Breeze OnDemand’s service zone. Pay in the app using credit or debit or pay the driver with cash 
SHARED.
Our App matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a ride with efficiency, speed, and affordability.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, reducing congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Questions? Reach out at support-sarasota@ridewithvia.com
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00120445:ios.description:
The parental control app is created to protect kids and provides supervision to keep kids safe online. The app is a powerful child control app for screen time, tracking location, tracking application usage time, limit app usage, limit phone usage, website control, YouTube monitoring. You can block apps, set daily app time limit, limit screen time, block inappropriate content.
Install this application on your mobile device. The application supports only the parent mode. The child mode is not available for iOS devices.
The application has unique features such as monitoring social media chats and eyes protection. Use night mode and eyes protection features to form healthy habits for your kids’ eyes.
App lock & Phone lock:
• Block apps and block games
• Block social media apps
• Limit app usage time and limit usage time remotely
• Set schedules and limit phone usage for family time, bedtime and study time
Device screen time management:
• Screen time app shows a detailed view of the daily phone usage
• Set and manage a specific daily app time limit
• Screen time tracker allows you to monitor apps usage statistics
Social media chat monitoring:
• Monitoring messengers (WhatsApp, Viber)
• YouTube Monitoring
Eyes protection & Night mode:
• Use Night Mode to protect the child’s eyes from intense blue light in the evening
• Use eyes protection to keep your child’s phone screen at the correct distance from your eyes
Family Locator & GPS tracking:
• Monitor your child’s location on the map in real-time
• Set geo-zone and get notifications if a child leaves this zone
Block websites & Block Youtube videos:
• Monitor websites which your child visited
• Web filters allow you to safe kids from harmful sites and content
• Monitor YouTube videos which your child was watched
• Block YouTube videos and channels
• Turn on Safe Search function to protect your kid’s searches online
also app gives you an opportunity to:
• Monitor and manage your kid’s phonebook
• Monitor the latest kid’s photos
• Monitor the battery level of the kids’ phone
Please install this application on your mobile smartphone and then on your child’s one(s) to perform remote child control of a child’s device.
Link all your family devices to the account. Both smartphones should have network data capability, as the app uses data to send and receive configuration commands.
The application is designed exclusively for children's protection and child safety. If the application is used inappropriately, the company disclaims responsibility for the consequences.
Price for the one-year license includes controlling of five different family devices, which can be activated in any mode (Parent mode / Kids mode). 
Use one account for the whole family.
Check out the subscription price: https://parental-control.net

bluejetty:00165452:ios.description:
Discover a New World of Plant Care with Plant Expert AI
Plant Expert AI is your ideal tool for plant care and expanding your knowledge about them. Our app is specifically designed to help you easily 
and effectively manage all aspects of plant care. Whether you are an experienced gardener or just beginning your journey in the world of plants, 
Plant Expert AI will become your indispensable assistant.
Key Features of Plant Expert AI:
1. Plant Identification:
With our advanced algorithm, Plant Expert AI can accurately identify any plant. Simply take a photo, and our app will instantly 
provide you with all the necessary information about the plant, including its name, characteristics, and care conditions.
2. Plant Disease Recognition:
Our disease detector helps you understand what is wrong with your plant. Plant Expert AI accurately identifies various diseases and 
pests, providing detailed instructions for treatment and prevention.
3. Light Indicator:
Proper lighting is the key to healthy plant growth. With our light indicator, you can find the ideal sunny spots for your plants, 
ensuring they thrive in optimal conditions.
4. Global Search:
Our extensive database allows you to search and find information on any plant by name. Whether you are looking for a rare exotic 
plant or a popular houseplant, Plant Expert AI helps you find all the necessary information.
5. Encyclopedic Information:
Plant Expert AI provides reliable and comprehensive information about millions of plants. You will get access to detailed descriptions, 
care recommendations, and interesting facts about each plant.
6. Create Your Own Greenhouse:
Manage your plant collection with the greenhouse creation feature. Add new plants, monitor their condition, and receive personalized care tips. 
Your plants will always be healthy and well-tended.
Your Green Oasis Awaits! Download Plant Expert AI now and unlock the full potential of your gardening skills!
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION:
By subscribing, you gain full access to our services without ads. A three-day free trial is available to explore all features. The trial will automatically 
convert to a paid subscription unless canceled 24 hours before it ends.
You can choose from weekly, monthly, or yearly subscription plans. Once your purchase is confirmed, the subscription fee will be charged to your account.
You can cancel the trial or subscription anytime, provided it’s done at least 24 hours before the current period ends to avoid automatic renewal. 
The renewal fee will be charged to your account 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
After purchase, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings. Any remaining free trial period will be forfeited 
when subscribing.
For any assistance or feedback, our dedicated support team is always just a click away. Contact us at support.plantexpertai@appvillis.com, 
and we will be happy to assist you. 
Privacy Policy: https://plant-expert-ai.glimmereyeventure.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://plant-expert-ai.glimmereyeventure.com/terms.html
EULA: https://plant-expert-ai.glimmereyeventure.com/eula.html

bluejetty:00063600:ios.description:
Embark on a Culinary Adventure with Kitchen Scramble: Cooking Game!
Join Chef Pepper as she takes her food truck around the globe in this FREE, highly addictive time-management and cooking simulation game. Perfect for adults who love casual, stress-free gaming, Kitchen Scramble offers an immersive experience where your kitchen skills are put to the ultimate test.
Why You'll Love Kitchen Scramble:
- Become a Star Chef: Hone your cooking skills across diverse restaurant settings and master various cooking techniques. Serve your customers swiftly to earn high tips or risk losing them if you're too slow!
- Global Food Journey: Travel city by city around the world, preparing and serving a vast array of food. Delight your customers with dishes like Eggs Benedict, Szechuan Chicken, Sweet and Sour Shrimp, Pizzas, Hamburgers, and more!
- Extensive Menu: With over 1,500 delicious dishes crafted from 280+ high-quality ingredients, there's always something new to cook and serve.
- Challenging Time-Management: Navigate through 2,000+ levels set in 80+ unique locations. Balance speed and accuracy to meet customers' demands under various challenges, including timed levels and minimum score requirements.
- Upgrade Your Kitchen: Enhance your kitchen with 100+ appliances like coffee makers, rice cookers, pizza ovens, and waffle makers. Upgrades help you manage the food line more efficiently and expand your food offerings.
- Social Features: Connect with friends on Facebook to share progress, unlock new locations, and compete on global leaderboards. Ask for help to progress faster and share your culinary achievements on social media!
Exciting Features:
- 1,500+ Dishes: Cook a wide variety of food using the best ingredients.
- 2,000+ Levels: Complete challenges in 80+ locations worldwide.
- 100+ Upgrades: Improve your kitchen appliances to boost efficiency.
- Social Connectivity: Engage with friends, compete globally, and share your success.
- Power-ups & Boosters: Utilize special tools to manage your time and cook more effectively.
- Premium Ingredients: Use high-quality ingredients to earn bigger tips and satisfy demanding customers.
Join the Cooking Craze!
If you're passionate about cooking, kitchen management, and food simulation games, Kitchen Scramble is the perfect match for you. Whether you're multitasking in a bustling food truck or perfecting a gourmet meal in a high-end restaurant, every moment is packed with culinary excitement.
Ready to Cook? Grab your spatula and start mixing, frying, and sautéing with Chef Pepper today!
Download Now for FREE and Start Your Culinary Journey!
Stay Connected:
- Like us on Facebook: www.facebook.com/kitchenscramble
- Share your achievements and invite friends to join the fun!
Note:
- The game is FREE with optional in-app purchases to enhance your gameplay. You can disable or limit in-app purchases in your device settings.
- Push notifications keep you updated with gifts and new content releases. You can disable them in your device settings if preferred.

bluejetty:00073801:ios.description:
Know when to go and where to fish with hyper-local wind and weather conditions and precision forecasts. 
Powered by 90,000+ exclusive Tempest Weather Stations and 150,000+ total sources, FishWeather delivers unmatched accuracy. With stations on buoys, piers, and key waterfront locations, combined with high-resolution marine forecasts, you get real-time conditions and forward-looking insight exactly where you fish.
Plan every trip with confidence using the Tempest Rapid Refresh Model fused with government data for industry-leading Nearcast AI predictions. Dial in the bite with radar, high-resolution forecast maps, and fully customizable alerts, so you hit the water at the right moment, every time.
- Coastal observations from proprietary Tempest Weather Systems along with all public domain marine forecasts and reports (NOAA, NWS, METAR, ASOS, CWOP) including all major airports creating over 150,000 unique stations.
- Exclusive Tempest Weather Systems deployed at key coastal locations report wind, rain, pressure and more than 24 other weather observations. 
- Apple Watch compatibility
- Live wind from our stations support powerful wind flow visualization – augmented by current station reports with advanced quality control.
- Our Proprietary AI-enhanced Nearcast provides enhanced forecasting for temperature, wind gust, speed, direction, humidity, dewpoint, precipitation rate, probability of precipitation, and cloud cover percentage - perfect for fishing.
- Public domain forecast models including High Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR), North American Mesoscale Forecast System (NAM), Global Forecast System (GFS), Canadian Meteorological Centre Model (CMC), Icosahedral Non Hydrostatic Model (ICON).
- Your fishing forecast app’s free subscription provides unlimited wind alerts with customizable thresholds to email, text, or get in-app. Plus National Weather Service (NWS) Marine Weather Forecasts & Marine Warnings / Alerts.
- Create a personalized Favorites list and instantly track conditions at all your go-to spots, so you’re always ready.
- Explore rich, interactive maps featuring real-time and forecasted wind, temperature, radar, satellite, precipitation, cloud cover, and nautical charts. 
Master the water with:
 - Tides charts
 - Wave height, wave period
 - Water temperature
 - Sunrise / sunset
 - Moonrise / moonset
 - Historical wind statistics
 - Windy days per month
 - Wind direction distribution
Go Beyond the Basics: Upgrade to Plus, Pro, or Gold membership to gain access to more weather stations, ad-free browsing, and more.
- Access exclusive high-quality Pro stations at top coastal locations and unlock FishWeather’s hyper-accurate Pro weather and wind forecasts written daily by a team of real meteorologists.
Detailed weather info, gusts, rain radar, satellite, NOAA, NWS, at spots of interest to coastal residents and property owners near the ocean, rivers and other bodies of water, including:
 - Sea surface temperatures
 - Sea surface currents
 - Detailed historical wind statistics
 - Historical wind speed average by year
Does your spot need a station? Join the Tempest Weather Network!
Get a Tempest Weather System and your data can be displayed in the FishWeather app.
Get support: help.weatherflow.com/hc/en-us/categories/200419268-Sailflow-iWindsurf-iKitesurf-FishWeather-WindAlert
Connect:
 - facebook.com/tempestwx
 - twitter.com/tempest_wx
 - youtube.com/@tempestwx
 - instagram.com/tempest.earth
Contact Tempest: help.weatherflow.com/hc/en-us/requests/new
Website: tempest.earth
By purchasing a subscription or downloading FishWeather you agree that you have read and accept our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
https://got.wf/privacy
https://got.wf/terms

bluejetty:00072906:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Draw Happy Queen!
It is a game to draw various things and make the Queen smile.
How much can you help them in need?
To pass this level, you have to discover why they are in trouble or in a bad mood. Think of something they will be happy with and write it in your own hands.
If your expectations are correct, their dissatisfaction will be resolved and you will smile!
Can you make the girls happy or struggle? Do you need a clue or a hint?
Are you looking for intuitive easy puzzle games? Save these girls!
They want to live a happy life, so they need your brain! Help them out!
Let's test your brain! Start drawing now! Save them all!
How to be a Draw Master
1.Relax and solve puzzles
Calm down and find missing issues
Please don't erase anything, but just scribble on the screen
2. Spend long days in the lives of girls
Over 200 puzzles and so many episodes of missing parts are packed with fun!
Don't be braindead! Look for clues and hints.
3. You don't have to draw perfectly—no need to be perfect
Enjoy just like you would on a chalkboard.
You need not feel guilty. You will likely have fun when you find the story behind the scenes!
If you like ibis paint, sketchpad, brainpop and happy glass, Draw Happy Queen will also be one of your favorite choices. Let's download Draw Happy Queen now, and draw something to solve puzzles! Drawing will put a smile to your face and your family!
This game is so easy that it's perfect for your kids to play! People of all ages can play, so let's play with your family and friends and get excited!
Feature functions:
• Draw by touching directly on the screen (tap and scribble)
• Intuitive UI and UX
• Colorful drawing will entertain your whole family
• Hint and clue are always available for each stage (hint is hidden at the bottom of the screen when you reach a certain stage)
• Short and simple game design to suit any age group
• No need to rush—there is no time limit
• Take your time and relax
• Easy to figure out puzzle
• Judgement is made user friendly
• Friendly tips, all for free!
What are you waiting for? Start drawing now, and save them cute girls!
Let's play Draw Happy Queen right away!

Practice English through conversations with an AI tutor. BetterSpeak offers guided speaking activities and AI-generated feedback to support your English learning routine.
Whether you’re beginning to learn English or looking for more opportunities to practice, explore everyday topics and work on expressing your ideas in English.

Take part in interactive conversations with an AI avatar tutor. Practice answering questions, expressing opinions, and using English in everyday situations.

Practice conversations related to work, travel, and daily life. Use guided activities to explore vocabulary and try different ways of communicating.

Explore speaking activities based on your learning goals and level. Make time for topics you want to revisit and practice at your own pace.

ENGLISH FOR WORK AND DAILY LIFE
Practice introducing yourself, discussing familiar topics, and communicating in workplace situations. BetterSpeak provides opportunities to use English as part of your learning routine.
