bluejetty:00014313:ios.description:
Know what you have, where it is, and your take home profits at a glance. Inventory Now tracks every item from purchase to sale — barcode scanning, real-time team sync, Square checkout, and true profit after expenses. Built for resellers, small shops, and any team managing stock across locations.
SCAN ANYTHING — Use your camera or an external scanner to find or add items instantly. Generate your Barcodes and SKUs. WIth Smart Scan: snap a photo and we'll create the item for you, with a suggested retail price.
SELL AND GET PAID — Create orders and take payments. Accept in-person payments through Square Point of Sale or Tap to Pay on iPhone. Track order status, customer details, refunds and returns. Send professional invoices and receipts in seconds.
KNOW YOUR REAL PROFIT — Track unit cost and auto-calculate sale prices and margins. Log expenses so your profit numbers are real. See inventory value, sales, and profit at a glance.
WORK AS A TEAM — Sync across devices and team members, so everyone sees the same stock. Run stocktake sessions together: scan what's on the shelf, reconcile against what the system says, and review the report as the numbers come together.
CONNECT YOUR CHANNELS — Sync with Shopify. Push listings to eBay or Etsy with one click and track the orders that come back. Send expenses and revenue to QuickBooks.
NEVER RUN OUT — Get notified when stock dips low. Inventory Now estimates days of stock remaining and lets you set your own reorder thresholds by quantity or lead time.
ORGANIZE IT YOUR WAY — Name, category, subcategory, UPC, SKU, location, images, notes, and custom fields. Add variants and track quantities across multiple locations. Sort, filter, and search to find anything instantly. Move data in and out with CSV import and export. Use Average cost basis for first-in-first-out cost calculations.
EVERYWHERE YOU WORK — Use it on iPhone, iPad, MacOS and any device with a web browser. Your data is backed up automatically and can be restored at any time.
SUBSCRIPTIONS — Inventory Now is free to try. Full functionality requires a service subscription:
Personal — core inventory tracking for a single user, from $10 / mo.
Professional — for teams and advanced features, from $20 / mo.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Service: https://www.inventorynow.com/terms-of-service 
Privacy Policy: https://www.inventorynow.com/privacy-policy
Questions? support@inventorynow.com

ListenLeap transforms podcasts, YouTube videos, and audio content into an immersive English learning experience. With bilingual subtitles, AI explanations, sentence-by-sentence listening practice, and shadowing exercises, any content can become your English textbook.
【Real English Content】
• Learn with thousands of podcasts and YouTube videos
• Discover content recommended based on your interests and level
• Explore topics including business, technology, news, culture, history, and more
【AI-Powered Subtitles】

• AI-powered explanations for vocabulary, phrases, and expressions

• Repeat difficult sentences with one tap

• Get instant pronunciation feedback with AI
• Build confidence through daily listening practice
【AI Learning Assistant】
• Automatic content summaries
• Ask questions about what you're learning
• Save notes and key takeaways effortlessly
【Import Your Own Content】
• Import YouTube videos
• Import local audio and video files
• Generate subtitles and translations automatically

bluejetty:00131278:ios.description:
Make Your Health a Habit.
Lose weight and keep it off with Noom.
Millions of people trust Noom because it pairs medication with mindset, giving you the tools, support, and science-backed strategies to build lasting habits. The award-winning app gives you all-in-one access to step tracking, meal logging with AI, face and body scanning with health insights, and rewards just for showing up.
Whether you want to build better habits or work with a clinician on Noom, you’ll get a weight loss plan tailored to your goals and lifestyle.
FEATURES
- AI food logging with 1M+ food items, protein & calorie tracking
- Access to GLP-1 meds, if eligible
- Body scans for real-time insights
- Meal plans & dietitian-backed recipes
- 1,000+ fitness, stretching & meditation classes
- Daily lessons on habits, & behavior change
- Supportive communities
- Sync with Apple Health, Fitbit, Garmin & more
- Optional 1:1 coaching
What people are saying:
“An evidence-based lifestyle behavior change program.” - Mashable
“Cost-effective and accessible to everyone looking to help manage their weight loss." - Newsweek
“Helped me reimagine my food choices without forcing me to completely cut out any foods.” - Healthline
NOOM WEIGHT
A sustainable weight loss program to help you change the habits behind your health through lessons and science-backed tools.
- Avg. weight loss: 15 lbs in 15 weeks¹
- 95% say it’s a long-term weight loss solution2
- 98% say it changed their habits for good2
- Supports intermittent fasting & behavior-based food logging
- Stay consistent with coaches, content & community
Plans as low as $17 a month.3
NOOM MED
Combine proven GLP-1 meds with the tools and support to lose weight and keep it off—even if you stop medication.
- If eligible, access trusted GLP-1s like Ozempic®4, Wegovy®, and Zepbound®55
- Or choose Noom GLP-1Rx with SmartDose, a personalized dosing system designed for a smoother, more effective GLP-1 experience
- Meds shipped to your door in 7 days,6 if prescribed 7
- Microdose GLP-1Rx options available, designed to deliver effective results and minimize side effects
- 100% online access to doctors & health coaches
- Protect your strength with Muscle Defense™ workouts
- Pairing GLP-1 medication with Noom habits leads to ~37% more weight loss 8
Plans start at $39 a month.9
¹ Based on a 3.5 year study of actively engaged Noom users with a minimum starting BMI of 25.
2 Based on a sample of 4,272 Noomers.
3 Based on a web annual auto-renewing plan for $209 USD. All prices are prior to any applicable sales tax or discounts. 
4 Ozempic® is not FDA approved to treat obesity or for weight loss
5 Eli Lilly and Company has not authorized this content. Not all customers will medically qualify for prescription medications. Pricing will vary based on dosage
6 Medication delivery in 7 days is only available for compounded medications. Not all customers will medically qualify for prescription medications. Compounded medications are produced in an FDA-registered facility but not reviewed by the FDA for safety, efficacy or quality
7 Medications require consultation and prescription by clinician through Noom platform. Not all customers will qualify for prescription
8 Results based on a January 2026 analysis of 14,203 Noom GLP-1Rx Program members who actively logged weight over a 40 week period. High and low engagement groupings measured by quantile of app opens. Higher app engagement was associated with greater weight loss at 16 weeks; this association does not imply causation
9 Pricing based on the 1st month subscription fee only and does not include the cost of medications
For CCPA: "Do Not Sell" Policy for California Residents, see https://www.noom.com/ccpa-do-not-sell/
Noom's Facial and Body Scans are for educational use only. These products are not medical devices and should not be used as a substitute for clinical assessment by a healthcare professional.

bluejetty:00027039:ios.name: Metar-Taf
bluejetty:00027039:ios.summary:
Visualized METAR and TAF weather information for all airports in the world. Concise summary of everything you need to know about today's aviation weather. 
METAR features: 
- Visualized in easy to understand and colourful metrics
- Weather
bluejetty:00027039:ios.description:
Visualized METAR and TAF weather information for all airports in the world. Concise summary of everything you need to know about today's aviation weather. 
METAR features: 
- Visualized in easy to understand and colourful metrics
- Weather symbols for significant weather and clouds, like in a non-aviation weather report
- Crosswind calculations, by combining METAR and runway information
- Flight rules category: VFR, MVFR, IFR, LIFR
- Read out by text-to-speech available, listen to a decoded METAR while doing other things
TAF features:
- TAF broken down and displayed per hour in a table
- Show sunrise/sunset, minimum and maximum temperature
Keeping track:
- Add your favorite stations to the list, see their weather at a glance
- Get observations near your location
- Find stations in the interactive map with weather codes
- Search airports by ICAO code or name
History:
- Graphs with weather trends today and yesterday: temperature, visibility, wind speed, QNH
- METAR history for the last hours and link to more on the website
Airport information:
- See information about the airports, like runway directions, elevation, location 
- If the airport doesn't report a METAR, the nearest station used for calculations
Calculations:
- All units are customizable units: speed (knots, km/h, m/s, mph), altitude (meters/feet), visibility (kilometers/miles), temperature (Celcius/Fahrenheit) and air pressure (Hectopascal, Inch Hg)
- Times are converted to the local time for each airport
- Sunrise and sunset are calculated based on the airports latitude/longitude
General:
- METAR, TAF and airport data are automatically saved for offline use
- Available in 6 languages: English, Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese, German and French

bluejetty:00092639:ios.description:
Know your strength. Track your progress. Get stronger.
My 1 Rep Max is a powerful yet easy-to-use one-rep max (1RM) calculator and strength tracker designed to help you train smarter, measure your progress, and reach new personal records.
Whether you're working toward a bigger bench press, a stronger squat, or a new deadlift PR, My 1 Rep Max gives you the tools to understand your strength and keep improving.
CALCULATE YOUR STRENGTH
• Calculate your 1RM using seven established strength formulas
• Explore training weights based on percentages of your estimated max
• See your estimated rep maxes for 1–10 repetitions
• Work in pounds or kilograms
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Every lift tells part of your story. Save your workouts and build a lasting record of your strength.
• Log your lifts and review your training history
• Identify personal records and all-time highs
• Pin your favorite lifts for quick access
• Share your strength achievements
TAKE YOUR TRAINING FURTHER WITH PREMIUM
Unlock powerful tools to get more from every workout.
• Progress Charts — Visualize your strength gains over time with interactive charts
• Plate Calculator — Quickly figure out which plates to load on your barbell so you can focus on lifting
• RPE Tracking — Record how hard your sets feel and incorporate effort into your strength estimates
• Custom Exercises — Track the lifts that matter most to you
• Extended Calculations — Estimate your 1RM from sets of more than 10 repetitions
ONE-TIME PURCHASE. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
Unlock all Premium features with a single purchase. No recurring fees.
Whether you're checking your numbers between sets or tracking months of progress, My 1 Rep Max makes it easy to see how far you've come—and how much stronger you can become.
A NOTE ABOUT SAFETY
One-rep max calculations are estimates. Accuracy can vary based on training experience, technique, fatigue, and individual physiology.
Attempting a true one-rep maximum involves risk. Always use appropriate safety equipment, have a qualified spotter when necessary, and never attempt a weight you aren't prepared to lift safely.

Whether you’re planning an outdoor activity
bluejetty:00175279:ios.description:
Introducing Wind Compass, the go-to app for tracking and monitoring wind & weather conditions. With Wind Compass, you can easily get the latest and most accurate weather updates for any location.
Whether you’re planning an outdoor activity, checking the weather during a road trip, or simply curious about the conditions outside, Wind Compass is the perfect app to help you stay informed. So why wait? Download Wind Compass today and start getting the weather information you need, right at your fingertips.
Wind Compass can answer important weather-related questions:
 - See what the current wind speed and direction is for your location or destination
 - View sunrise & sunset times so you can catch first light or the perfect sunset
 - Learn what the temperature feels like so you can plan for your day
 - Get the hourly & daily forecast to better plan for outings & travel 
Key Wind Condition Features
 - Get Wind Speed readings in Miles/hour, Kilometers/hour, Knots, Beaufort Wind Force, or Meters Per Second
 - Select Compass Magnetic Declination from True North or Magnetic North
 - Choose Temperature measurement from Fahrenheit or Celsius
 - Select the Arrow direction of the Wind Indicator from Blowing To or Coming From
Top Weather Forecast Features
 - View the Current Temperature and check Estimated Highs and Lows 
 - See Sunrise/Sunset times, plus the "First Light" and "Last light" times for the day (Also known as Nautical Twilight Start and End)
 - 24-Hour & 7-Day Forecast showing Time, Estimated Temperature, Estimated Wind Speed and Direction, and % Chance of Precipitation
Custom Backgrounds 
 - Choose from standard colored backgrounds
 - Add a map showing your current location
 - Select an overlay displaying your rear camera view
 - Pick a color gradient that automatically adjusts from warm to cool based on the temperature of where you are
Wind Compass Pro Features
 - Save Multiple Locations
 - Daily Weather Forecasts
 - Remove Ads
With Wind Compass, you can easily stay up-to-date on the weather conditions around you. As an added bonus, Wind Compass shows you which direction is North so if you are indoors or turned around, you can reorient yourself, as well as check the current wind direction.
Thanks for using Wind Compass! Have questions or feedback? Email us at contact@maplemedia.io for fast & friendly support.

bluejetty:00161396:ios.description:
Tochi: Your All-in-One Mental Health Journal & Mood Tracker App
Tochi is a complete mental health app designed for real-life emotional wellbeing and mental wellness. Whether you need an anxiety journal, a stress journal, or a gratitude journal with guided prompts, Tochi is built for you. From managing depression, bipolar disorder, and ADHD to navigating burnout or daily stress, this is the mental health journal that adapts to your journey.
Effortless Mood Tracker Check-Ins
The Tochi mood tracker makes tracking progress effortless. Simply open the app, pick an emotion, add a trigger, and you’re finished in under a minute. Whether you use it as an emotion log or a gratitude journal, every entry builds the self-awareness necessary for emotional wellbeing. The insights you gain from a consistent mental health journal make lasting mental wellness possible.
CBT Journal Prompts & Guided Reflection
Tochi is a comprehensive mental health journal, not just a basic log. After every mood tracker entry, CBT-inspired guided prompts help you process feelings, manage anxiety, reframe stress, and break unhealthy patterns. By using Tochi as an anxiety journal or a mental health journal for depression and ADHD, you turn raw data into genuine insight. 
Your Anxiety Journal & Stress Companion
This mental health journal uses guided prompts to help you identify triggers, reduce burnout, and manage daily anxiety. Every entry in the mood tracker reveals anxiety journal patterns you might otherwise miss. Track daily stress, log emotions, and watch your emotional wellbeing improve week by week. Tochi also serves as a specialized bipolar mood tracker, surfacing shifts before they escalate.
Gratitude Journal Practice, Built In
Tochi weaves gratitude into your daily mental wellness routine. Add a gratitude note to any mood tracker entry to anchor positive emotions and deepen your mental health journal reflections. Practicing with a gratitude journal is one of the most evidence-backed tools for emotional wellbeing. With Tochi, your gratitude journal practice is effortless.
Powerful Mental Wellness Insights
Every mood tracker entry builds toward deep weekly and monthly mental health summaries. These insights surface the emotional trends hidden within your mental health journal. Tochi translates your data into a clear map of your emotional wellbeing and mental wellness journey.
Your Story, Chapter by Chapter
Tochi transforms your mental health journal into personal "Life Chapters" a guided narrative of your emotional wellbeing. No other mood tracker organizes your growth quite like this. Watch your life evolve, one guided mood tracker entry at a time.
Why Choose Tochi?
- Mood tracker and mental health journal in one seamless app.
- Anxiety journal & stress journal featuring CBT-inspired guided prompts.
- Versatile bipolar mood tracker, ADHD diary, and depression support.
- Advanced emotional wellbeing and mental wellness insights.
- Guided mental health journal check-ins designed for daily growth and emotional clarity.
Terms of Use: https://tochi.lazyhippodev.com/termsandconditions.html
Privacy Policy: https://tochi.lazyhippodev.com/privacy.html
Support Email: hippo@lazyhippodev.com
For personal reflection, not medical care. Tochi is not a medical device and cannot diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent medical conditions. Seek a healthcare professional's advice for medical questions, diagnosis, or treatment.

Speech to Text – Voice Typing
The Ultimate App to Convert Speech into Text with AI-Powered Accuracy
Easily convert voice to text, transcribe audio and video files, and type using your voice with Speech to Text – Voice Typing, your all-in-one transcription and productivity assistant. Whether you need to transcribe interviews, meetings, lectures, voice notes, or videos, our advanced AI ensures fast, accurate, and multilingual transcription – anytime, anywhere.
Why Choose Speech to Text – Voice Typing
• Voice Typing in Real Time
Type with your voice in any situation — emails, notes, messages, or documents. Just speak, and watch your words appear instantly. Perfect for hands-free productivity and accessibility.
• Accurate AI-Powered Transcription
Delivers highly accurate speech-to-text results using advanced artificial intelligence, even in noisy environments or with diverse accents.
• Live Voice-to-Text Transcription
Real-time transcription for meetings, lectures, and conferences. Ideal for note-taking and live captioning.
• Transcribe Audio and Video Files
Upload audio or video from your device or use a link. Supports formats like MP3, WAV, M4A, and more.
• Voice Memo Transcription
Turn voice memos into text in seconds. Great for capturing personal notes or conducting interviews.
• Transcription from URLs
Transcribe audio and video directly from online sources such as YouTube and podcasts.
• Speaker Identification
Automatically distinguishes between speakers for clean, structured transcripts.
• Multi-Language Support and Translation
Transcribe speech in over 90 languages and dialects, and translate non-English audio into English.
• Transcript Editing and Customization
Rename speakers, format text, and prepare transcripts for sharing or publication.
• Export Options
Save transcripts as TXT, PDF, DOCX, or SRT for easy sharing, editing, or subtitle generation.
• Ad-Free Experience
Work without interruptions or distractions.
Use Cases
• Voice-type emails, notes, and documents
• Transcribe meetings and business calls
• Generate subtitles for videos
• Convert lectures and lessons into notes
• Document voice recordings automatically
• Enable live captions for accessibility
• Translate international content
• Save time with hands-free typing and automated transcription
Download Speech to Text – Voice Typing and transform your voice into text — whether you’re typing hands-free or transcribing with AI precision.

Scrivi in tempo reale al programma in onda con la nuova tab “Scrivici” oppure trova gli indirizzi e-mail utili per entrare in contatto con la radio.
L'app Radio Deejay funziona su tutti i dispositivi con sistema operativo iOS14+.

Con la funzione "Rewind" potrai tornare all’inizio della trasmissione e spostarti avanti e indietro lungo lo stream della diretta. Se invece vuoi riascoltare una puntata, potrai accedere all’on-demand all’interno della tab "Reload".

La sezione “Podcast” è dedicata alle serie audio originali di Radio Deejay, con un’offerta ricca di generi diversi e sempre in aggiornamento.

Scrivi in tempo reale al programma in onda con la nuova tab “Scrivici” oppure trova gli indirizzi e-mail utili per entrare in contatto con la radio.

L'app Radio Deejay funziona su tutti i dispositivi con sistema operativo iOS14+.

 
L'app salverà e rispetterà le tue preferenze sulla privacy. Informativa sulla privacy: https://www.deejay.it/corporate/privacy/index.html

bluejetty:00177803:ios.description:
This island needs YOU to become the mayor of the city!
Build a small town, expand to a city, and discover all that this beautiful island sim has to offer!
Sparkling Society Games returns to bring you a fresh city building game experience set in a looney world with a unique theme and style. If you are familiar with our other citybuilders, you know we have the best mobile casual city builder games out there!
In our offline game "Village City - Town Building Sim Game", you are the mayor of your city: use your creativity to design your village and towns on a beautiful island and create your own city set in a fun and looney world. Unlock nearly 200 unique and cool buildings; construct and upgrade them. Keep your citizens happy, create jobs and collect cash from your buildings. Build your own town and expand your cities and skylines in an exotic adventure packed with dozens of quests and rewards.
Key features:
* Collect nearly 200 unique buildings!
* Build your own city in this looney world full of story.
* NO INTERNET REQUIRED!
* Free to play: the game can be played without spending money, but we do offer in-app purchases.
* Casual city sim game for everybody; easy to play city simulation and strategy game.
* Build a town on different types of terrain: grass, beach, water, rock, and more.
* Collect daily rewards and achievements.
Coming soon:
* Fight for glory on the world-wide leaderboard.

bluejetty:00079304:ios.description:
Introducing Tile Aura, the ultimate mahjong triple match puzzle game! Immerse yourself in hours of fun and challenging gameplay as you match tiles to progress through the brainteaser levels. Solve the puzzle and become the ultimate tile master. With its easy-to-learn mechanics and addictive gameplay, Tile Aura is the perfect game for triple match puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.
Play Tile Aura' relaxing puzzle games. As you play the matching games, you'll be tasked with matching three or more tiles of the same color to clear them from the mahjong inspired board. But be careful! The match game levels get progressively harder as you advance, and you'll need to think strategically to overcome obstacles, solve the puzzle, and be the tile master.
- SOLVE THE PUZZLE TO TRAIN YOUR BRAIN - Challenge your brain through thousands of mahjong puzzles. Puzzles start with low difficulty and become challenging fast!
- Create a Calm Experience - Solve addictive yet always evolving tile matching mahjong puzzles in a unique and calm experience.
- Relax and Have Fun - Take your time to solve the puzzles and clear the board. They are simply for your entertainment and will relax your brain.
- Explore - Discover unique and relaxing sceneries that are displayed in the background while you match tiles.
Our new generation mahjong game will have you addicted to solving tile matching puzzles, reaching new levels and becoming the master. There's never a dull moment when you're playing our unique tile-matching puzzle game!
With hundreds of relaxing puzzle game levels to play through, you'll never run out of new tile puzzle challenges to conquer. And with new levels added regularly, you'll always have something new to play.
This game is much harder than it looks and absolutely addictive!

bluejetty:00024655:ios.description:
Our application is the first sports application in Kurdistan Region and Iraq. The application is designed to get details and results of all Kurdistan and Iraqi competitions in both Kurdish and Arabic languages. We aim to provide up to date results to sports fans in parallel with giants leagues across the globe.

bluejetty:00069903:ios.name: Baby Tracker Pro - Newborn Log
bluejetty:00069903:ios.summary: Baby Tracker Pro makes it simple to record feedings, sleep, diaper changes, pumping, growth, health, and milestones—all in one place. Designed by busy parents, for busy parents, it keeps everyday tracking quick, clear, and easy to share wit
bluejetty:00069903:ios.description:
Baby Tracker Pro makes it simple to record feedings, sleep, diaper changes, pumping, growth, health, and milestones—all in one place. Designed by busy parents, for busy parents, it keeps everyday tracking quick, clear, and easy to share with caregivers.
WHAT’S NEXT
One more helpful cue for your baby’s day.
What’s Next uses on-device AI to turn recent activity logs into personalized timing cues. Depending on what you’ve logged, it may show:
• A likely wind-down window before sleep
• An estimated length for the next nap or sleep
• An approximate wake-up window
• An estimated time for the next feed
• A suggested time to check the diaper
Cues can start appearing after just a few logs. Regular, complete logging helps make them more personal to your baby’s developing routine.
What’s Next is optional. You can hide it in Settings → Preferences.
GUIDANCE, NOT A SCHEDULE
Use What’s Next alongside your baby’s own cues and your judgment—not as a fixed schedule or instruction.
What’s Next is not medical advice. Contact a healthcare professional if you have concerns about your baby’s health, sleep, or feeding.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
What’s Next cues are created directly on your device. Your baby’s logs aren’t sent to us to generate them.
FEEDING TRACKER
• Track breastfeeding with an easy nursing timer
• Record which side you last used and time spent on each breast
• Log bottles, formula, expressed milk, and solids
• Record pumping sessions and amounts
• Add notes about preferences, reactions, or other details
SLEEP TRACKER
• Record naps and nighttime sleep
• Use a convenient sleep timer
• Review sleep patterns over time
• Set reminders and alarms
• See personalized What’s Next sleep and wake-up cues
DIAPER TRACKER
• Log wet, dirty, and mixed diapers
• Quickly see when the last diaper change occurred
• Review diaper patterns and share records with caregivers or healthcare professionals
GROWTH, HEALTH, AND DEVELOPMENT
• Track height, weight, and head circumference
• Compare measurements against World Health Organization growth standards
• Record medications, vaccinations, and temperature
• Save important health notes and history
• Capture milestones with photos and journal entries
CHARTS AND REPORTS
• Review activity by day, week, or month
• Recognize patterns across sleep, feeding, and diaper records
• Export records as a PDF
• Email or print reports for caregivers and healthcare professionals
MADE FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• Sync records across multiple devices
• Keep caregivers up to date
• Use Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for quick information
• Track active sessions with Live Activities
• Record and review activities from Apple Watch
• Use Siri Shortcuts for convenient hands-free logging
• Use Quick Log to describe an activity to Siri in your own words. Requires iOS 26 with Apple Intelligence turned on.
BABY TRACKER PLUS
Your existing Pro features remain available without a Plus subscription.
Try What’s Next with a free 3-day preview—no subscription required to start. After the preview, continue with your own Baby Tracker Plus subscription or one shared through your sync group.
Plus adds personalized sleep, feed, and diaper cues. With Group Plus, one Plus subscription unlocks Plus for everyone in your sync group.
Baby Tracker Plus is an auto-renewing subscription. Pricing and renewal terms are shown before you subscribe. You can manage or cancel your subscription in App Store settings.
From late-night feedings to first steps, Baby Tracker Pro helps you spend less time managing records and more time with your baby.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.nighp.com/babytracker/babytracker_pp.html

bluejetty:00035752:ios.description:
Fal baktırmak için birilerini aramanıza gerek kalmadı. Kahve falı baktırmak için, en büyük sanal eğlenceniz, Fal Cafe her an yanınızda. 
Kahvenizi keyifle için ve fincanınızı çevirip biraz bekleyin. Sonra fotoğraflarını çekip bize gönderin. Sizler için yorumlayalım.
Birbirinden değerli falcılarımız, her fincanı dikkatle inceliyor, size özel yorumları uzun uzun yapıyor. 
Ayrıca dilerseniz fallarınızı sesli olarak yorumluyoruz.
Bu nedenle falların cevaplanma süresi 10 dakika ile yarım saat arası bir zamanı bulabiliyor. Yoğun ilginiz ve sabrınız için teşekkür ederiz.
Niyet Falı ile beklemeden falını okuyabilirsin. Niyetini seç ve falını hemen oku!
Özellikler:
* Sesli Fal ile fallarını sesli olarak baktırabilirsiniz.
* Yorum için fotoğrafları hem albümden hem de kameradan doğrudan gönderebilirsiniz.
* Yorumlanmış fallarınız gelen kutusunda saklanır.
* Yorum bekleyen fallarınızı takip edebilirsiniz.
* Her saat başı bedava krediler dağıtılır
* Günlük ücretsiz fal baktırabilirsiniz.
* Karakter özelliklerinizi bir kez tanımlamanız yeterlidir.
* Günün her saatinde fal baktırabilirsiniz.
* Yorumcularımızın size gönderdiği yorumları beğenebilirsiniz.
* Niyet Falı ile beklemeden falını oku.
Kullanım Şartları: https://falcafe.mstapps.com/tos.html

bluejetty:00129437:ios.name: VocaLive CS
bluejetty:00129437:ios.summary: VocaLive provides singers and vocalists with a suite of 12 real-time professional vocal effects, along with a range of tools to help you practice, sing and record. The effects can be combined into a chain of 4 processors and saved as preset
bluejetty:00129437:ios.description:
VocaLive provides singers and vocalists with a suite of 12 real-time professional vocal effects, along with a range of tools to help you practice, sing and record. The effects can be combined into a chain of 4 processors and saved as presets. A collection of 55 presets is included to get you up and running immediately. 
VocaLive CS for iPhone comes with the Reverb effect, and upon registration the Double effect is unlocked. You can add 10 additional effects à la carte from a selection that includes Pitch Fix (for tuning or stylized FX), Choir, Morph, De-Esser, Delay, Parametric EQ, Compressor, Chorus, Phazer and Envelope Filter. Together these effects provide unparalleled creative processing power.
With VocaLive you can process your voice, sing along to any song in your iTunes Music library — its Voice Cancel feature lets you remove existing vocals — and warm up with helpful vocal warm-up tools. 
Use the new 2-track recorder to sing over backing tracks, or expand the studio section (available via in-app purchase) to record whole songs. 
With the optional Mic Room feature, VocaLive also gives you the sound and color of 20 classic and modern studio microphone emulations, for even more control over your vocal tone.
Ready to perform? VocaLive’s new Live Mode offers an optimized GUI specifically for live use. See your entire chain at a glance, with all the settings and controls you need in an easy-to-read format designed for the stage. Plus VocaLive offers an optional 4-track looper to easily create songs, harmonies and more on the fly.
For best quality, use VocaLive with IK’s iRig Mic range of microphones, from handheld to studio condenser mic. Or connect your favorite 3rd party mic using our iRig Pre interfaces. But you can also have fun with it and record quick ideas using the built-in microphone on your iPhone or earbuds.
Control your virtual rig just as easily as you would a traditional vocal multiFX with new iRig Stomp I/O integration, so you can change presets, control effects and more right from your feet. Or go wireless with iRig Blueboard, a wireless Bluetooth controller for basic control on the go.
VocaLive also supports Core Audio and Core MIDI so you can use any compatible third-party interface or MIDI controller, and Audiobus and Inter-App Audio compatible, letting you use it alongside your favorite recording or songwriting apps.
VocaLive CS for iPhone features: 
• Real time vocal processor + recording app 
• 4-processor vocal effects chain 
• 12 professional studio-quality effects available - 2 included
• Mic Room microphone with 20 classic and modern studio mic emulations*
• Includes metronome and vocal warm-up tools
• 4-track looper section*
• 2-track recorder (expandable to a full 8-track recording studio*)
• Import and play songs directly from your Music library or computer 
• Voice Cancel lets you create sing-along backing tracks by removing the vocal track from existing recordings 
• Simultaneous multi-track recording 
• Studio section (included with Recorder) with waveform visualization and editing, touch-and-drag looping, normalization, punch-in/punch-out recording, simultaneous multi-track recording support and more
• AutoFreeze (allows each track to have its own full effects chain)
• Live Mode shows you your entire rig at a glance, with all the parameters you need on stage easily accessible 
• 55 presets included with 4 Favorites for fast recall 
• MIDI controllable and with built-in integration for iRig Stomp I/O, iRig Blueboard and other controllers
• Audiobus & Inter-App Audio support
• Full version available
* available via in-app purchase
IMPORTANT: AmpliTube users can add the effects processors from VocaLive to their AmpliTube app using the “Restore my purchases” option in the in-app menu. 
For more information: 
www.ikmultimedia.com/vocaliveiphone
Accessories information:
www.ikmultimedia.com

Supports multiple functions such as shift schedules, holidays, specific dates, and time reporting, meeting various needs in work and daily life:
● Common Alarm Clock: 
Flexibly adapts to official holidays, while supporting personalized scheduling for overtime days and leaves.
● Shift Alarm Clock: 
A boon for shift workers, requiring just one alarm to handle rotating schedules effortlessly.
● Specific Date Alarm Clock: 
Set reminders for specific dates, whether it's for snagging limited-time deals or renewing your driver's license.
● Monthly Alarm Clock: 
Set it once and get monthly reminders for tasks like credit card payments, rent, and more – even on specific weekdays of the month.
● Yearly Alarm Clock: 
Customized alerts for birthdays and anniversaries, ensuring you never miss those significant moments.

◆Time Announcements: iOS 13 and above users can tailor time announcements, keeping you aware of every passing moment.

bluejetty:00127617:ios.summary:

Do you often plan ambitious goals, only to give up later? Have you tried repeatedly to introduce healthy habits into your life, but stop working on yoursel
bluejetty:00127617:ios.description:
Creating healthy habits is easy! Improve yourself with the help of a habit tracker.
Do you often plan ambitious goals, only to give up later? Have you tried repeatedly to introduce healthy habits into your life, but stop working on yourself after only a few days? Now, you can change your life for the better with the help of a habit tracker.
CREATE YOUR FIRST HABIT 
Hooray! You've taken your first step towards change. Create your first habit. Choose any of the ready-made habits or add your own. It's easy: just think of a title, add a motivational phrase, and start moving towards your new life! 
KEEP TRACK OF YOUR PROGRESS
Open your habit card and check your streak to keep track of how well you're doing. There's also a calendar that shows you the days you've missed. 
MAKE PLANS, TAKE STOCK
Set up morning notifications to get your habit plan at the beginning of the day. This will keep you on track and motivated. Evening reminders will help you summarize the day's completed habits.
You can also choose a dark theme for the app. Invite your friends to form healthy habits together.
PREMIUM FEATURES
— Unlimited reminders and repetitions during the day, as well as a daily schedule. Customize your habit to suit your needs and daily routine.
— View detailed statistics about all your habits, such as your current and best habit streak, how many days you've successfully completed your planned habits, and your total number of completed habits.
— A calendar in your stats helps you identify your most and least productive days. Switch between different months and track your progression. 
Install the app now and change your life for the better.
The app offers an auto-renewing subscription to provide you with unlimited access to all features as long as you maintain an active subscription. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be shown. You can manage your subscription and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms & Conditions: https://calledandrey.github.io/habitapp/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://calledandrey.github.io/habitapp/privacy.html
If you have any feedback please contact us via email: habitappnet@gmail.com. We will get back to you immediately

bluejetty:00060702:ios.name: iComics
bluejetty:00060702:ios.summary:
iComics® is a Universal app designed for iPad, iPhone and iPod touch that allows you to read DRM-free comics from your own collection, quickly and smoothly! 
"Highly customizable and polished" -The Best Apps for Reading Comics on Your iP
bluejetty:00060702:ios.description:
iComics® is a Universal app designed for iPad, iPhone and iPod touch that allows you to read DRM-free comics from your own collection, quickly and smoothly! 
"Highly customizable and polished" -The Best Apps for Reading Comics on Your iPad, MakeUseOf, 2015
"Attractively designed" -Best Comic File Readers, AppAdvice, 2015
Supporting all of the major comic formats, iComics makes it extremely easy to import comic files onto your iOS device and start reading them straight away! 
-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
Features 
* Supports all of the major comic formats (ZIP, CBZ, RAR, CBR, 7ZIP, CB7, TAR, CBT, LZH, LHA, EPUB, PDF). 
* Collections for organizing sets of comics.
* Hot jumping directly from one comic to the next.
* Super smooth scrolling when turning pages. 
* Comics can be imported from your PC via iTunes, or from other apps on your iOS device (Such as Dropbox, or Safari). 
* Comic files are never modified or destroyed (So you can get them back off your device whenever you want!) 
* A slider that lets you jump between comic pages quickly. 
* Comics can be read from left-to-right, or right-to-left (Great for Eastern comics) 
* Page zooming can be set to reset every time a page is turned, or locked to the same scale across all pages. 
* Extra wide comic pages can be split up and treated as two separate pages. 
* Many sharing settings including being able to email, print or locally save individual pages! 
-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=- 
System Requirements 
iComics requires iOS 9.0 or higher 
Supported hardware includes: 
* iPad (2 and above) 
* iPhone (4 and above) 
* iPod touch (5th Gen) 
-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
Follow 'iComicsApp' on Twitter, Instagram or Facebook for updates!

The FiGPiN App is the beginning of an amazing collector experience.
Every FiGPiN ever manufactured has a unique Serial Number laser engraved on the back. With the FiGPiN App you can unlock that serial number to discover the rarity of your FiGPiN (The Factory Score) and begin earning points as a proud owner of an awesome FiGPiN (The Story Score).
You can also browse the entire FiGPiN Catalog and build your ultimate Dream Collection. Be the first to see new FiGPiNs before they are released. Gain access to rare App Exclusive pins.
Collect Awesome!
What’s New
In this new major update you can now manage your collection with shelves. Name and organize your shelves to fit your collection’s needs. You can make your individual shelves publicly visible or private. When another user in the App touches your Avatar icon, they will be able to see all your visible shelves.
***
When you unlock your FiGPiN you will see a FACTORY SCORE and a STORY SCORE.
The Factory Score is made up of three facets and has a total max value of 100 points. The three facets are:
EDITION – FiGPiNs made in one production run belong to an Edition (max 20 points).
VOLUME – The number of FiGPiNs that are manufactured in one production run (max 20 points).
SEQUENCE – The order in which your individual FiGPiN was made during manufacturing. (max 60 points).
The Story Score is an exciting new way to go beyond your shelf or pinboard. You can earn points for sharing your FiGPiN’s journey in your collection. Here are some ways to earn Story Score points:
ADOPTER - Be one of the first to adopt your FiGPiN and earn a maximum of 100 points.
BOOSTS - Earn points every time someone in the FiGPiN community boosts your FiGPiN.
ARENAS - Earn points by comparing the uniqueness of your FiGPiN’S serial number with others.
SHARES (coming soon) - Earn points by showing off your FiGPiNs to the world.
CHECK-INS (coming soon) - Earn points by taking your FiGPiNs to your favorite CON or show and checking them in.
TAGS (coming soon) - Earn points by having your friends, artists or celebs sign and tag your FiGPiNs.
BONUSES (coming soon) - Earn points by discovering the MANY Easter Eggs that we’ve dropped throughout the FiGPiN Universe.

bluejetty:00119863:ios.description:
O SuperApp educacional mais usado de todo o Brasil. 
Com a Agenda Edu a escola tem uma solução que reúne em um só lugar: comunicação em tempo real, gestão de atendimento, engajamento escolar e pagamentos digitais. 
Tudo para tornar as jornadas educacionais, tanto da equipe escolar, quanto das famílias e alunos, mais simples e intuitiva. 
Importante: Nosso aplicativo funciona somente para as escolas que adquirirem a agenda digital. Então, se sua escola ainda não utiliza a Agenda Edu, acesse nosso site e cadastre-se.
Como funciona?
A escola envia comunicados, eventos, atividades, diários de classe, fotos e muito mais para as famílias, que acompanham tudo direto da tela do celular.
Além disso, por meio do app os responsáveis podem ter atendimento em tempo real com as escolas, solucionando demandas de forma completamente digital, onde e quando precisarem.
Também usando o SuperApp as famílias podem realizar a matrícula e pagamentos de mensalidades direto no celular, por PIX, boleto e cartão de crédito, tudo com segurança jurídica e de transações. Além de aproveitar a comodidade de comprar os produtos escolares direto no app, com as melhores taxas do mercado educacional.
Caso tenha alguma dúvida ou sugestão, nos envie um e-mail para suporte@agendaedu.com
Siga nossas redes sociais e acesse nosso blog:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/agendaedu/ 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/agendaedu/ 
Blog: https://jornadaedu.com.br/

bluejetty:00044940:ios.description:
If you’re a JEA MyWay customer and want to manage your prepaid utilities account,
search for “JEA MyWay” in your app store to download that app.
My JEA makes it easier to do business with JEA and so much more. Whether you need
to view and pay your bill, check your utility consumption, report electric and water
outages, update your account information, or get help from our Customer Solutions
team, My JEA helps you get it done so you can get on with your day.
Easy Login: Sign in with the same credentials you use for your jea.com account. Don’t
have an account? It’s easy to set one up, right on the app.
View and Pay Your Bill: View your actual PDF bill and download if you need it. Pay your
way with a bank account, debit/credit card, or mobile wallet.
Check Your Consumption: View a graph of your electric and water usage with a
temperature overlay. View full screen in landscape mode for even more detail.
Sign Up for eBill Paperless Billing: You’re already going paperless with My JEA. Take
the next step by signing up for eBill, right from your account profile.
Request Payment Assistance: Need a little extra time to make a payment? Request a
payment extension or payment arrangement and get an instant answer.
Report Outages: View our Electric Outage Map in full screen mode. Report electric and
water outages and get updates on restoration progress.
Get Assistance: A single click will connect you by phone to JEA support. You can also
get directions to our Customer Solutions Center and make an appointment online for
faster service when you arrive.
Update Your Contact Info: Need to update your billing address, email or phone
number? Easily update your account profile inside the app.
Future Enhancements: Be on the lookout for new features with your convenience in
mind.

bluejetty:00071295:ios.name: AuditBricks: Site Audit Report
bluejetty:00071295:ios.summary: AuditBricks turns site walkthroughs into professional inspection reports. Capture punch list items, defects, and safety issues with photos, mark them up, assign them to subcontractors, and send a branded PDF or Excel report before you leave
bluejetty:00071295:ios.description:
AuditBricks turns site walkthroughs into professional inspection reports. Capture punch list items, defects, and safety issues with photos, mark them up, assign them to subcontractors, and send a branded PDF or Excel report before you leave the site. No internet needed.
Built for general contractors, superintendents, inspectors, engineers, property managers, and facility teams.
CAPTURE FAST
• Quick Capture: keep the camera open, shoot every item on your walkthrough, and add them all as issues at once
• Voice-to-issue: describe the problem out loud and AuditBricks fills in the title, description, and fix-by date
• Attach multiple photos to each issue, or import photos from your library as bulk issues
• Import issues from a CSV file
• "Save & Add New" for fast, continuous logging
PHOTO MARKUP
• Arrows, lines, rectangles, circles, pen, highlighter, and text
• Tick, cross, warning, and numbered markers to call out each item
• Blur faces, license plates, and other sensitive details
• Choose colors and line thickness so every markup is easy to read
TRACK TO CLOSEOUT
• Assign items to subcontractors, trades, or team members
• Set status, priority, and fix-by dates, and get reminders when items are due
• Filter issues by status, assignee, and more
• Pick lists for titles, descriptions, assignees, and statuses keep entries consistent across every job
PROFESSIONAL REPORTS
• Generate PDF and Excel reports in seconds
• Add your company logo, inspector name, and signature
• Choose your date format, photo size, and the fields to include
• Large reports are split into smaller files so they're easy to email
SHARE & TEAMWORK
• Send reports by email, Messages, AirDrop, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, or any app in the share sheet
• Share a whole project with your team and combine their findings into one report
• Back up and restore all your data
WORKS ANYWHERE
• Fully offline, so it works in basements, new construction, and remote sites
• Unlimited projects and unlimited issues
• Available in 50 languages
USE IT FOR
• Punch lists and construction closeout
• Building and home inspections
• Quality control and QA/QC walkthroughs
• Safety inspections and hazard logs
• Defect tracking and warranty items
• Property condition surveys and maintenance checks
Questions or feedback? Email support@appculus.com or visit www.auditbricks.com.

bluejetty:00133507:ios.description:
This is a powerful metadata tool for your photos and videos. You can easily view, edit, and remove exif metadata, including date, time, gps location, camera model, aperture, author and so on.It's very useful for professional photographers to manage the Exif data of their photo&videos.
Features in APP:
View Exif metadata
- View location data
- View more than 60+ metadata tags like ISO, shutter speed, focal length,camera model, lens model, time stamp, aperture, shutter count,file name and a lot more.
Edit Exif metadata
- Edit GPS location data.You can search the map to add location or long press to put a pin on the map.
- Support standard and satellite map
- Edit all the exif metadata,such as data, time, author, title, description,comment,keywords, copyright, camera maker, camera model, camera lens maker, camera lens model, aperture, exposure time, software
Remove Exif metadata
- Remove all exif metadate
- Remove GPS location
Bulk edit photo Exif metadata
- Edit or remove Exif metadata of multiple photos at once
- Edit or remove GPS location data of multiple photos at once
Works with
- All of your iOS devices(iPhone, iPad,iPod Touch)
- All photos&videos in your phone camera roll, iCloud photo library and photo stream
- Support Sony, Nikon, Fuji, Canon and other camera photo formats
- Support image formats(JPG,PNG,TIFF,HEIC) and RAW formats(CR2,NEF,DNG)
Others
- Ability to copy photo Exif data to clipboard
- Support Grid view and List view
- Support for deleting the photos&videos directly in the app
- Support for reverting to original image after wrong edit
- Support direct browsing and sharing from the system album
- Ability to share photos&videos with or without Exif metadata
- Support dark mode
- Support template saving and importing
- Support filtering photos based on whether there is location information
- Support showing and sharing photo assets

bluejetty:00153064:ios.summary:
When you hand your child a screen, you want it to mean something.

Your child's first
bluejetty:00153064:ios.description:
When you hand your child a screen, you want it to mean something.
Most cooking games are built around pressure — timers, scoring, failure. FF3 is built around the opposite: a real cooking experience, without the anxiety.
Your child's first real kitchen
From the first tap, your child is already cooking. Kneading pizza dough. Grilling a burger. Building a hot dog. Folding a taco. Every recipe follows authentic culinary logic — developed with professional chefs and adapted so children can follow independently.
They're not tapping randomly. They're discovering how food is actually made — one step at a time, with growing confidence.
Real actions. Real understanding.
Every action mirrors a real kitchen — chop, mix, assemble, cook. Steps teach sequencing. Hands learn to move with purpose. And because there's no timer counting down, no score to chase, no wrong answer — the focus grows quietly, on its own.
This is why children come back. Not because they're told to. Because finishing a recipe feels genuinely satisfying.
Calm you can trust
No timers. No scoring. No fail states. Your child moves at their own pace, repeats any step freely, experiments without pressure. The learning happens quietly — because there's no anxiety attached to getting it wrong.
Designed for children ages 3 to 9 — intuitive enough for a toddler, engaging enough to grow with them. New kitchens, new ingredients, new techniques added regularly — always something new to explore, always the same calm experience.
From screen to kitchen
The recipes in FF3 are real. Real enough to try at home, together. What starts as play can become a Saturday morning in the kitchen — a child who wants to help because they already know the steps.
The game doesn't replace that experience. It opens the door to it.
→ No personal data collected
→ Works offline — no WiFi needed
→ No external links or in-app pressure
Built by a team with 15 years of experience in children's digital content.
Your child's first real kitchen is one tap away.

Scan all QR code, barcodes and documents!
Features:
* All-in-one scanner: scans all standard 1D and 2D code types
* Documents scanner: scans any paper document
* History of scanned QR & barcodes, documents
* Rapid scan
* Internet connection is not required for scanning
* Flashlight supported: supports scanning even in the dark
* Scan history saved

Scanner decodes information from 2-D codes such as:
* WiFi with ability to join network
* email (matmsg, mailto, smtp): send email
* phone number (tel, sms, smsto): call or send sms
* GEO location: show location on map or open in Apple Maps or Google Maps
* Link: open inside the app, open in browsers
* Contact (VCard): create new contact or update existing one 
A must-have app in your iPhone & iPad!
Download now!

Mornings are tough. But they don’t have to be! Enter Yoga Wake Up, the first-ever Yoga Alarm Clock that teaches you to wake up and fall asleep the right way — with audio-guided yoga, meditation, and stretching. Yoga Wake Up features hundreds of sessions and dedicated series to teach you how to build habits to transform your morning and bedtime routine, resulting in your best days yet. With Yoga Wake Up, wellness is made simple from sun up to sun down. 
Try it for free! Or subscribe and get: 
The First-Ever Yoga Alarm Clock: Finally, an alarm clock that aligns with your wellness goals. Select your preferred session and wake-up time, and let our gentle alarm seamlessly transition into a revitalizing yoga practice or invigorating meditation.
Morning Series: Two morning yoga series designed to teach you how to wake up — with yoga! The best part? Your first series is always FREE.
A Consistent Routine: Get daily reminders to squeeze in a meditation or yoga practice whenever works best for your schedule. Plus, use our Widgets to add an extra dose of inspiration and motivation. 
Highly Rated Instructors At Your Fingertips: Our passionate and diverse community of certified yoga instructors is here to put your mind at ease and feed your flow.
Content for Every Part of Your Day: Whether you’re a morning person, live for an afternoon mindset break, or prefer to meditate at night, our meditation and yoga content is curated with you in mind. 
Yoga in Bed: Yes, really! Whether you want to hop to the mat the moment you open your eyes or relax with bedtime yoga, with the largest selection of bed yoga sessions in the wellness-sphere, we bring more “Namas-tay in bed” to your day.
Meditate With Us To:
Sleep more soundly
Reduce stress and anxiety
Improve your mental health, mood, and mindset 
Increase your focus and concentration
Practice Yoga With Us To:
Start your morning right 
Get your heart pumping and blood flowing 
Begin your day with movement
Learn that yoga is for anybody and everybody!

“Why wake up to the intensity of an alarm when you can start your day with the sound of nature and easy-to-follow meditation routines?” – NY Mag’s The Cut

bluejetty:00123579:ios.description:
Save money by rescuing goods from your favourite shops. ResQ Club is a service that connects users with local restaurants, cafés, grocery stores, and florists offering surplus food and flowers at discounted prices. These items are still of good quality but would otherwise go to waste. 
Getting Started:
1. Download the App.
2. Browse Offers: Explore available deals on a map or in a list format.
3. Make a Purchase: Select the items you wish to rescue and pay securely through the app.
4. Pick Up Your Order: Collect your items from the venue within the specified pickup time.
By using ResQ, you contribute to reducing food and flower waste, support local businesses, and enjoy quality products at lower prices. 
Get the most out of the ResQ Club app:
1. Mark your favourite venues for effortless browsing and get notified of their latest offers.
2. Enable notifications for the ResQ app so you never miss deals near you.
3. Look for the Best of ResQ symbol – these partners are top-rated by our community!
More about ResQ Club:
Website: https://resq-club.com/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/resqclub/
We would love to hear your feedback! If you need help or have suggestions, email us at info@resq-club.com.

bluejetty:00131887:ios.description:
Apple iPhone App of the Year, 2019
Introducing Spectre, from the makers of Halide, one of the top camera apps in the App Store.
Spectre uses AI to help you make amazing long exposure photographs. Spectre can remove crowds, turn city streets into rivers of light, make waterfalls look like paintings, and much more. Until now, it was difficult to take long exposures: from keeping the camera steady to guessing the amount of light you need. Spectre takes care of all of that!
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• MAKE CROWDS DISAPPEAR: Spectre helps take photos of crowded, touristy places. Simply set a medium or long duration and take a shot to erase the crowd from a location. Capture the those special moments like you remember them.
• RIVERS OF LIGHT: At night, AI scene detection automatically switches modes to draw beautiful light trails, for stunning nighttime city photography or light painting.
• GORGEOUS WATER: Capture waterfalls, ocean waves, fountains and more with beautiful ghostly water. 
LIVE PHOTOS AND VIDEO
Spectre’s intelligent computational shutter takes hundreds of shots over the span of a few seconds, and saves them in an accompanying live photo. That means you can pick a different frame as your photo, apply live-photo effects, and even use the long exposure as a live-wallpaper!
ENDLESS SMARTS
Spectre is a packed with powerful technology from by the team that brought you Halide.
From machine learning-based scene detection to computer vision aided image stabilization, Spectre is jammed full of impressive technologies to get the best possible image.
DESIGNED FOR HUMANS
Spectre is meticulously designed. Its dark UI is gentle on the eyes when you shoot at night. Gorgeous glowing highlights infuse it with a unique style. Custom typefaces and iconography combined with unique, smooth controls make it as tactile and delightful as an actual physical camera. Like its sister app Halide, the app is easily usable with one hand, even on the largest iPhones.
HIGH-TECH SHOWCASE 
Build with the latest tech, Spectre isn't just a long exposure camera — it’s the cutting edge technology showcase of one of the App Store’s foremost camera apps, Halide. Here’s just a few of the latest technologies that we use in Spectre:
- DCI-P3 Wide Color Pipeline
- Live Photos
- Metal Graphics Acceleration
- Tripod Detection
- Siri & Shortcuts
- AI Stabilization
- Machine Learning & CoreML
- Computer Vision
COMPATIBILITY:
Spectre’s smart Automatic Scene Detection requires iOS 12. AI-based stabilization features are available on iPhone 6S and later.* For the best experience, we recommend iPhone 8 or later.
On iPhone 6, Spectre captures in lower resolution. 
ABOUT US 
We’re Ben and Sebastiaan, two friends living in the San Francisco Bay Area that love building fantastic apps for photography. 
We hope you love Spectre! We’d love your feedback to make it even better or any reports of bugs you run into. You can always contact us directly via email: support@halide.cam, on our Twitter: @halidecamera or Instagram: @halideapp
Don’t forget to share your amazing results by tagging them with #SpectreShot so we can share them on our growing social media accounts!

- normal

- terrain

bluejetty:00000597:android.description:
"RTHK TV"’s functions include:
1) Live Webcast: You can watch RTHK TV live webcast on the internet.
2) VoD and download: "RTHK TV" offers a video-on-demand (VoD) feature that allows you to watch our RTHK TV 31 and TV 32 programmes any time you like. You may also use the download function to pre-load our programmes to 'My Downloads' in the app for subsequent watching. Archive service will be available for programmes broadcast in the past 12 months, subject to copyright restrictions. RTHK reserves the right to make the final decision.
3) Programme Subscription: Simply click on the function, and you can have all your favourite programmes subscribed and stored in the 'My Subscriptions' column.
4) Add Favourite: By clicking the "Add Favourite" button, users can save the episode to "My Favourites", making it easy for users to enjoy their favourite content.
5) Search: You can find info on RTHK TV programmes on "RTHK TV" easily.
6) Social Media: "RTHK TV" offers a sharing function for sharing your favourite RTHK TV programmes with your friends via social media.
Our support team can be contacted at any time if you have any problems. Just send an email with a detailed description of the issue. 
Email: webmaster@rthk.hk
Archive service will be available for programmes broadcast in the past 12 months, subject to copyright restrictions. RTHK reserves the right to make the final decision.
Web Accessibility Conformance Statement:
We have incorporated appropriate accessibility features in this app., if you encounter difficulties in using this app., please contact us via email, at webmaster@rthk.hk.
This app version runs smoothly on Android 6.0 or above. However, please note the operation systems listed below are not official Android Systems, which may have compatibility issues with "RTHK Screen" and the app's functionality cannot be guaranteed: 
Huawei / Vivo / Xiaomi / MIUI / Meizu / OnePlus / Flyme / Aliyun / OMS / Blackberry BB10 / ZTE

bluejetty:00188049:ios.name: AppSheet
bluejetty:00188049:ios.summary: With AppSheet, you can create and distribute your own custom mobile apps without writing code or hiring developers. These apps can display content, take notes, create forms, capture photos, signatures and GPS, scan bar codes, and generate w
bluejetty:00188049:ios.description:
With AppSheet, you can create and distribute your own custom mobile apps without writing code or hiring developers. These apps can display content, take notes, create forms, capture photos, signatures and GPS, scan bar codes, and generate workflows for a wide variety of business scenarios. You can also build web apps and chatbots.
AppSheet uses data from your cloud storage -- Google Sheets, Excel on Office365, Dropbox or Box, Smartsheet, SalesForce, and a variety of databases (SQLServer, mySQL, Postgres, and DynamoDB). You can create an app in minutes and enhance it to create rich custom apps for your team, business, or enterprise. Check review sites like Capterra to learn how AppSheet’s modern technology platform outpaces older low-code solutions like PowerApps, Salesforce1, and App Maker. 
AppSheet is an ideal solution for many business, including those in property management, agriculture, supply chain, operations, salesforce management, education and more. Here are just a few scenarios:
WORKING WITH REMOTE TEAMS
Apps built with AppSheet can help a remote team work with centralized data saved in spreadsheets (eg: in Google Drive, Box, or Droppox) or SQL databases. 
PROJECT MANAGEMENT
Millions of people manage projects using Google Sheets, Excel, and Smartsheets. Project managers can build apps with AppSheet to display and share project data through a mobile device with other team members and stakeholders. Keep data centralized in a core spreadsheet and share only the parts that their audience needs to see. No more managing dozens of files that go back and forth via email!
EDUCATION
Manage study plans, school rosters, grading, and group work by creating a custom app with charts, maps, text summaries and image galleries. Share the app securely with students and colleagues.
CUSTOMER SUPPORT AND ENGAGEMENT:
Keep track of your customer pipeline on a Google Sheet but get the benefits of a streamlined custom mobile app using AppSheet. You can also interact with your data in new ways like building maps from your data, calling or messaging to telephone numbers, sending emails to contacts, and building catalogs using image galleries.

bluejetty:00041734:ios.description:
Welcome to BestLevel! This is the essential app for clients working with trainers or sport clubs using the BestLevel platform. Access your personalized training plans, track your progress, and stay connected with your coach, all in one place.
Your fitness journey is personal, and BestLevel is here to support every step.
Key Features for Clients:
- **Access Your Training Plans:** View the workout programs assigned by your trainer, complete with exercises, detailed instructions, sets, reps, rest times, and more.
- **Exercise Library:** Find detailed information and potentially video demonstrations for each exercise in your plan (mention videos if your app supports them).
- **Log Your Workouts:** Easily record completed sets, reps, weights, and notes after each session to keep a detailed history of your performance.
- **Track Your Progress:** Monitor your improvements over time with personal metrics, progress photos, and performance charts (if applicable). See how far you've come!
- **Communicate with Your Trainer:** Send messages directly to your coach for questions, feedback, or support (if applicable, mention this).
- **View Events & Schedules:** Stay informed about upcoming training sessions, classes, or events scheduled by your club or trainer.
- **Stay Motivated:** Have your entire plan and progress history at your fingertips to keep you on track and motivated.
BestLevel makes it easy to follow your plan, stay accountable, and achieve your fitness goals with the guidance of your trainer.
Download BestLevel and take control of your fitness!

bluejetty:00042424:ios.summary: Find immediate customized peer support by connecting anonymously with someone who understands your pain. WhiteFlag is a peer support app that connects people who are struggling with mental health and addiction issues with others who have be
bluejetty:00042424:ios.description:
Find immediate customized peer support by connecting anonymously with someone who understands your pain. WhiteFlag is a peer support app that connects people who are struggling with mental health and addiction issues with others who have been there too. 
WhiteFlag is changing the way people in pain communicate and heal. It’s free for users, and it always will be – no judgment, just real people helping people heal.
Finding support doesn't have to be hard. WhiteFlag offers a safe space where you will find acceptance, connection, and understanding among peers.
You’re not alone! And you never have to feel that way again.
Start healing today by selecting exactly what you are going through (depression, substance use disorder, loneliness, or suicide of loved one, for example.) Once you’ve chosen the filters that coincide with your life, simply Raise your WhiteFlag and receive immediate support from those who have personal experience with your struggles.
Also, are you the type of person who wants to help others but don’t know who needs it and where to find them? WhiteFlag is for you. Give support to those who are struggling with mental health and addiction issues in real-time, when they need it the most. 
The WhiteFlag movement is dedicated to:
Acceptance – No judgment, just real people helping people in pain.
Connection – You are not alone. We help you connect with people who understand your pain.
Support – Get help and give help. Immediately. Anonymously. Free.
Healing – Don't give up. WhiteFlag is a safe space where it's okay to not be okay.
Download the WhiteFlag App today!

bluejetty:00121364:ios.description:
Never lose track of your games again. GameTrack helps you organise your entire game library, manage your backlog, keep a diary of everything you play, and discover what to play next — like Letterboxd, but for games.
TRACK YOUR COLLECTION
• Add games from a database of 250,000+ titles across 40+ platforms
• Mark games as Playing, Queued, Completed, Shelved, Dropped, or Wanted
• Own a game on several platforms at once, physical, digital, or cloud
• Rate games in half stars and write reviews, with spoiler warnings
• Browse your library by platform, genre, series, tag, or account
KEEP A PLAY DIARY
• Play sessions are detected from your real playtime and logged to your diary
• Time sessions with a Live Activity, from Control Center, or on Apple Watch
• Add notes and tags to every session and see each day's play at a glance
• Keep your streak going, with an activity grid and shareable streak cards
• Track every playthrough, New Game+ included, against Time to Beat
CONNECT YOUR ACCOUNTS
• Link PlayStation, Xbox, Steam, Nintendo, Epic Games, GOG, and RetroAchievements
• Your libraries sync automatically, with wishlists, playtime, trophies, and achievements wherever the store shares them
• Trophies and achievements from every platform in one place, with rarity and recent unlocks
• Share your rarest unlocks as achievement cards
NEVER PAY FULL PRICE
• Deals across PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, and PC, ranked by what players want
• Spot lowest-ever prices and see when each sale ends
• See which wishlist games are on sale and set price alerts
DISCOVER & EXPLORE
• Trending games, new releases, critics' picks, and upcoming games in one place
• Personalised recommendations with a match score
• Explore every game in a series and see which ones you're missing
• Follow gaming events with countdowns, reminders, and replays
• Critic scores, player reviews, and Time to Beat estimates
JOIN THE COMMUNITY
• Follow friends and see what they're playing in your activity feed
• Race through backlogs, play along, or hunt trophies together in group challenges
• Build lists and game grids, and save lists other players share
• Show off your games, reviews, and achievements on your profile, alongside your stats and year in review
EVERYWHERE YOU PLAY
• Your library syncs across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro
• Apple Watch app with Now Playing, Up Next, and a Smart Stack widget
• Home Screen widgets, Live Activities, Control Center, and the Action button
• Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight, and Apple Intelligence
• A split game page on folding iPhones
GameTrack is free to download. GameTrack+ unlocks unlimited lists, game grids, tags, price alerts, Year in Review, your profile showcase, themes and app icons, and more.
GameTrack+ Subscription Terms
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase. Your GameTrack+ membership renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. To manage your membership or turn off auto-renew, go to Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://gametrack.app/privacypolicy/

listings.name: GameTrack
listings.description:
Never lose track of your games again. GameTrack helps you organise your entire game library, manage your backlog, keep a diary of everything you play, and discover what to play next — like Letterboxd, but for games.

TRACK YOUR COLLECTION
• Add games from a database of 250,000+ titles across 40+ platforms
• Mark games as Playing, Queued, Completed, Shelved, Dropped, or Wanted
• Own a game on several platforms at once, physical, digital, or cloud
• Rate games in half stars and write reviews, with spoiler warnings
• Browse your library by platform, genre, series, tag, or account

KEEP A PLAY DIARY
• Play sessions are detected from your real playtime and logged to your diary
• Time sessions with a Live Activity, from Control Center, or on Apple Watch
• Add notes and tags to every session and see each day's play at a glance
• Keep your streak going, with an activity grid and shareable streak cards
• Track every playthrough, New Game+ included, against Time to Beat

CONNECT YOUR ACCOUNTS
• Link PlayStation, Xbox, Steam, Nintendo, Epic Games, GOG, and RetroAchievements
• Your libraries sync automatically, with wishlists, playtime, trophies, and achievements wherever the store shares them
• Trophies and achievements from every platform in one place, with rarity and recent unlocks
• Share your rarest unlocks as achievement cards

NEVER PAY FULL PRICE
• Deals across PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, and PC, ranked by what players want
• Spot lowest-ever prices and see when each sale ends
• See which wishlist games are on sale and set price alerts

DISCOVER & EXPLORE
• Trending games, new releases, critics' picks, and upcoming games in one place
• Personalised recommendations with a match score
• Explore every game in a series and see which ones you're missing
• Follow gaming events with countdowns, reminders, and replays
• Critic scores, player reviews, and Time to Beat estimates

JOIN THE COMMUNITY
• Follow friends and see what they're playing in your activity feed
• Race through backlogs, play along, or hunt trophies together in group challenges
• Build lists and game grids, and save lists other players share
• Show off your games, reviews, and achievements on your profile, alongside your stats and year in review

EVERYWHERE YOU PLAY
• Your library syncs across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro
• Apple Watch app with Now Playing, Up Next, and a Smart Stack widget
• Home Screen widgets, Live Activities, Control Center, and the Action button
• Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight, and Apple Intelligence
• A split game page on folding iPhones

GameTrack is free to download. GameTrack+ unlocks unlimited lists, game grids, tags, price alerts, Year in Review, your profile showcase, themes and app icons, and more.

GameTrack+ Subscription Terms
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase. Your GameTrack+ membership renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. To manage your membership or turn off auto-renew, go to Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://gametrack.app/privacypolicy/

Первичная аккредитация (специалитет) 2018 - Все специальности
В каждом направлении имеются следующие разделы:
 "Подготовка" - общее количество вопросов для удобства разделены на блоки по 100 вопросов. Каждый блок включает в себя следующие подразделы:
 - "Учить тесты" - позволяет изучить предложенные в данном блоке вопросы в текстовом формате с отмеченными правильными ответами 
 - "Тренировка" - все вопросы блока представлены в тестовом режиме 
 - "Получить зачёт" - данный подраздел создан для контроля знаний. Имеется возможность выбрать количество вопросов, которых на ваш взгляд достаточно для проверки самого себя (минимум 30). По окончании зачетного тестирования положительный результат программа программа выдаёт при наборе 75%, здесь вы сами решаете достаточно ли вам этого результата для получения зачёта. Если вы и программа считаете, что данный блок изучен достаточно, то данный диапазон вопросов помечается "галочкой".
 "Сдать экзамен" - максимально приближенный тестовый режим к реальному экзамену. Количество вопросов - 80. Положительный результат вы получаете набрав 70% правильных ответов.
 "Поиск по тестам" - раздел для поиска нужного вопроса среди всех предложенных по данной специальности. 
 "Избранное" - раздел, в который вы можете добавлять плохо запоминающиеся вопросы и прорешивать их. Добавление вопросов возможно на любом этапе: из общего поиска, тренировки и экзамена. 
Также для удобства визуализации общего процесса подготовки имеется экран, включающий в себя данные о количестве изученных вопросов, количестве успешных попыток сдачи экзамена и общего количества вопросов по направлению.

• Select multiple frames and export as video or GIF
• Control the frame playback speed and duration
• Optional editing for each frame (text, borders, filters)
• Smooth animations for previewing and fine-tuning
• No compression or quality loss during export
Create scroll-stopping visuals in just a few taps—Frame to Clip turns raw footage into polished content that stands out.

Password Manage.r is a powerful creator of passwords that will ward off hackers and keep your treasured information safe. Strong passwords are generated by complexed algorithms and stored in an encrypted database. You will only need one master pin to unlock it all and do as you wish.

bluejetty:00036694:ios.description:
Are you ready for an adventure that will take you on a wild ride through the dark side of Grand Gangster? 
Once the right hand of the gang, you abandoned your family for the love of a woman they disapproved of, becoming a prodigal son in the process. However, good times are fleeting... Your former girlfriend has now moved on to a new love, a mere punk from your old clan. Faced with this harsh reality, you decide to return and reclaim your place in the family business.
Yet, Vice Nation has changed dramatically in your absence, and everything you once knew is now different. With only your loyal friend Beverly by your side, you must navigate this lawless city to rejuvenate the family’s fortunes. Unbeknownst to you, a storm of intrigue is brewing, adding complexity to your already challenging journey...
【Game Features】
Manage Night Club, Take Control
Take charge of your night club! Here, every decision you make impacts your club's reputation and bottom line. From hiring staff, booking talent, to orchestrating unforgettable parties, it's up to you to create the ultimate nightlife hotspot. You can acquire wealth, charm, luxury cars, exquisite wines, and the ultimate power that's just within your reach!
Sandbox Strategy, Perfect Takeover
As you level up, you'll be able to unlock more minions to help you expand your territory. Unlock all kinds of Enforcers for your gang! From Amy's fierce whip to Phoenix's Gatling gun, no other gang will dare stand in your way.
Expand Your Territory, Explore New Areas
Upgrade your buildings, research new technology, train your henchmen, loot resources, march freely on the map, and expand your territory! The world is at your fingertips!
Exhilarating Battles, Epic Teamwork
Whether you prefer fighting at the front lines or supporting others back in the HQ, you'll experience the thrill of fighting side by side with your allies and let yourself shine!
Loving Grand Gangster War? Visit our social media at the link below to discover more about the game!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61564459084149
Discord: https://discord.gg/BvHsvE4Tz5
Subscription Rules:
1. Subscription Validity: 30 days (from the day of purchase until the 30th day at 11:59:59 p.m.).
2. Once subscribed, the following can be claimed daily: Purple Diamond*800, 60m Speedup*2, 60m Building Speedup*2, 60m Research Speedup*2, Lv.3 Resource Custom Chest*5.
3. During the subscription period, you can enjoy the following features: Research Speed +10%, Training Speed +5%, Stamina Recovery +5%, Building Speed +5%.
