Compete in free, fun activity challenges with your friends and family–no matter which fitness tracker they have. Sign-up for free, connect a wearable device or smartphone and get moving with others. 
CONNECT A VARIETY OF WEARABLE DEVICES
bluejetty:00168907:ios.description:
Compete in free, fun activity challenges with your friends and family–no matter which fitness tracker they have. Sign-up for free, connect a wearable device or smartphone and get moving with others. 
CONNECT A VARIETY OF WEARABLE DEVICES
Stridekick connects to a variety fitness trackers so you can compete with your friends no matter which device they use. Don’t have a fitness tracker? No problem. Connect using your smartphone or enter your activity manually. We connect with the following devices: Fitbit, Apple Watch, Garmin, Withings, Misfit, iPhone 5S+, Apple Health, Polar, and Xiaomi. 
CREATE YOUR OWN ACTIVITY CHALLENGES
Choose from three challenge modes: Leaderboard, Streak, and Target. 
JOIN COMMUNITY ACTIVITY CHALLENGES
Join bigger community challenges with other steppers on the Stridekick platform. Community challenges feature different modes of competition including Journey, Stick to it!, Teams, and even a collective Group Target! We're always adding new community challenges, so check back often. 
A SOCIAL COMMUNITY TO KEEP YOU MOVING
Everything is more fun with others. Stay motivated with the community of Stridekick steppers. Add friends and follow each other's activity stats. Keep up with those you know best through our daily Friends Leaderboard.
A VARIETY OF CHALLENGE GOALS, UNLIMITED FUN
Our challenge types offer a variety of ways to compete. Whether you're seeking a highly competitive leaderboard, a daily activity goal, or a long-term step target, we’ve got you covered. Compete on steps or active minutes.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS OVER TIME
View your weekly, monthly and yearly averages for steps, distance and active minutes. Keep track of your all-time best days and work to beat your personal records. Unlock activity levels as you increase your weekly activity average.
Join for free to create challenges that
- Last up to 7 days
- Can include up to 10 people per challenge
- Are public for anyone to join
Upgrade your experience with a Pro subscription that includes
- Longer challenges, up to 45 days
- Higher participant limits
- Private challenges for just your group
- Priority support
Terms of use: https://stridekick.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00062943:ios.name: Amerigo - File Manager
bluejetty:00062943:ios.summary:
Amerigo is an enhanced file manager that allows you to manage and organize local and cloud-saved files. 
It's the only APP that allows to link multiple cloud (DropBox, Google Drive, OneDrive, iCloud Files) and offers iOS Files app integra
bluejetty:00062943:ios.description:
Amerigo is an enhanced file manager that allows you to manage and organize local and cloud-saved files. 
It's the only APP that allows to link multiple cloud (DropBox, Google Drive, OneDrive, iCloud Files) and offers iOS Files app integration to download and upload to any cloud from any app!
For example if you receive an email, you can directly save the email attachments to one of the cloud linked in Amerigo, simply choosing "Save in files" in the action sheet.
Virtual folders allows to group files that come from different sources (cloud/local): you can for example have a virtual folder with all the files that belongs to a project but are stored on different cloud storage providers.
The Spotlight indexing of all local contents allows to immediately find and open the file you're looking for, without opening the app!
You can also add more than one account for each clouds to increase your space! 
The integrated PDF viewer with enhanced annotation capabilities, automatically recognise common shapes and gestures, and allows to highlight paragraph by drawing a line over it.
Main features: 
- iOS 11 Files app integration for ALL clouds linked to the app in read write mode.
- Spotlight indexing of all content in the app.
- Integration with the Dropbox, GDrive, OneDrive, iCloud services for remote file storage.
- Search between all contents in the app and in the linked cloud storages thanks to the advanced search 
- Compression (zip) and decompression (zip & rar) of any files. 
- PDF editor with annotation, free-hand writing.
- Support for all Microsoft Office files. 
- Simultaneous management of multiple Cloud accounts and management of folders shared with other users. 
- Enhanced bookmarks and history management. 
- URL autocomplete and search suggestions 
- Quick search bar, and enhanced search within all cloud and local files.
- File archive with folders and subfolders capabilities. 
- PIN to hide selected folders.
- Multi-tab fast internet browsing 
- Private browsing mode

bluejetty:00062090:ios.description:
Color It By Numbers is an exciting painting game for boys. 
There’s a car so suit any boy’s taste – once he’s found one, he can color it in with his favorite colors.
Benefits: 
◦ Teaching children simple arithmetic. Addition and subtraction
◦ Coloring by geometrical figures and pictograms
◦ Coloring by letters
◦ Very simple program interface that any child can master 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors
◦ High-quality drawings of all pictures 
◦ Visual effects and sound effects 
◦ Pleasing background music 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
◦ And many other useful features that make coloring entertaining
Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.
Boys and girls of all ages love to color. The simple coloring mode is suitable for the smallest of children, including those of kindergarten and preschool age. These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

bluejetty:00100894:android.summary:

The
bluejetty:00100894:android.description:
📱App Freezer helps you freeze (disable) unwanted apps and preinstalled bloatware on Android devices. By disabling unused apps, you can reduce background activity, save battery, free RAM, and keep your device cleaner and more organized.
The app supports many Android devices including Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Huawei, OnePlus and more.
It works on ROOTED and NON-ROOT devices (using Android Device Administrator mode).
🔑 Important Permission Notice
Root access or Device Administrator permission is required to freeze or unfreeze apps.
Without these permissions, App Freezer works only as a package information viewer.
All permissions are used only for core app functionality and are clearly explained.
⭐ Key Features
✔ Freeze / Unfreeze apps or packages
– Disable unwanted system apps, preinstalled apps, and bloatware
✔ One-tap Freeze / Unfreeze
– Quickly manage supported bloatware packages with a single tap
✔ Export / Import (XML)
– Backup and restore frozen app lists via external storage
✔ Favorites list
– Save frequently used packages for faster access
✔ Smart filters
– View frozen apps, running apps, or favorite packages
✔ Custom widgets
– Freeze or unfreeze selected apps or groups directly from the home screen
✔ Fingerprint authentication
– Protect the app from unauthorized access
✔ Advanced options (Root only)
– View app details, launch apps, or uninstall packages (Root required)
📱 Non-Root Device Setup (Advanced Users Only)
For Android 5.0+ devices without Root, App Freezer can operate in Device Administrator mode.
Requirements:
1. Basic knowledge of ADB commands
2. A computer with ADB installed
Steps:
1. Temporarily remove/logout all accounts from device settings
2. Enable USB Debugging
3. Connect your device to a computer
4. Run one of the following commands:
"adb shell dpm set-device-owner com.wakasoftware.appfreezer/.receiver.DPMReceiver"
or
"adb shell dpm set-profile-owner com.wakasoftware.appfreezer/.receiver.DPMReceiver"
Restart the app, then add your accounts back
📘 Detailed guide:
http://wakasoftware.com/app-freezer-setup
🔐 Special Permissions Explained
WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE → Used to export/import XML files and backup APKs
BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN → Required to enable freeze/unfreeze functionality on non-root devices

listings.name: App Freezer
listings.description:
📱App Freezer helps you freeze (disable) unwanted apps and preinstalled bloatware on Android devices. By disabling unused apps, you can reduce background activity, save battery, free RAM, and keep your device cleaner and more organized.

The app supports many Android devices including Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Huawei, OnePlus and more.
It works on ROOTED and NON-ROOT devices (using Android Device Administrator mode).

🔑 Important Permission Notice

Root access or Device Administrator permission is required to freeze or unfreeze apps.

Without these permissions, App Freezer works only as a package information viewer.

All permissions are used only for core app functionality and are clearly explained.

⭐ Key Features

✔ Freeze / Unfreeze apps or packages
– Disable unwanted system apps, preinstalled apps, and bloatware

✔ One-tap Freeze / Unfreeze
– Quickly manage supported bloatware packages with a single tap

✔ Export / Import (XML)
– Backup and restore frozen app lists via external storage

✔ Favorites list
– Save frequently used packages for faster access

✔ Smart filters
– View frozen apps, running apps, or favorite packages

✔ Custom widgets
– Freeze or unfreeze selected apps or groups directly from the home screen

✔ Fingerprint authentication
– Protect the app from unauthorized access

✔ Advanced options (Root only)
– View app details, launch apps, or uninstall packages (Root required)

📱 Non-Root Device Setup (Advanced Users Only)

For Android 5.0+ devices without Root, App Freezer can operate in Device Administrator mode.

Requirements:

1. Basic knowledge of ADB commands

2. A computer with ADB installed

Steps:

1. Temporarily remove/logout all accounts from device settings

2. Enable USB Debugging

3. Connect your device to a computer

4. Run one of the following commands:

"adb shell dpm set-device-owner com.wakasoftware.appfreezer/.receiver.DPMReceiver"

or

"adb shell dpm set-profile-owner com.wakasoftware.appfreezer/.receiver.DPMReceiver"

Restart the app, then add your accounts back

📘 Detailed guide:
http://wakasoftware.com/app-freezer-setup

WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE → Used to export/import XML files and backup APKs

BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN → Required to enable freeze/unfreeze functionality on non-root devices

App Freezer does not misuse permissions and does not access personal data.

Open App Freezer → Menu (⋮) → Uninstall this app

Or run the ADB command:

"adb shell dpm remove-active-admin com.wakasoftware.appfreezer/.receiver.DPMReceiver"

- Be cautious when freezing system-critical apps

bluejetty:00135588:ios.summary: Unleash your creativity and take control of your plans with Craft, a productivity app that transforms how you write, organize, and get things done. Create structured documents, manage tasks, organize your knowledge with Collections, and cha
bluejetty:00135588:ios.description:
Unleash your creativity and take control of your plans with Craft, a productivity app that transforms how you write, organize, and get things done. Create structured documents, manage tasks, organize your knowledge with Collections, and chat about it all with the AI Assistant. With seamless sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web, your workspace is always ready, online or offline.
WRITE ANYWHERE, ANYTIME
Your best ideas don’t wait for an internet connection. Work seamlessly offline with full access to all features, then let your changes sync automatically when you reconnect. Whether you’re on iPhone, iPad, or Mac, Craft keeps your writing experience consistent and powerful.
AI ASSISTANT IS THERE TO HELP
For seamless research, text editing, or searching across your entire knowledge base, Craft’s AI Assistant keeps you in flow on every device you use Craft on. Powered by advanced large language models, it finds any note, answers questions based on your content, and helps you stay on top of your knowledge without making you maintain a strict organizational system.
BUILT-IN TASK MANAGEMENT
Turn your ideas into action with our native Tasks system. Capture tasks as they emerge in your notes, manage them in a dedicated Inbox, and access them from any page with the Assistant’s help. Set target dates, due dates, and reminders to stay on track. With a unified tasks view, it’s the perfect balance between AI-powered fluidity and a dedicated, always-available space.
STAY ON TOP OF YOUR DAY
Make daily planning effortless with Daily Notes. Capture quick thoughts, plan your schedule, track tasks, or maintain your personal journal, all in one dedicated space. Switch to the calendar view to visualize your progress, reflect on your week, and understand how your days are shaping up.
CONNECT YOUR DOCS TO OTHER TOOLS
Turn Craft into the home for your whole workflow. Connect your documents to popular AI chat tools and productivity apps using deep integrations and APIs. Save conversations into Craft, pull in tasks, events, or other content from your existing tools, or even use your Craft documents as a CMS for powering a blog or website.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED
- Available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web
- Markdown and keyboard shortcuts
- Link sharing and web publishing
- Version history
- Fast, reliable sync
- Advanced integrations and API support
- AI-powered Assistant
- Incredible customer support
WHAT’S NEW
Craft Assistant: your smart partner to brainstorm, research, and write. It can help you find your notes across your space, rewrite and summarize documents, all while keeping you in the flow.
MCP & API: connect Craft to AI models and other tools in your productivity stack, turning it into an organizational layer and live memory.
Whiteboards: turn thoughts into visuals with a spacious canvas for sketching ideas, mapping projects, and collaborating creatively.
QUESTIONS?
Contact us on X at @craftdocs or email feedback@craft.do
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
If you purchase a Craft subscription, you’ll be charged via the payment method associated with your Apple ID. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period.
You can turn off auto-renewal at any time in your account settings on the App Store. Craft subscriptions are available as one-month and 12-month packages.
Prices may vary depending on country and are subject to change without notice. Current subscriptions cannot be canceled during the active subscription period. If you don’t choose to purchase a Craft subscription, you can continue using Craft for free.
Terms of service: https://www.craft.do/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.craft.do/privacy

bluejetty:00180722:ios.description:
INSTITUTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED.
Access the latest advances in clinical knowledge anytime, anywhere with ClinicalKey®- the essential resource for medical professionals.
ClinicalKey combines the speed of synoptic content with the depth of a comprehensive clinical reference tool in one intuitive solution to provide clinicians trusted information in the moments that matter most. With ClinicalKey, you can:
• Stay abreast of rapidly expanding clinical knowledge
• Quickly confirm diagnosis and treatment information
• Advance critical thinking skills and research
Please note: To access our extensive content library, ensure you have a subscription to ClinicalKey from your organization.
To get started:
1. Download the free ClinicalKey app for iOS on your iPad® or iPhone®.
2. Follow the prompts to connect to your organization’s account.The app will ask questions to get you to the right content.
3. Choose the method of access that is right for you:
4. Select Access via Network if you need a quick answer and your device is connected to your organization's network.
5. Select Access via Institution for other ways to connect.
6. Once you have gained access, create or sign- in to your Elsevier ClinicalKey user account to save favorites and earn CME/MOC/CE/MOC/CE.
ClinicalKey®
Because you want to find a better way to help your patients
ClinicalKey combines the speed of synoptic content with the depth of a comprehensive clinical reference tool in one intuitive solution to give clinicians trusted information in the moments that matter. With the ClinicalKey, clinicians will be able to:
• Enhance patient care with trusted resources and deep insights across 30+ specialties
• Combine efficiency and confidence in your practice with access to quick answers and information that is continuously updated
• Excel in your field by building foundational knowledge and keeping up with the latest trends through full-text reference books and journals, while earning free CME/MOC/CE credit
• Stay abreast of rapidly expanding clinical knowledge
• Quickly confirm diagnosis and treatment information
• Advance critical thinking skills and research
ClinicalKey App for iOS Features:
• Trusted Comprehensive content covering more than 30 medical and surgical specialties
• Easy-to-scan, clinically focused medical topic synopses
• Intuitive search with auto-suggest/
• Easy search with auto-completion
• Direct navigation to your favorite books and journals
• Mobile-optimized medical calculators
• Access to full-text books, full-text journals, guidelines, multimedia and more
• Access via Institutional IP; individuals will not be able to earn CME/MOC/CE, save, or share content when using IP authentication. Please register for remote access via your institutional web version of ClinicalKey.
ClinicalKey Registrants (non-IP) customers will enjoy:
• Opportunity to earn CME and fulfill MOC requirements with the American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM)
• Ability to favorite and save content
• Option to print and email topics, videos or graphics
• Earn and track free CME/MOC/CE credit
Ability to favorite and save content
Print and email topics, videos or graphics to patients and colleagues

bluejetty:00015307:ios.name: The Human Body: Learn Anatomy
bluejetty:00015307:ios.summary:

With "How does the Human Body Work?" you
bluejetty:00015307:ios.description:
Explore the human body and discover how your organs and muscles work. Play and learn as you watch the heart pump blood, where the food we eat passes, why a mosquito bite hurts us and much, much more!
With "How does the Human Body Work?" you can play and learn freely, with no pressure or stress. Play, observe, ask questions and find the answers. Have fun controlling your character, feeding him and cutting his nails. 
Enter our machine and watch how the blood platelets plug the wounds, how the muscles contract to kick a balloon or how a baby grows inside its mother. 
Learn and concentrate on healthy habits, watch how the lungs get sick if we breathe a lot of smoke, how running and exercise is good for your health and how the human body is healthier and stronger if you eat a balanced diet. We only have one body, let's take care of it!
With 9 incredible interactive scenes:
Circulatory system
Zoom into the heart and see how it pumps blood. Discover white blood cells, platelets and red blood cells, and see how they work to make your body healthy. 
Respiratory System
Watch your character inhale as see how the air goes to the lungs, bronchi and alveoli. Play by controlling your character and seeing how the rhythm of his breathing changes.
Urogenital system
Learn what the kidneys and bladder do. Interact with your character and help clean the blood and make him pee. 
Digestive system
What path does the food follow from its entry into the human body until the waste comes out? Feed the character and help him absorb the nutrients and dispose of the waste. 
Nervous System
Observe how the nerves of the whole body are activated and how the senses work: sight, smell, hearing... and also learn about the brain and its various parts. 
Skeletal System
In this system, you'll learn how the skeleton is made up of many bones, how they give us mobility and allow us to walk, jump, run... and how your bones are responsible for generating the blood of our body. 
Muscular System
Learn how your body contracts and relaxes the muscles to help us move, protect us and learn the names of the most important muscles. You can turn your character around and see that we have other muscles on the other side!
The Skin 
Discover how the skin protects us and how it responds to cold and heat. Watch how the hairs grow, clean the sweat of your character and play by cutting its nails and painting them. 
Pregnancy
Take care of the pregnant woman, take her blood pressure, do an ultrasound and observe how a baby is forming inside her. 
Suitable for all ages, starting at 4 years old.
ABOUT LEARNY LAND
At Learny Land, we love to play, and we believe that games must form part of the educational and growth stage of all children; because to play is to discover, explore, learn and have fun. Our educational games help children learn about the world around them and are designed with love. They are easy to use, beautiful and safe. Because boys and girls have always played to have fun and learn, the games we make - like the toys that last a lifetime - can be seen, played and heard.
At Learny Land we take advantage of the most innovative technologies and the most modern devices to take the experience of learning and playing a step further. We create toys that could not have existed when we were young.
Read more about us at www.learnyland.com.
Privacy Policy
We take Privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your children or allow any type of third party ads. To learn more, please read our privacy policy at www.learnyland.com.
Contact us
We'd love to know your opinion and your suggestions. Please, write to support@learnyland.com.
Terms of Use: http://learnyland.com/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00126884:ios.name: Kahoot! Numbers by DragonBox
bluejetty:00126884:ios.summary:
Kahoot! Numbers by DragonBox is an award-winning learning game that gives your child a perfect introduction to math and the foundation they need for future math learning.
“Kahoot! Numbers by DragonBox is the first thing you should download
bluejetty:00126884:ios.description:
Kahoot! Numbers by DragonBox is an award-winning learning game that gives your child a perfect introduction to math and the foundation they need for future math learning.
“Kahoot! Numbers by DragonBox is the first thing you should download on a tablet if you have kids 4-8 years old” -Forbes
The prestigious Parents magazine names Kahoot! Numbers by DragonBox a best learning app for kids for two years in a row, 2020 and 2021.
**REQUIRES A SUBSCRIPTION**
Access to the contents and functionality of this app requires a subscription to Kahoot! Kids.
The Kahoot! Kids subscription gives your family access to premium Kahoot! features and 7 award-winning learning apps for math and reading.
HOW THE GAME WORKS
Kahoot! Numbers by DragonBox goes beyond teaching children to count by teaching your child what numbers are, how they work, and what you can do with them. The game makes it easy and fun for your child to develop their number sense and gain an intuitive understanding of numbers.
Kahoot! Numbers by DragonBox brings math to life by turning numbers into colorful and relatable characters, called Nooms. The Nooms can be stacked, sliced, combined, sorted, compared and played with, any way your child pleases. By doing this they will learn basic math and learn addition and subtraction with numbers between 1 and 20.
FEATURES
The app contains 4 different activities for your child to explore, each designed to challenge your child to use the Nooms and basic math in a different way.
The "Sandbox" section of the game is designed to let your child explore and experiment with the Nooms. It's also the perfect tool for parents and teachers to explain basic math concepts to kids.
In the "Puzzle" section, your child will use basic math to create their own puzzle pieces, and place them in the right spot to reveal a hidden picture. Every move your child makes reinforces number sense. Your child will perform thousands of operations while solving the 250 puzzles.
In the "Ladder" section, your child will have to think strategically to build larger numbers. Your child will develop an intuitive understanding of how larger numbers relate to small numbers, and practice basic math strategies every step of the way.
In the "Run" section, your child will have to direct the Noom down a path using quick mental calculations. Your child can use their fingers, Nooms, or numerals to jump over obstacles. This activity reinforces your child's number sense and trains their ability to quickly recognize and add numbers.
Kahoot! Numbers by DragonBox is based on the same pedagogical principles as the other games in the award-winning DragonBox series and works by integrating the learning seamlessly into the gameplay, with no quizzes or mindless repetitions. Every interaction in Kahoot! Numbers by DragonBox is designed to heighten your child’s understanding of numbers and strengthen his or her love of math, giving your child a great foundation for future math learning.
Terms and Conditions: https://kahoot.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy https://kahoot.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00088750:ios.summary:

The Lyynk app provides young people with a personalized toolbox to help them better understand themselves and measure their well-bein
bluejetty:00088750:ios.description:
Lyynk supports and strengthens the bond between young people and their trusted adults (parents or others).
The Lyynk app provides young people with a personalized toolbox to help them better understand themselves and measure their well-being. It’s a safe place available at any time, designed by young people in collaboration with mental health professionals.
Lyynk also allows adults to learn more about their young person, based on the information that the young person feels ready to share with their trusted adults. The app also offers features that encourage interaction and resources to support adults who often feel helpless when facing the challenges their young people may encounter.
By energizing this connection, the Lyynk app helps strengthen the relationship between young people and their trusted adults. These same young people will naturally tend to seek support from adults they see as more open and involved in their well-being and mental health.
The Lyynk app is recommended by psychologists, psychiatrists, and youth mental health experts. Lyynk is accessible to everyone—children, teenagers, adults…
Using the app for just 10 minutes a day can make a difference. Lyynk is designed for daily use, but how often you use it depends on your needs and preferences.
Benefits of the app:
For young people:
■ Strengthen the relationship of trust with parents or trusted adults
■ Express emotions and feelings
■ Set and track goals
■ Find help in crisis situations
■ Get to know themselves better and improve their quality of life and well-being
For trusted adults / parents:
■ Strengthen the relationship of trust with their child
■ Track their child’s emotional state
■ Understand their child’s needs and desires
■ Interact with their young person through a digital tool
■ Be seen as a reliable resource by the young person
Notes:
Compatible with all devices.
Intuitive use, suitable for all ages.
Respect for user data privacy and security.
Send us your questions, feedback, and suggestions on the app!

bluejetty:00114408:ios.name: My Leisure Time
bluejetty:00114408:ios.summary:
Welcome to Yoyo Town, where your relaxing new life begins!
Here, you can immerse yourself in a warm and adorable art style, experience a life of leisurely freedom, meet hospitable neighbors, and even own your dream home! With free interior
bluejetty:00114408:ios.description:
Welcome to Yoyo Town, where your relaxing new life begins!
Here, you can immerse yourself in a warm and adorable art style, experience a life of leisurely freedom, meet hospitable neighbors, and even own your dream home! With free interior design, personalized fashion, and adorable pets, a variety of relaxing gameplay options await you. Make every day full of surprises and joy!
【Abundant Layouts, Unlimited Decoration】
In Yoyo Town, everyone can own their own houses! Choose from a wide range of layouts: a cozy bungalow, a stylish loft, a spacious duplex, or a luxurious villa. You can freely plan the layout of your home, adjust space partitions, and meticulously decorate every detail—from the living room and bedroom to the balcony, kitchen, and bathroom—creating your ideal living space! You can also renovate and remodel your house anytime, keeping your home feeling fresh and new!
【Renovate Freely, Remodel Your Home】
With over a thousand types of furniture, you can easily create your dream home style! Whether you prefer the elegant charm of classic Chinese aesthetics, sleek and modern minimalist design, romantic fairy-tale themes, rustic country vibes, or industrial retro styles… you can mix and match freely, making each room uniquely charming! Besides, with a variety of interactive furniture, your home will be full of life, perfectly realizing your dream blueprint!
【Dress Freely, Create Your Style】
A highly customizable outfit system lets you create a unique virtual avatar! Choose from hundreds of clothing items, hairstyles, accessories, and makeup options. From refined elegance to trendy avant-garde, you can master any style. Whether it's casual daily wear, simple and efficient looks, gorgeous royal attire, or sweet dreamy styles, you can mix and match freely, always presenting the best version of yourself!
【Relaxing Gameplay, Super Stress-Relieving Mini-Games】
Yoyo Town is not just your home—it's a vibrant little town! Enjoy a variety of life-simulation activities: go fishing by the shore, learn to cook at the canteen, brew aromatic coffee at the café, or pick beautiful bouquets at the flower shop… You can also meet the town's residents and share bits of daily life with friends! Open the map to unlock more fun activities with one click, and enjoy a leisurely, comfortable ideal life!
【Pets Welcome, Enjoy Cozy Moments】
A cat or a dog? The answer is "both"! In Yoyo Town, you can adopt pets and spend warm, cozy moments together! Whether it's a clingy kitten or an energetic puppy, they'll leave their little paw prints all over your home, accompanying you every day. You can even dress up your pet in cute outfits and create a dedicated interactive space for them, enjoying the therapeutic joy of living with pets!
【Build Together, Grow Together】
Here, you can team up with like-minded friends to build your ideal town—from planting flowers to decorating courtyards, creating it step by step! Whether you're sharing decoration ideas, participating in town events, or building shared spaces with friends, you'll find a sense of belonging here and create wonderful memories together!

bluejetty:00027042:ios.description:
Master-Nav is a progressive COLREGS learning system developed by a Master Mariner. The COLREGS are notoriously difficult to learn and retain — Master-Nav makes it significantly easier through an interactive system built around how your brain actually works.
Instead of guessing through random question banks, Master-Nav guides you step by step through every rule from start to finish. Wrong answers are revisited until the rules stick — properly.
Complex regulations are broken down into learnable chunks — bite-sized sections supported by mnemonics, memory aids and interactive visuals designed around how the brain actually retains information.
Every incorrect answer is shown graphically alongside the correct one — immediately clear, no confusion. And with a single tap, the relevant COLREGS rule is accessible from any question at any time.
Master-Nav covers COLREGS Parts A to D — General, Steering & Sailing, Lights & Shapes and Sound & Light Signals — plus Annex IV Distress Signals. Over 1000 questions in multiple formats, with a dedicated Practice Section that tracks right, wrong and unanswered so you always know where to focus.
COLREGS — the easy way.

NLB mKlik omogućava vam da obavljate sve finansijske transakcije putem vašeg mobilnog uređaja u bilo koje vreme i na bilo kom mestu na brz, jednostavan i siguran način. Usluge su dostupne 24 sata, sedam dana u nedelji. Sve što vam je potrebno je mobilni uređaj i internet konekcija.
NLB mKlik vam nudi sledeće opcije:
· Provera stanja i prometa na računima i platnim karticama
· Slanje izvoda sa računa za dinarske i devizne račune na registrovanu email adresu
· Obavljanje plaćanja i transfer novca uz mogućnost slanja potvrde o plaćanju za završene transakcije
· Plaćanje putem PRENESI usluge unošenjem mobilnog telefonskog broja registrovanog od strane primaoca sredstava za ovu uslugu
· Registracija za PRENESI uslugu
· DEEP LINK usluga
· Podnošenje ONLINE zahteva za određene proizvode i usluge, realizacija bez odlaska u filijalu
· Kupovina/prodaja deviza
· Lokator bankomata i filijala
· Mogućnost kreiranja šablona za plaćanja
· Pregled štednje sa fiksnim rokom
· Pregled kredita i pripadajućih detalja
· Dopuna prepaid salda na mobilnom telefonu kod domaćih operatera
· Primanje komunikacije od banke, informacije o transakcijama na računu putem PUSH obaveštenja i kontakt sa bankom putem emaila, društvenih mreža ili telefona
· Administracija platnih kartica
· Postavke za prijavu i autentifikaciju putem prepoznavanja lica
Napomena: Ako već koristite NLB eKlik, možete sami pokrenuti slanje aktivacionog koda za NLB mKlik u trenutnom podešavanju na vašem eKlik korisničkom nalogu. Takođe postoji mogućnost da pozovete kontakt centar radi dobijanja novog aktivacionog koda. Unapređene funkcionalnosti mKlik-a mogu se koristiti na uređajima koji imaju preinstaliran OS 15.6 ili noviji.
------------------------------------------------------
NLB mKlik enables you to perform all the financial transactions via your mobile device at any time and place in a fast, easy and safe way. The services is available 24 hours, seven days a week. All you need to have is mobile device and internet connection. 
NLB mKlik offers you the following options: 
- Check the balance and turnover on accounts and payment cards 
- Sending of account statements for domestic and foreign currency accounts to registered email address 
- Perform payment and money transfer with an option of sending payment confirmation for completed payments 
- Payment via the PRENESI services by entering the mobile phone number registered by the recipient of funds for this service 
- Register for the PRENESI service 
- DEEP LINK service 
- Submitting an ONLINE request for certain products and services, realisation without going to the Branch 
- Purchase/sell foreign currencies 
- ATM and branch locator 
- The ability to create payment templates 
- Summary overview of fixed term savings 
- Loans overview and the supporting details 
- Top up the prepaid balance on mobile phone with domestic operators 
- To receive communication from the bank, info about account transactions through PUSH notifications and contact the Bank via e-mail, social networks or telephone 
- Payment cards administration 
- Login and authentication option settings for face recognition 
Note: If you are already using NLB eKlik, you can initiate sending the activation code for NLB mKlik yourself within the current Setup on your eKlik user account. There is also the possibility to call the contact center to receive a new activation code. Improved functionalities of mKlik can be used on devices which have preinstalled OS 15.6 or higher.

bluejetty:00160099:ios.description:
Play puzzles and brain teasers in one of the puzzle adventure! Your goal is to solve mystery in these fun hidden object adventure and to investigate the case.
When a young woman is kidnapped from a public place, in the middle of the day, with no witnesses, the only detectives that can pick up her trail are Randall and Eleanor, the twin detectives who each bring a unique approach to every case! Randall is a forensics expert who uses science and logic, while Eleanor uses intuition and arcane mysticism to find the clues. But this time, even their combined specialties might not be enough. They’ll need your help and skills to make sure this mystery isn’t their last! Gather your wits for an unforgettable detective story in this pulse-pounded new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!
· INVESTIGATE THE DEATH OF JENNIFER'S BROTHER IN THE BONUS GAME!
Play more exciting puzzles and finding object games after you finish the main story!
More adventures await you in this unique chapter, where you can find the hidden objects and unlock all new branches of the story! Investigate and examine a crime scene!
· FIND HIDDEN COINS, MORPHING OBJECTS, AND MORE TO COMPLETE YOUR COLLECTIONS!
Each location has a unique collection of various collectibles to help you in your investigation! Are you ready to go on an exciting journey and collect all the hidden pictures while playing the mystery adventure games?
· ENJOY EXCLUSIVE CONCEPT ART AND MUSIC!
Our mystery stories quests have tons of bonus content for you to enjoy! More objects need to be found!
· REPLAY YOUR FAVORITE HIDDEN-OBJECT SCENES AND MINI-GAMES TO UNLOCK CHALLENGING ACHIEVEMENTS!
Replay your favorite investigation games to earn as many achievements as you can to brag to your friends!
· KEEP THE CASE MOVING WITH A STRATEGY GUIDE!
Stuck on any detective games? No problem - our built-in walkthrough will always help you!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Visit our website to search and find hidden object games: http://dominigames.com
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

Move emails to different accounts

Set up rules to auto reply, auto delete, auto file/archive, set flags & lots more

A quick swipe will mark and email as spam, move it to the spam folder, block the sender email address, domain or IP address and unsubscribe - in one action!
Smart Spam detector and also DMARC, DKIM, SPF
Create spam actions and rules

bluejetty:00080288:android.summary:

Download now to experience exhilarating battles and surpass all expectations! Face fierce combat and epic boss fights while enjoying a refreshing
bluejetty:00080288:android.description:
"Tales of Brave-doomsday battle RPG is an incredibly fun, free roguelike hack-and-slash game.
Download now to experience exhilarating battles and surpass all expectations! Face fierce combat and epic boss fights while enjoying a refreshing and relaxing gameplay experience!
Key Features:
- Tons of beautifully designed characters, form a team of five and conquer the battlefield
- Gem embedding system for revamped gameplay
- Mech allies to ignite the battlefield with power
- Various dungeons to freely explore
Gameplay Highlights:
・Casual and Relaxing, Easy to Pick Up
No matter where you are, enjoy smooth and exciting battles at any time! With simple controls, one finger is all you need to master the battlefield, offering a mix of thrilling combat and relaxing fun.
・Team Up with Five Characters, Conquer the Battlefield
Form a powerful team of five characters, work together seamlessly to crush your enemies, and experience the ultimate thrill of teamwork.
・Customize Skills, Create Your Own Combat Style
Combine skills freely from a diverse skill set and adapt to any battle situation. Tailor your strategy to the enemy and environment, unleashing unique combos to showcase your personal style.
・Elemental Growth and Skill Evolution, A Visual Feast
Control the four elements—Wind, Fire, Lightning, and Ice—along with physical and energy-based attacks. Evolve your skills, increasing power while enjoying stunning visual effects. Every battle is a feast of both strategy and beauty.
・Innovative Monsters, Unpredictable Battles
Monsters are designed with creativity, and their movement patterns and abilities vary, constantly changing the course of battle and challenging your tactics and reflexes.
・Revamped Gameplay with Equipment and Gems
The powerful equipment and gem embedding system offer limitless potential. Explore ruins, complete missions, and obtain top-tier gear. Equip gems to transform your gameplay and unlock new battle strategies.
・Diverse Dungeons, Play Freely
The game features a variety of dungeons, each offering unique challenges and rewards. Enjoy the freedom of choosing different gameplay modes whenever you like.
・Guild Collaboration, Easy Socializing
Join or create a guild, team up with friends, share resources, and cooperate in tasks. Immerse yourself in a vibrant social circle and enjoy the fun of team-based combat.
・Sacred Relic Excavation, Strategic Enhancement
Explore mysterious ruins to uncover powerful sacred relics that add more strategy and fun to your battles! Sacred relics provide extra abilities to your characters, diversifying your combat strategies and boosting your chances of victory, while adding depth and challenge to the game.
・Pet Companions and Multi-line Development (Coming Soon)
Collect and train adorable pets that provide combat support and feature deep multi-line development systems. Your pets will be your loyal companions as you venture across the lands.
Game Background:
In the year 1023 of the Continental Calendar, the Z-virus infection is sweeping through the city!
The appearance of aether essence has allowed humanity to survive, leading to the creation of countless sanctuaries!
As time passes, a few survivors resonate with the aether essence, gaining special abilities!
As one of the elite, you will use the power of the aether essence to protect the sanctuaries alongside your friends!
Discord：@TalesofBrave
Twitter：@TalesofBraved_
Contact Us：TalesofBrave.service@outlook.com"

*** Welcome to the enchanting world of Tile Blossom Forest - Triple 3D: A serene forest where blooming flowers meet captivating tile-matching puzzles! Immerse yourself in a magical forest, where lush greenery creates an enchanting garden, offering serenity and captivating gameplay.
*** Why Tile Blossom Forest Stands Out:
Explore the tranquility of beautifully crafted gardens in the lush blooming woodland with many gorgeous flora objects while mastering the art of pairing identical tiles. Engage in addictive gameplay that's both calming and challenging.

Embark on a journey of relaxation and mental engagement through the art of matching flower tiles. Tap and pair identical tiles to clear the board and unwind as you solve puzzles amidst the blossom-covered forest.

Delve into meticulously designed levels that test your skills and keep you immersed. Crush through puzzles, strategically tapping, merging, and pairing tiles to progress through a myriad of captivating challenges.

Gather enticing rewards by overcoming unicorn challenges, and obtaining appealing power-ups that unlock an array of limitless levels.

Engage in friendly rivalry with friends and global players on leaderboards. Form teams to unlock enticing boosters and rewards, showcasing your tile-matching skills!
*** Features that Tile Blossom Forest Offers:
* Endless Entertainment: Immerse yourself in an infinite array of captivating levels, ensuring a continuous journey through flower-filled landscapes.
* Easy to Play, Challenging to Master: Enjoy a simple yet addictive gameplay experience suitable for all ages while keeping your mind sharp and engaged.
* Diverse Floral Tiles: Explore an assortment of beautifully crafted flower tiles, each meticulously designed to captivate players with its uniqueness.
* Power-Up Your Play: Utilize strategic boosters to overcome tricky levels, making your journey through the forest even more rewarding.
* Play Anywhere: Enjoy the calming experience of tile-matching bliss offline, anytime and anywhere.
* Enjoy play together: Team up, climb leaderboards, and maximize the enjoyment!
*** Download Tile Blossom Forest now and:
* Immerse yourself in a serene tapestry of flowers and engaging puzzles.
* Experience a tranquil escape with relaxing gameplay designed for all ages.
* Dive into a world of zen gaming, exploring the beauty of flower tile matching.
About Skylink Studio:
Tile Blossom Forest: Triple 3D is developed by Skylink Studio, a premier game studio specializing in Puzzle and Casual Games. Renowned for titles like Merge Master - Elden Warrior, Toy Master 3D, Tile Zen, Merge Tower Defense 3D, and other engaging and innovative games, Skylink Studio aims to provide entertainment while fostering relaxation and mental engagement through gaming."

bluejetty:00152289:ios.name: Jigsaw Art Puzzle Solitaire
bluejetty:00152289:ios.summary: Jigsaw Art Puzzle Solitaire is a relaxing jigsaw puzzle where you swap cards to complete beautiful photo pictures. Inspired by solitaire, each move challenges your logic and rewards you with a smooth, satisfying snap as the full image comes
bluejetty:00152289:ios.description:
Jigsaw Art Puzzle Solitaire is a relaxing jigsaw puzzle where you swap cards to complete beautiful photo pictures. Inspired by solitaire, each move challenges your logic and rewards you with a smooth, satisfying snap as the full image comes together.
Drag a card, place it on another, and watch them swap positions as you gradually reveal stunning photo artwork piece by piece. Easy to learn, yet surprisingly challenging to master.
No timers. No pressure. Just calm, focused puzzle gameplay.
Game Features
- Unique swap-based card mechanics
- Beautiful themed photo puzzles and artwork collections
- Relaxing gameplay with no timer
- Extra challenging daily puzzles
- Helpful boosters like Hint and Shuffle when you need a nudge
- Casual brain and logic gameplay for all skill levels
Play at your own pace to unwind, or test your skills in daily challenges for an extra challenge. Whether you love solitaire, classic jigsaw puzzles, or brain-teasing puzzle games, this card-based experience delivers the perfect balance of relaxation and strategy.
Swap. Relax. Complete the picture.
Jigsaw Art Puzzle Solitaire combines the relaxing flow of solitaire with the joy of completing beautiful pixel-art puzzles. Arrange cards in sequence, clear the board, and earn puzzle pieces with every successful run. Place each piece to slowly reveal stunning pixel artworks — cozy rooms, dreamy landscapes, and cute animals come to life as you play.
Simple yet deeply satisfying, Jigsaw Art Puzzle Solitaire offers hundreds of unique puzzles and soothing animations wrapped in calm music and soft pastel tones. Use undo, hint, or wild cards to fix tricky moments, chain long combos to boost your score, and collect every finished artwork in your personal Pixel Gallery. Play freely in Zen Mode or chase the top of the leaderboards through daily challenges and limited-time events.
Whether you have a minute or an hour, Jigsaw Art Puzzle Solitaire is the perfect way to relax, focus, and feel rewarded one move at a time. 
Download now and start uncovering your next masterpiece.

bluejetty:00120042:ios.description:
Discover the World of Physics with Dinosaur Pirate!
Set out on a thrilling ocean voyage and unravel the mysteries of the physical world in "Dinosaur Pirate". Designed specially for the young curious minds, this game fuses the excitement of pirate adventures with practical physics lessons. It's not just about being a captain of a pirate ship; it’s an exploration, a journey of learning through play.
Key Features:
• Engage & Educate: With over 40 levels of physics-based puzzles, children are introduced to a myriad of scientific concepts: from optics and electromagnetism to principles of mechanical operation.
• Unique Gameplay Modes: Six distinct pirate ships, including the manipulator ship, water cannon ship, and ray ship, offer a blend of fun and education.
• Dynamic Learning: The levels evolve with the storyline, allowing players to witness and understand physical phenomena firsthand.
• Child-Friendly Design: Cheerful animations, vibrant colors, fun shapes, and humorous sound effects make learning delightful. Designed specifically for toddlers, kindergarten, and preschool-aged kids.
• Play Anytime, Anywhere: Our game is an offline game, meaning you can embark on your pirate adventure without the internet.
• Safety First: Absolutely no third-party advertising.
Why Choose Dinosaur Pirate?
Looking for boat games or simulator games that provide more than just entertainment? "Dinosaur Pirate" stands out as one of the best educational games, emphasizing learning through play. Not only does it fit the bill for 'pirate games for kids' or 'games for toddlers', but it also introduces them to Pre-K activities. Dive deep into a world where colors come alive, and shapes take on new meanings. It's not just a game; it's a holistic learning experience.
About Yateland:
At Yateland, we believe in the power of play. Our apps are not just games for kids; they are portals to knowledge. Guided by our motto - "Apps children love and parents trust", we craft apps with educational values that inspire preschoolers across the globe. Dive into our world: https://yateland.com
Privacy Policy
Yateland is committed to protecting users' privacy. If you would like to know more about how we deal with these matters, please read our full privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

Do you want to race on super tracks and arrange realistic car crashes? Welcome to CrashOut, a mix of race car games and car crashing games! Play and enjoy extreme car racing games of the demolition derby style in one of the best 3D car crash simulator. 
Over 15 cars types for your most exciting race car games – from pickups and SUVs to luxury cars. Each car has a unique skin and tuning options for your car customizing games. The game features a large open world, racing with a car wreckfest, realistic car damage (including car burnout) and a detailed destructible environment. 
 Game modes 
Quarry mode – car racing games with other players. Consists of more than 50 race tracks for custom car games. In this mode, you need to get to the finish within a certain time, arranging car accidents for your rivals. 
 Demolition derby mode –car crash battle. In this mode, you can play the hardest car crashing games. The main goal is to destroy your rivals’ cars or damage them as much as possible. 
Free mode – a game’s open world to explore. Here you can simply drive a car, race, and explore tracks, earning experience and in-game currency. To earn these, you need to do stunts, drifts, jumps, offroads, smash cars, and wreck destructible obstacles. Also, collect bonuses that are located all over the map. To get to them, you need to hone your driving skills. 
Online mode. In this mode, you can arrange multiplayer battles in racing, free, or demolition derby modes. 
Super-realistic car demolition games! 
 In this car crash simulator, you can damage cars extremely realistically! The realistic engine outputs a detailed damage model. Depending on the damage force and point, a car gets dents, windows break, car body parts fall off, and if the chassis is damaged, you get poor handling and steering. The final result of the destruction of the car is a fire in the engine compartment. 
 First-person racing 
 With the first-person racing, you will feel like a real racer and enjoy your racing and drifting games even more. In serious car accidents, the driver can be thrown from the windshield with ragdoll physics. 
Download CrashOut, a racing and car crash simulator, right now! Tune your auto like in classic car customizing games! Play your best car racing games! And of course, smash cars and destructible obstacles to win the derby!

bluejetty:00124404:ios.description:
Used by over 160,000 pilots worldwide, LogTen Pilot Logbook by Pilotbase is the most trusted digital logbook in aviation, designed to support pilots throughout their whole aviation career. Whether you're logging your first solo or preparing for your next type rating, LogTen offers powerful tools to keep you current, compliant, and ready for every opportunity.
▶ Try before you buy – Your first 50 hours of total flight time are on us. ◀
▶ Need flight data imported from your old logbook? We’ll do it for you just email us at imports@logten.com! ◀
▶ What Pilots Say ◀
“Excellent program. Smart and simple to understand. I can log every aspect of my flight with a few taps. Love that it keeps track of currency, and expiring certificates like medical. Customer support is amazing. This App is a must have for all pilots.”
▶ LOG & PROTECT ◀
• Lightning fast data entry on Watch, iPhone and iPad (also available on your Mac with Pro subscription!)
• Automated and totally customizable for the type of flying you do
• Schedule import for over 100 airlines with LogTen Pro
• All your devices, always in sync
• Protects your logbook with automatic and manual backups. You can even name your backups for easy organization.
▶ ANALYZE & REPORT ◀
• One tap access to key analytics pilots need for each aircraft you fly - multi-engine, turbine, PIC, SIC, total instrument etc.
• Powerful, industry leading Smart Group technology so you can track virtually any aspect of your time and get the answers you need instantly - no calculator needed
• Over 100 built-in reports including experience reports, logbook formats from around the world, 8710 and pilot job applications including automated digital signature on every page!
▶ PLAN & TRACK ◀
• Use LogTen Pro for Mac to import your flight schedule, or one of our third party partners with LogTen Basic (iOS Only)
• Track your goals with custom filters - for example progress towards achieving your ATPL, or how much XC Night you have
• Track your currencies, flight limits, flight duty limits, and rest
• Industry first Dynamic Time Loupe™ enables you to quickly identify potential future issues with rest, duty or flight duty period limits before they happen, including complex rest and duty regulations such as FAR117 and EASA regulations
▶ CAREER ACCESS ◀
• Put your job search on autopilot and land the job faster with personalized career matching inside LogTen
• Personalized job matching based on your actual hours, ratings, and flight experience
• Tons of flight hour-building opportunities to help you reach your next minimums faster
• All major pilot job types in one place — 121, 135, 91, corporate, and cadet programs 
• Find the right job faster with career search built directly into your LogTen logbookTurn your logbook into a career advancement tool, not just a record of flights
Subscription Information:
As part of our goal to help more pilots succeed, we offer the LogTen service completely free until you have logged more than 50 hours of total time! And with or without a subscription, you always get updates, and you always get full access to your data, where you can view, edit, generate reports, export, and print.
Pricing may vary by location (see pricing under Top in App Purchases, or right in the App in the Store section of Settings). Your subscription will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account and will automatically renew 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period, unless auto-renew is disabled beforehand. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be disabled by going to your iTunes account settings after purchase. A subscription cannot be cancelled during the active subscription period.
---
Privacy Policy: https://logten.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://logten.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00096868:ios.name: Lirevo
bluejetty:00096868:ios.summary: Lirevo is a beautifully designed iOS app that helps book lovers capture and preserve their reading memories. Create detailed records of the books you read, save memorable pages, and record your thoughts—all stored securely on your device.
bluejetty:00096868:ios.description:
Lirevo is a beautifully designed iOS app that helps book lovers capture and preserve their reading memories. Create detailed records of the books you read, save memorable pages, and record your thoughts—all stored securely on your device.
Key Features:
Comprehensive Book Records
Create detailed records for every book you read. Add the book title, author name, reading progress (0-100%), and personal notes. Each record requires a cover image (3:4 aspect ratio) to help you visually identify your books at a glance. All records are stored locally on your device.
Book Page Photos
Capture and save important pages from your books using your device's camera. Add multiple photos to each record, and attach personal notes to each image to remember why that page was meaningful to you. Edit or delete photos and their notes anytime.
Audio Notes
Record your thoughts and insights while reading. Each audio recording includes a real-time timer, custom title, and tag (Insight, Reading, or Knowledge) to help you organize your thoughts. Play back your recordings on both the detail and edit screens. Audio files are stored locally on your device.
Complete Local Storage
All your data—records, photos, and audio files—are stored locally on your device. Your reading memories remain private and secure, with no cloud sync or internet connection required. Your data stays with you.
Easy Organization & Search
- Browse your recent records on the home screen with beautiful card layouts
- View record count, image count, audio count, and notes preview on each card
- Search through all your records by title or author using the search bar
- View detailed information for each book record including all photos and audio
- Edit or delete records as needed
- Pull down to refresh your record list
Beautiful iOS Design
Lirevo features a clean, modern interface with iOS-native Cupertino design patterns. The intuitive bottom tab navigation (Home, Records, Settings) makes it easy to create, view, and manage your reading records. Enjoy smooth animations and responsive layouts optimized for all iPhone screen sizes.
Privacy & Security
Your reading data stays on your device. We don't collect, sync, or share your personal information. All records, photos, and audio files are stored locally for your privacy and security. No account registration required.
Perfect For:
- Book enthusias

Live the offroad life. Build your truck, trailer your jetski, drive ATVs, monster trucks & dirt bikes across open-world trails or even design your own maps with the Map Maker. The mobile offroad sandbox where you choose your adventure.
DRI
bluejetty:00066173:ios.description:
Live the offroad life. Build your truck, trailer your jetski, drive ATVs, monster trucks & dirt bikes across open-world trails or even design your own maps with the Map Maker. The mobile offroad sandbox where you choose your adventure.
DRIVE EVERYTHING
Trucks. Jeeps. Semi trucks. ATVs. SxS. Monster trucks. Rock crawlers. Dirt bikes. Snowmobiles. Jet skis. Boats. Drones. Every vehicle has its own physics. Pickup truck for the mud bog. SxS for the dunes. Dirt bike for the hill climb. Jeep for the rock trail. Big-rig semi for the long haul. Snowbikes for the snow. Boat for the lake. This isn't just an offroad driving game it's an offroad sandbox in your palms.
BUILD YOUR RIG
Complete control over how you build, set up, and drive your truck. Tune the suspension from stiffness, damping, travel, to axle type. Swap to an independent front suspension and a solid rear if you want a modern truck with a custom setup. Diesel swaps. Engine upgrades. Liveries, decals, wraps. The deepest truck customization in any mobile offroad game.
JOBS & ROLEPLAY
Hook a trailer full of boulders and run a delivery. Hitch up a jet ski and back it down to the water. Drop in and complete different jobs. Chase crates across the map to earn money, or hand the keys to your imagination. YOU make your own trail rules.
MAP MAKER
Want to build your own trail? Offroad Outlaws comes with a full Map Maker suite. Design your own maps, share them with the community, and play maps other players have built. From mud bogs to rock crawls to drag strips. If you can imagine it, you can build it.
MULTIPLAYER
Explore the trails with your friends or other players, or battle it out in different modes. Race up mountains, rock trails, or through rivers with friends. Offroad is more fun together.
CONTROLS
Tilt, arrow, or on-screen steering wheel you choose your control scheme.

You will be charged $9.99 for the first month, or $29.99 for the first year, immediately after your purchase is confirmed. bluejetty:00144621:ios.name: Quartzo - Bill Organizer
bluejetty:00144621:ios.summary:
Quartzo is the simple bill organizer and expense tracker that shows where your money goes, what's due this week and how much you'll have left at the end of the month. Log an expense in seconds and see your balance before it happens.
KNOW W
bluejetty:00144621:ios.description:
Quartzo is the simple bill organizer and expense tracker that shows where your money goes, what's due this week and how much you'll have left at the end of the month. Log an expense in seconds and see your balance before it happens.
KNOW WHAT'S LEFT
• Current and projected balance: see what has already come in and gone out, and what will be left after this period's bills and expected income.
• Your month's cash flow and balance in one place, with easy period navigation.
• A home screen that fits you: choose which sections appear, and in what order, for each wallet.
NEVER MISS A BILL AGAIN
• Recurrences and installment plans: set them up once and Quartzo takes care of what comes next.
• Pending bills at a glance: see what's overdue and what's due in the coming days, and mark it paid with one tap.
• Reminders before the due date and a daily summary of your bills.
BUDGETS THAT WARN YOU EARLY
• Set limits by category and see how much room is left this month.
• Get an alert when a budget is close to its limit or goes over.
UNDERSTAND YOUR SPENDING
• Monthly and yearly trends, compared with the same period before.
• Top categories, notable changes and automatic insights.
• Search by name, category, wallet or note, and filter by period, type and amount range.
ORGANIZED YOUR WAY
• Multiple wallets: checking, credit card, home, travel, business, each with its own balance.
• Wallets in other currencies.
• Categories with an emoji or a brand logo, which also shows on your transactions.
• Attach receipts and invoices with the camera or from your photos.
WIDGETS AND LOCK SCREEN
• Bills due, Overdue bills, Bills this week and Month overview widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen.
• Pay a bill right from the widget without opening the app.
• This month's bills calendar on your Lock Screen as a Live Activity.
• Add an expense or income straight from a widget.
SHORTCUTS AND AUTOMATIONS
• Apple Pay logs itself: pay with a tap and the expense lands in Quartzo with the amount and the store.
• Shortcuts actions to add transactions, check a wallet's balance, see this month's spending and open the bills calendar.
• Step-by-step guides in the app get everything set up in under a minute.
PRIVATE AND IN SYNC
• Your data stays in your iCloud and syncs across iPhone and iPad.
• Face ID or Touch ID lock.
• No account to create and no bank login required.
• Light, dark or automatic theme, with a layout built for iPad too.
QUARTZO PRO
Unlock the whole app: unlimited wallets, categories and budgets, automatic entries, full trends, reminders and daily summary, Lock Screen calendar, attachments, brand logos, wallets in other currencies and biometric lock.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.
Download Quartzo and start every month knowing exactly where your money is.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.quartzo.app/privacy.html

bluejetty:00115178:ios.description:
Ever wondered what your future baby might look like? With AI Baby Maker: Future Face, you can turn imagination into reality using AI. Upload your own photo or a pair of photos, such as you and your partner, or even two celebrities - and get a realistic image of your potential child in seconds.
This fun and intuitive app uses advanced AI to create adorable baby photos, beautifully framed in a digital photo album or picture frame. Whether you're just curious, sharing laughs with friends or capturing cute little moments - AI Baby Maker: Future Face makes it simple and fun!
Main Features:
• Couple Mode: Upload two photos - yours and a partner's (or celebs) for paired generation
• AI Baby Generation: Create a realistic baby face with smart face merging
• Gender Selection: Choose the preferred gender for your generated baby
• Simple Upload: Take a new photo or select from your gallery
• Save & Share: Easily save to your device or share with friends
• Animated Preview: Enjoy a playful animation during image generation
• Mockups: See your generated baby in a sweet photo frame or collage layout
Sweet, fun, and surprisingly realistic - AI Baby Maker: Future Face lets you explore future family moments in a unique and heartwarming way. Whether you’re creating keepsakes or sharing giggles - it's a lovely app to enjoy little “what-if” dreams.

bluejetty:00071549:ios.description:
Welcome to BabyBus Kids! It's an amazing world that brings together kids' games, creative exploration, early learning, songs, and cartoons!
Here, you can enjoy lots of baby games, role-playing games, cooking games, pet games, and learning games; watch exciting animated videos, and learn and grow with Kiki and Miumiu through fun and play.
EXPLORE A WORLD FULL OF SURPRISES
Create your own avatar, princess, or baby character, and mix and match outfits, accessories, and hairstyles! Interact with countless items around town, explore places like hospitals, malls, and amusement parks, and discover endless possibilities in town!
CREATE, IMAGINE, AND DESIGN
Come play dress-up games and coloring games and unleash your creativity to your heart's content! Design dresses for princesses of different skin tones, create makeup looks, join balls, and socialize freely. Play elegant piano pieces or add various colors to your artwork!
UNLEASH YOUR INNER CHEF
Cook and decorate to create a feast with your own hands in the cooking game: ice cream, burgers, pizza, Chinese cuisine, Japanese cuisine, French cuisine—every dish is your creative stage!
ENJOY HEARTWARMING PET GAMES
Meet adorable animal friends—cats, dogs, ponies, ants, and more! Take care of them, feed them, and learn about love and responsibility through fun animal games!
Start Exciting Daily Stories
Play as doctors, police officers, dentists, teachers, farmers, and more. Play, explore, and create freely! Be anyone you want and tell your own story!
ADVENTURE NEVER ENDS
Embark on epic adventures! Meet dinosaur friends, outsmart witches, beat dragons, scream your heart out at amusement parks, and fly airplanes across the sky! Enjoy endless excitement and thrills!
 LEARN IMPORTANT LIFE SKILLS
Through engaging nursery rhymes, animations, and games, learn to use the toilet, take baths, even shop at the supermarket, and take care of babies. Gain essential safety knowledge for home, earthquakes, and fire emergencies!
AMAZING NURSERY RHYME AND ANIMATIONS
Enjoy over 1,000 episodes of nursery rhymes and animations, including classics like Baby Shark and Lady Bug, and exciting animations like Sheriff Labrador, Neo's World, Panda Rescue Team, LiaChaCha, and The MeowMi Family.
WHY CHOOSE US?
- 200+ popular BabyBus games;
- Fun themes: cars, dinosaurs, princesses, babies…
- 1,000+ episodes of nursery rhymes and animated videos;
- Beloved characters by your side: Kiki, Miumiu, Sheriff Labrador, and more
- Small memory games: run smoothly without lag;
- Offline games: have fun anytime, anywhere;
- Weekly updates: enjoy new games and adventures;
- Parental control: customize screen time;
- Eye protection mode: care for children's eyes.
—————About BabyBus
BabyBus dedicates to sparking kids' creativity, imagination and curiosity to help kids learn independent thinking, build up self-confidence and respect others. We design our products from the kids' perspective to help them explore the world.
BabyBus offers a wide variety of products, videos and other educational contents for about 500 million fans aged 0-8 around the world! Until now, we have released over 200 educational apps for little kids, over 2500 episodes of cartoons of nursery rhymes with various themes spanning Health, Language, Society, Science, Art and other fields.

bluejetty:00074171:ios.name: wHealth Dashboard
bluejetty:00074171:ios.summary:

Explore more than 120 types of health data through beautiful, easy-to-read charts, trends, statistics and personalized goals. Dis
bluejetty:00074171:ios.description:
Make more of your health data. Discover wHealth.
Your health tells a story. wHealth helps you understand it.
Explore more than 120 types of health data through beautiful, easy-to-read charts, trends, statistics and personalized goals. Discover how your body evolves over time, track your progress and turn your health data into meaningful insights.
YOUR HEALTH. YOUR DATA. YOUR WAY.
Whether you use an iPhone or an Apple Watch, wHealth puts your health data at your fingertips. No Apple Watch required. Seamlessly complement Apple Health with a powerful, customizable dashboard designed around the metrics that matter most to you.
Explore a full year of historical data, compare values across different time periods and uncover trends in your health, sleep, workouts and recovery.
Make wHealth truly yours. Customize your charts, set personal goals, receive helpful notifications, compare your progress and share your reports with your doctor. Add new measurements in seconds, export your data and access your favorite metrics whenever you need them.
KEY FEATURES
iPhone & Apple Watch
- Track more than 120 types of health data.
- Personalize your dashboard and choose exactly which metrics to display and in what order.
- Explore 8 chart types, 30 colors and extensive customization options.
- Set personal goals and follow your progress directly on your charts.
- Get personalized reference values based on your age and sex for supported metrics.
- Add measurements in seconds, including weight, hydration and blood pressure.
- Receive notifications when you reach your goals or when values cross your chosen thresholds.
- Monitor workout performance and recovery.
- Explore sleep sessions with detailed statistics.
- Display up to 50 health metrics directly on your Apple Watch dashboard.
- Access your favorite data through a wide range of Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
- Customize your Apple Watch face with comprehensive complication support.
iPhone features
- Relive outdoor workouts on animated maps showing your route and performance.
- Compare your health data across time periods and specific dates.
- Create personalized graphical reports tailored to your needs (Report Creation in-app purchase required).
- Share health reports with your doctor or performance reports with friends.
- Export your health data to CSV files for further analysis.
HEALTH DATA
Most of your data comes directly from Apple Health (HealthKit). wHealth also supports additional data types not yet available in HealthKit, automatically synchronized between your devices.
YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS
Your health data stays yours. With your permission, wHealth reads data from Apple Health to display your dashboard and can write new measurements when authorized.
Your HealthKit data remains in Apple's HealthKit database and is never transmitted elsewhere by wHealth. Cached data is stored locally on your iPhone and Apple Watch to keep your dashboard responsive, and is automatically deleted when you uninstall the app.
wHealth - A clearer view of your health. Every day.

The Evia hypnotherapy pro
bluejetty:00174408:ios.description:
"Discover the most successful, clinically proven, non-hormonal technique for managing hot flashes during menopause—hypnotherapy." - Dr. Gary Elkins, Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience at Baylor University.
The Evia hypnotherapy program is an easy and effective way to manage menopausal hot flashes naturally. With a program developed by world-leading neuroscientist and menopause researcher, Dr. Gary Elkins, Evia helps you learn how to calm the body's stress response and self-manage hot flashes with evidence-based hypnotherapy. 
Evia is based on evidence-supported hypnotherapy and established clinical guidelines for the management of hot flashes, as recommended by The North American Menopause Society
and the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (RANZCOG). 
In a recent study by Dr. Elkins, published in the International Journal of Clinical and Experimental Hypnosis, women who completed a similar hypnotherapy program reduced their hot flashes by 70-80% after five weeks with continued practice. 
How does it work?
By combining cooling mental imagery, relaxation techniques, and evidenced-based hypnosis, Evia helps you learn to manage your hot flashes by giving you the tools you need to self-regulate how your brain perceives temperature changes during menopause.
With Evia, you can:
- Learn to self-manage hot flashes effectively without medication
- Self-regulate increased anxiety during menopause
- Soothe menopausal sleep problems and night sweats 
- Learn about menopause and hot flashes 
- Track and evaluate your symptoms
What you get:
- A 5-Week Core Program with evidence-based hypnotherapy
- Relaxing 20-minute daily sessions that fit easily into your schedule 
- A supportive Maintenance Program to help you maintain results after five weeks 
- A relaxing Sleep Session
- Daily educational readings about menopause and hot flashes
- In-app chat support from real people
Evia is a self-management tool intended to help people live well with hot flashes during medically diagnosed menopause. It should not replace any medical or professional care, diagnosis, or treatment. Evia is not intended as a treatment for hot flashes and does not replace care by your provider and menopause treatments you may be using. Evia is not a substitute for any medications. You should continue to take your medications as directed by your healthcare provider.
Sign up today to learn to manage hot flashes naturally with Evia!
If you subscribe through iTunes, the credit card associated with your iTunes account will be charged at the end of the 7-day trial period, and your subscription will automatically renew every 3 months thereafter unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. If you do not cancel, your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. If you purchase a subscription during the free trial period, any unused portion of the trial period will be forfeited.
To manage your Evia subscription from iTunes:
1) On your iOS device, go to your device Settings and the 'iTunes & App Stores'
2) Tap on your Apple ID
3) Tap to 'View Apple ID'. (You may need to sign in or use Touch ID.)
4) Tap on 'Subscriptions'
5) Choose 'Evia Subscription'
6) Tap 'Cancel Subscription'

bluejetty:00045301:ios.description:
MainTrack is a comprehensive Bike Maintenance app that will help to keep track of your bikes and components usage, remind you when it's time to service your gear and record all serviced parts and components. 
Wondering when was the last time you changed your front tyre? Or what distance you've ridden with your race wheels? Or when you need to service your suspension? MainTrack will help you to answer these questions and much more.
Features:
 • Connect to Strava to synchronize your activities and update your bikes usage
 • Create Components that you use occasionally or in multiple bikes
 • Assign Components to Bikes for a period of time and keep track of their usage separately based on the bike's activities
 • Plan your bikes maintenance periodically based on period of time, usage, rides or elapsed time.
 • Receive notifications after a ride is completed and when a service is due 
 • Keep track of all services executed
 • Check your bike's parts usage since you last serviced them
 • Synchronize your data across multiple devices
MainTrack is very intuitive and easy to use, with a beaultiful interface design to provide you the best user experience.
