bluejetty:00022270:ios.description:
Are you ready to embark on a journey of brain-boosting fun? 
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of wordplay with Crossword Puzzle Explorer, the definitive crossword puzzle experience that's not only fun but also educational! Best of all, this game is completely free to play!
Whether you're a seasoned crossword enthusiast looking for a new challenge or someone just beginning their crossword journey, Crossword Puzzle Explorer has something special for you. 
Dive into our vast crossword puzzle collection, featuring a diverse range of themes, sizes, and difficulty levels. There's a puzzle for every mood and skill level. 
 Key Features 
- Endless Puzzles: Challenge yourself with an impressive collection of thousands of crossword puzzles that span the spectrum from easy to expert. Whether you have a few minutes or hours to spare, Crossword Explorer always has a puzzle to keep your mind in tip-top shape. 
- Daily Challenges: Are you up for a daily challenge? Crossword Puzzle Explorer offers fresh crossword puzzles every day. Solve them to earn fantastic rewards, hone your crossword-solving skills, and prove your word mastery. 
- Track Your Progress: Keep tabs on your crossword conquests! Unlock a variety of achievements as you conquer crossword after crossword and climb the ranks of wordplay greatness. 
- Themes & Customization: Make your crossword-solving experience uniquely yours! Explore a delightful selection of themes and beautiful backgrounds! 
- Hints & Tips: No one likes getting stuck on a tricky word or clue. That's why we've got you covered with a range of hints and tips to nudge you in the right direction. Keep the crossword-solving momentum going and conquer those challenging puzzles! 
- Educational Fun: Enhance your vocabulary, sharpen your language skills, and boost your knowledge while having an absolute blast! 
Don't miss out on the crossword puzzle adventure of a lifetime. 
Download Crossword Puzzle Explorer now and start exploring the world of words like never before. Challenge yourself, have fun, and let your word-play journey begin!
Write back to us with any issues or suggestions, we are all ears!
Privacy Policy & Terms of Use: https://playsimple.in/privacy

- No se permite la cancelación de una suscripción activa durante el periodo de validez que se haya contratado.

bluejetty:00079166:ios.description:
Peptide Calculator App: Precision at Your Fingertips
Introducing the #1 Peptide Dosage Calculator, the ultimate PepCalc solution for researchers, scientists, and peptide enthusiasts. 
Key Features:
Comprehensive Syringe Options: Choose from U20, U30, U40, U100, and other syringe sizes for versatile calculations, ensuring you have the right tool for any scenario.
Save and Edit Calculations: Calculations are saved automatically, so you can revisit and edit them at your convenience. Add notes to each calculation for better organisation and reference.
Peptide Tracking & History: Keep a clear record of your peptide usage and calculations over time with a built-in peptide tracker. View past entries in a chronological timeline, monitor changes in dosages or ratios, and maintain a consistent log for reference, comparison, and long-term planning
Peptide Reconstitution Guide: Our peptide reconstitution chart provides you with the estimated amount of water required for your peptides, simplifying the reconstitution process.
Mixing Ratios Simplified: Explore and determine the optimal mixing ratios for different peptide sequences with ease, thanks to our intuitive peptide mixing calculator.
Bacteriostatic Water Compatibility: Utilise bacteriostatic water calculations to perfect your mix, ensuring compatibility and precision in your experiments.
Peptide Library Resource: Access a rich peptide library as a resource for your research, enhancing your understanding and application of peptides.
Recalculation Option: Mistakes happen, but our app has you covered with the option to recalculate peptides if incorrect values are selected initially.
PDF Export: Print your results into a PDF for easy sharing, documentation, and record-keeping.
Dark and Light Modes: Choose between dark and light modes to suit your visual preference, making the app accessible at any time, under any lighting condition.
PepCalc is more than just a peptide calculator; it's a research companion that grows with you.
Disclaimer: The App is intended only for educational and laboratory purposes. It is not designed for use by medical professionals and should not be considered a medical guide or tool. Always consult with a local professional and follow your local regulations and guidelines.
Please note:
For using the premium features, a valid in-app purchase is necessary. The payment will be charged to your iTunes account once you confirm the subscription. The subscription gets automatically renewed. However, you can manage the auto-renewal option by using the account settings after making a purchase.

bluejetty:00061088:ios.description:
مع التطور الذي يشهده عالمنا، نحن بحاجة لوسيلة تمكننا من متابعة تدريب السواقة عن كثب، لهذا طورت مجموعة هولوتك تطبيق نظام التدريب الموحد.
بهدف متابعة مستجدات التدريب وكذلك مراجعة الدروس، والاستفادة من الفيديوهات التوعوية، والاختبارات التجريبية، والكثير من الميزات الاخرى..
تطبيق نظام التدريب الموحد:
• يتيح متابعة سير العملية التدريبية للطالب والمدرب والمدرسة.
• يقدم تقارير عن عمليات التدريب والساعات المنجزة.
• يتيح للطالب رؤية جدول التدريب و الاختبارات.
• يوفر كتاب الكتروني بعدة لغات عالمية، والذي يشمل المعلومات النظرية .
• يوضح المخالفات المرورية لدولة قطر.
• يحتوي على جميع الاشارات المرورية، بشكل تفصيلي واختبارات تجريبية بعدة لغات عالمية.
• يوفر فيديوهات توعوية بعدة لغات عالمية.
• يسهل عملية التواصل بين الطالب والمدارس.
يمكن للطالب استخدام التطبيق في أي وقت، حتى بعد الحصول على رخصة السواقة، لمراجعة الإشارات المرورية أو المخالفات أو الغرامات أو أي معلومات أخرى في التطبيق.
كما يحق لكل زوار دولة قطر تحميل التطبيق، للتعرف على القوانين المحلية، والاستفادة من المحتوى.
يمكن للزوار الدخول الى صفحة الفيديوهات التوعوية، والاشارات المرورية والمخالفات المرورية، والغرامات والتواصل مع مدارس السواقة.
In a world of cutting edge technology, Holoteq Group has developed a system that facilitates Driving training and testing. 
Driving Training System
• Tracks the process of training for the student, the trainer and the school. 
• Provides daily reports indicating the students’ progress and the number of training hours completed. 
• Allows the applicant to access the training and the test schedules.
• Offers an electronic book available in multiple languages which covers the theoretical aspects of driving.
• States and explains Qatar traffic violations in multiple languages.
• Covers all the traffic signs in the State of Qatar and provides practice tests in different languages.
• Provides traffic awareness videos in multiple languages.
• Facilitates the communication between the Applicant and the schools.
- Students can access DTS Application even after obtaining the Driving License to retrieve traffic signs, violations, penalties and other information on the app. 
- Access to the application is not limited to Driving students, anyone can access the application as a Visitor.
Visitors can access the awareness videos, Traffic violations, Traffic violation penalties and contact the driving schools.

bluejetty:00168078:ios.description:
Estudio de la Biblia Reina Valera 1960 le presenta una gran ayuda para conocer y estudiar las Santas Escrituras. La Biblia es un libro complejo y muy amplio y siempre es bienvenida una ayuda para comprenderla mejor.
Fabulosos estudios sobre la Biblia que seguro serán de su bendición.
La Biblia está compuesta por 2 testamentos, 66 diferentes libros, 1,189 capítulos, 31,173 versos, y 773,692 palabras. 
Los diferentes libros de la Biblia cubren diferentes temas y fueron dirigidos a diferentes audiencias. Los libros de la Biblia fueron escritos aproximadamente por 40 diferentes hombres, sobre un período de aproximadamente 1500 años. Por esta razón el estudio de la Biblia es una gran empresa.
Estudio de la Biblia Reina Valera 1960 es una estupenda herramienta para estudiar la Biblia tomando en cuenta los pasos de la observación cuidadosa del texto, luego su interpretación, aplicación y correlación. Considera los elementos básicos del plan de salvación y su presentación con claridad.
Integración con Inteligencia Artificial. Puedes hacer preguntas, buscar versículos específicos y recibir explicaciones contextuales sobre pasajes bíblicos. Esta experiencia enriquece la comprensión y acerca a las Escrituras de una manera única.
Estudios bíblicos sobre la doctrina cristiana básica que todo creyente debe saber. Estos principios deben estar incorporados en nosotros para conocer cada día más a este Dios maravilloso que tenemos.
Debemos leer y estudiar la Biblia simplemente porque es la Palabra de Dios a nosotros. 2 Timoteo 3:16 dice que la Biblia es “inspirada por Dios”.
En esta herramienta Estudio de la Biblia Reina Valera 1960 encontrará los siguientes temas de estudio:
- Estudio de la Biblia: Le proporcionamos un conocimiento básico de cada libro de la Biblia. En cada ficha se incluirá el autor, fecha en que se escribió, propósito de su escritura, versos claves y un breve resumen. Esta herramienta le ayudará a entenderla mejor la Biblia y le animará a estudiarla de una manera más profunda. Además, podrás compartir todo el contenido por tus redes sociales favoritas.
- Mundo Bíblico: Es el estudio de la historia de la nación de Israel: los patriarcas, el éxodo, la monarquía, el cisma, el exilio y el destierro.  El curso comienza con el mundo de Abraham y da énfasis en las naciones que tuvieron influencia sobre el pueblo hebreo: Egipto, Asiria, Babilonia, Persia, Grecia y Roma.  También se considera la geografía del medio-oriente y las costumbres en los tiempos bíblicos. 
Profundizar en el conocimiento de la Sagrada Escritura desde la Fe, la Ciencia y la Historia. Comprender la Sagrada Escritura va más allá de saber leerla. La Biblia es un mundo literario, un hermoso entramado entre historia y fe que debe ser enfrentado con las herramientas necesarias para poder comprender lo que se quiso decir entonces y lo que puede decir a la persona de hoy.
Además, la aplicación Estudio de la Biblia Reina Valera 1960 se compone de las siguientes opciones:
- Diccionario Teológico: Totalmente offline para que usted pueda consultar cuando desee todas las definiciones acerca de la teología.
- Como estudiar la Biblia: te enseña por dónde empezar a leerla, la frecuencia con que debes hacerlo, la cantidad que debes leer por cada vez o cómo utilizarla.
- Temas Bíblicos para predicar, que te ayudarán a encontrar esa fortaleza día a día mediante la Biblia y la Palabra de nuestro Señor Jesús.
- Bosquejos para sermones, Estudios Bíblicos, Predicas y mensajes Bíblicos, Evangelio del día, y muchos más recursos Bíblicos
- Biblia Escrita offline Reina Valera 1960: Consulta toda su obra cuando desees.
- Audio Biblia: Relájate y escucha la Biblia tranquilamente.
- Navegación sencilla, rápida e intuitiva.
- No necesita conexión a internet.
Descargue Estudio de la Biblia Reina Valera 1960 y amplíe su conocimiento con una gran cantidad de recursos bíblicos puestos a su alcance. Con esta herramienta podrá profundizar en todos los temas de su agrado e interés.

bluejetty:00147468:ios.name: Best Discount Calculator
bluejetty:00147468:ios.summary: Would you like to be able to know the final price of an item that has been sold off without making the slightest calculation effort? Are you tired of standing still for several minutes in front of a product you want to buy, calculating its
bluejetty:00147468:ios.description:
Would you like to be able to know the final price of an item that has been sold off without making the slightest calculation effort? Are you tired of standing still for several minutes in front of a product you want to buy, calculating its final price? Well, the Calculate Sales application is made for you.
Discount Tax Calculator is a free application that allows you, in just a few clicks, to calculate the final selling price, with or without tax, of products put on sale based on the discount percentage and their initial price.
Only two steps to follow:
Enter the initial price (price before reduction).
Select the discount percentage(s) if the product has been sold several times in a row.
The calculation will be done automatically
Please note that it is possible to add taxes on the final price.
To better understand, here are two examples:
Example 1: You would like to buy a jacket at 30% off. Its initial price is 25€.
Enter the figure "25" in the box "Initial price".
Choose from the percentages displayed, "30%".
The final price (17.5 €) will be displayed automatically.
Example 2: You intend to buy the latest smartphone of your favourite brand. But, smart as you are, you've been waiting for the right opportunity to do so: THE SALES!
Good news, the smartphone that initially cost €1259.99 is on sale at 5% off. Except that, for you, 5% won't change much from its initial price. So you try to find promotion codes on the Internet... And BINGO 20% discount offered by one of them. However, this discount does not exclude the first one, it becomes cumulative to it.
Enter the number "1259.99" in the "Initial price" box.
Select, in the first place, from the percentages displayed, "5%".
Choose "20%" from the displayed percentages in the second place.
The final price (957.59€) will be displayed automatically.
Discount Calculator will save you a lot of time because the calculation of the discount will not only be accurate but also very fast. It will also protect you from the illusions of some stores that try to make you believe that buying a certain product on sale is really a bargain you shouldn't miss.
Enjoy the sales without worrying about the math! With Discount Calculator Tax your shopping days with your friends or family will be a real pleasure! You will know in advance if buying this famous product, which you've been eyeing for a long time, and which is finally sold out is a good deal or not.
You can also find out how much you have saved thanks to the promotions. This amount will be displayed just below the word "Discount" at the top of the screen.
Fast, accurate and efficient calculation.
Very easy to use application.
Huge time saving.
Take advantage of the sales between your friends and family! Don't worry about the calculation anymore!
During sales, don't waste time! Download the app !
Count on Discount Calculator Tax for your next shopping spree!
Add the VAT if it is not added
Bookmark different tax rates

bluejetty:00060824:ios.summary: ACC Mobile 3 extends the power of Avigilon Control Center™ video management software to mobile devices, enabling security professionals to efficiently monitor ACCTM systems and to quickly respond to incidents anytime and from any location t
bluejetty:00060824:ios.description:
ACC Mobile 3 extends the power of Avigilon Control Center™ video management software to mobile devices, enabling security professionals to efficiently monitor ACCTM systems and to quickly respond to incidents anytime and from any location that has network connectivity. The ACC Mobile 3 app works together with Avigilon Cloud Services to provide secure remote access to your cloud-connected ACC 7 sites, alleviating the need for any complicated firewall configuration.
With the ACC Mobile 3 app, users can:
• Sign in using Avigilon Cloud Services credentials for seamless access to an organization’s cloud-connected ACC 7 sites using firewall traversal
• Directly connect to ACC 6 sites or ACC 7 sites not connected to Avigilon Cloud Services by specifying a IP address or hostname, port, and ACC credentials for each one
• View live or recorded video from any H.264 or H.265 cameras connected to ACC sites
• Efficiently stream live or recorded HD video from Avigilon cameras using High Definition Stream Management (HDSM)™ technology to optimize the use of network bandwidth
• Receive push alarm notifications to quickly detect, verify, and act on events such as motion or video analytic rule triggers
• View analytic bounding boxes for detected people and vehicles in video from Avigilon cameras with self-learning analytics
• Use audio talk down to deter an intruder by broadcasting voice audio to cameras with connected speakers (not available for ACC Core edition)
• Listen to live or recorded audio from cameras with a connected microphone (not available for ACC Core edition)
• Easily review recorded video using the recorded video timeline
• Control PTZ cameras including running tours and moving to defined presets
• View live video from multiple cameras at a time using selectable view layouts
ACC Mobile 3 is available for use with ACC Core, Standard, and Enterprise edition sites. Whether connecting through Avigilon Cloud Services (ACC 7.4.4.14 or a more recent version) or directly (ACC 6.2.0 or a more recent version), ACC Mobile 3 requires ACC sites to be running the ACC Web Endpoint component. The ACC Web Endpoint is pre-installed on Avigilon Network Video Recorders (NVRs) and High Definition Video Appliances (HDVAs), is part of the firmware for ACC ES Recorders and ACC ES Appliances, and is available as a separate download for any server running on Windows.

bluejetty:00074375:ios.description:
Your daily Financial Times newspaper, delivered to your device when it goes to print. Now with search to quickly find and save articles across editions.
WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM THE FT APP
• View global print editions editions in 3 reading modes
• Editor-curated news in a classic newspaper layout
• Exclusive digital access to FT magazines normally available only in print
• Translate articles into 30+ languages
• Access previous editions of the newspaper dating back 15 years
APP FEATURES:
• Search for and save articles across editions
• Listen to articles with AI audio
• Download editions to read offline
• Set alerts to stay ahead of the day's news
• Change the font size for easier reading
EXCLUSIVE MAGAZINES INCLUDE:
• HTSI (formerly ‘How To Spend It’): The FT's weekly, multi-award-winning luxury lifestyle magazine covering fashion, design, and the arts
• FT Weekend Magazine: A supplement to the weekend edition of the Financial Times, featuring long-form journalism, investigations, photography, and international reporting
• FT Wealth: Insights into wealth management and luxury living
• The Art of Fashion: A special edition exploring the intersection of art and fashion
• Business Education: Insights into executive education, MBA programs, and leadership development
READING MODES
• Headline view for quick browsing
• Article view optimized for reading
• Replica view to enjoy the full newspaper layout
IS FT DIGITAL EDITION FOR YOU?
Whether you're navigating global markets, exploring culture, or seeking fresh perspectives, the FT Digital Edition delivers expert, independent journalism you can trust.
From Wall Street to Hong Kong, FT covers markets, politics, technology, climate policy, and industry-leading social research. Track economic shifts, follow business trends, and explore cultural movements with FT’s analysis and expertise.
With reporting from over 50 countries, translation available in 30+ languages, and exclusive magazine content—including HTSI, FT Weekend Magazine, and FT Wealth—the FT Digital Edition is for those who think critically about the world. Whether you're planning your next trip to a cultural capital, deepening your understanding of global finance, or seeking fresh literary and lifestyle insights, stay engaged, informed, and inspired with FT.
FINANCIAL TIMES ADVANTAGE:
• Accurate, independent, and insightful journalism since 1888
• Unbiased reporting: expert commentary and analysis on business, politics, economics, finance, and more
• Coverage across arts, real estate, fashion, food, books, technology, and beyond
WHAT DOES IT COST?
The FT Digital Edition offers comprehensive coverage and great value. Monthly pricing starts from $12.99, with discounts available for longer terms.
Subscribe via the app or at https://www.ft.com/todaysnewspaper
Terms and conditions apply. Read them at ft.com/terms
We respect your privacy. Read our privacy policy at ft.com/privacy

bluejetty:00044640:ios.description:
Reimagine the way you collect and track your receipts. Introducing QuickReceipts, a mobile app designed to help you collect both your paper and email receipts. 
QuickReceipts is the only receipt tracking app that allows you to seamlessly scan your paper receipts and automatically import email receipts directly from your inbox. This app saves you valuable time by saving all of your receipts in one place.
The goal of QuickReceipts is simple: to help consumers go paperless with receipts. Paper receipts are a hassle to manage - they’re easy to lose track of and take up space in your pocket, purse, and drawer. Easily save them to QuickReceipts with a couple simple steps.
Alternatively, you can eliminate the need to snap pictures of paper receipts and start automating the way you collect and organize your receipts. You can automatically import your email receipts* directly into QuickReceipts. We utilize the latest iPhone capabilities to process receipts on your device, ensuring your data stays safe and private on your device.   QuickReceipts is free to use, but you can upgrade to QuickReceipts Pro for up to 100 custom tags, secure cloud backup, and multi-device access. Perfect for freelancers, consultants, and anyone managing receipts across multiple projects.
Features:
- Access your paper and digital receipts in one place
- Scan paper receipts and use our on-device processing to extract vendor, address, total, tax, tip, date, and time
- Upload pictures of paper receipts from your photo album
- Manually create receipt entries
- Automatically sync your last month of receipts in your inbox
- Import additional email receipts as needed
- Get notified of new email receipts in your Gmail inbox
- Search your inbox and import emails directly from the app
- Create customized tags to categorize purchases (up to 10 free, 100 with Pro)
- Multi-select and bulk edit multiple receipts
- Add notes and flag receipts for easy reminder 
- Create expense reports by date range and tags
- Export receipts by PDF, CSV, and ZIP file
- Secure cloud backups of your data
- Quick share receipts using a share sheet
- Filter and sort your receipts
- Create folders to organize your receipts 
- Track spending with helpful spending overviews
- Look at purchases by vendor
- Enhanced Insights to help you dig deeper on spending trends
- Custom reminder notifications
- Utilize Quick Insights, our on-device purchase intelligence 
- Modernized design with functionality familiar to iOS users
- Consumer privacy friendly with on-device processing and intelligence
* Note: QuickReceipts is only compatible with Gmail inboxes at the moment. Access to different email inboxes will be released down the road.
QuickReceipts is compatible with Gmail inboxes and available exclusively for iOS devices in the United States and Canada. We’re always updating and adding new features to the app, so stay tuned for more!
The future of receipts is here - download QuickReceipts now and get started for FREE. If you want more from the app, QuickReceipts Pro is available. What you get from Pro:
- Up to 100 custom tags to organize receipts your way
- Access receipts from multiple devices
- Batch import more receipts from your inbox
- Enhanced insights to dive deeper into spending patterns
Pro is available for $6.99 per month or $69.99 per year. Subscriptions renew automatically - cancel anytime. Learn more about Pro on our website.
Ready for a better way to manage your receipts? Get started today!
Have a feature request or need help? Email us at support@quickreceipts.co
Apple standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
QuickReceipts Terms of Use: https://quickreceipts.co/terms

bluejetty:00061226:ios.description:
Jesus Calling is your yearlong guide to living a more peaceful life. The Jesus Calling App is the mobile version of the time-tested classic packed with digital and audio features that make this daily devotional more accessible than ever. 
Experience a deeper relationship with Jesus as you savor the presence of the One who understands you perfectly and loves you forever. With Scripture and personal reflections, New York Times bestselling author Sarah Young brings Jesus' message of peace—for today and every day.
By spending time in the presence of the Savior with the much-loved devotions from Sarah Young, you will:
• Feel comforted by a daily word of hope and encouragement
• Be reassured of Jesus' unending blessings and love for you
• Receive gentle guidance based on daily Scripture readings
• Connect with Jesus further with reflection and meditation based on God’s Word
Written as if Jesus Himself is speaking directly to you, Jesus Calling invites you to experience peace in the presence of the Savior who is always with you. 
These writings are personal reflections based on Jesus’ own words of hope, guidance, and peace within Scripture—penned by one who loved Him and revered His Word. The Bible is the only infallible, inerrant Word of God, and author Sarah Young kept her writings consistent with that unchanging standard during her lifetime. She wrote from the perspective of Jesus speaking, to help readers feel more personally connected with Him. So, the first person singular (“I,” “Me,” “My,” “Mine”) always refers to Christ; “you” refers to you, the reader.
Jesus Calling’s Terms of Use are available at https://www.harpercollinschristian.com/terms/

bluejetty:00126520:ios.description:
Need a postcode or postbox fast? We’ve got you covered.
Making deliveries or driving a cab? Filling out paperwork that needs your full postcode? Or maybe you’re trying to find the nearest postbox or post office?
No worries. Just open the app and sort it in seconds.
You can also search for a postcode by address or tap anywhere on the map to get the one you need. Save your favourite places too and look them up later when it suits you.
Got an Apple Watch? Brilliant. Your current postcode is just a tap away, right on your wrist.
Fun fact: Some British Overseas Territories have their own UK postcodes:
• TDCU 1ZZ – Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
• BBND 1ZZ – British Indian Ocean Territory
• BIQQ 1ZZ – British Antarctic Territory
• FIQQ 1ZZ – Falkland Islands
• GX11 1AA – Gibraltar
• PCRN 1ZZ – Pitcairn Islands
• SIQQ 1ZZ – South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
• TKCA 1ZZ – Turks and Caicos Islands
Please be aware that using this app will requite you to use a subscription.

bluejetty:00195254:android.description:
Manage your crypto portfolio, create watchlists, and analyze trading charts for over 20,000 digital assets in one app - TabTrader Crypto Terminal. Trade Bitcoin and altcoins seamlessly, as TabTrader is also a multi exchange crypto trading platform.
TabTrader is a cross-platform app syncing across Android, iOS, and Web. Data are aggregated through APIs to provide accurate and timely cryptocurrency prices, trade volumes, and market caps. The app lets you stay informed and empowered to react to trends, ensuring you never miss a trade opportunity.
SUPPORTED CRYPTO EXCHANGES
The TabTrader multi exchange crypto trading platform is supported by the leading CEXs, including:
• Binance
• Bitfinex
• Bitget
• BitMEX
• Bitstamp
• Bybit
• Coinbase Advanced
• EXMO
• Gate.io
• Gemini
• HitBTC
• Huobi
• Indodax
• Kraken
• KuCoin
• Mercado Bitcoin
• MEXC
• NovaDAX
• OKX
• Poloniex
• Whitebit
CUSTOM CRYPTO TRADING CHARTS
What sets TabTrader apart from other crypto trading tools is our mobile-optimized user interface that you can personalize. Here’s what you can do with our charts:
• Customizable charting tool and layouts with pre-configured user preferences for faster technical analysis
• Diverse types of crypto trading charts, including Heikin Ashi
• Over 30 technical indicators, including Moving Averages, Bollinger Bands, MACD, RSI, Ichimoku Cloud, and Stochastic Oscillator
• Volume Delta tools
• Comprehensive drawing tools for technical analysis, including Fibonacci levels and parallel channels
HIGH-SPEED AND SEAMLESS PERFORMANCE
TabTrader is a one-stop solution for spot and futures crypto trading. Trade crypto from a single, responsive, and intuitive crypto terminal interface designed for seasoned traders and newcomers alike. Experience lightning-fast, real-time data updates and instantaneous order execution, ensuring you never miss a critical trading opportunity. 
CRYPTO MANAGEMENT AND WATCHLISTS
Seamlessly connect your exchange accounts via API keys to TabTrader and track your whole crypto portfolio in a single dashboard. Additionally, you can leverage the app’s advanced crypto watchlists and built-in screener to discover trading opportunities easily.
CRYPTO PRICE AND TECHNICAL ALERTS
Stay ahead of the trends with the fastest crypto price alerts on the market. And with our newest feature, technical alerts, you will get notifications triggered by specified technical indicator conditions or thresholds. Now you can act quickly on signals based on your technical analysis without having to monitor crypto trading charts constantly.
ROBUST SECURITY MEASURES
Trade confidently knowing your assets and personal information are protected by robust security measures, including PIN-code authentication, biometric authentication (FaceID), and industry-standard two-factor authentication (2FA).
DEDICATED CUSTOMER SUPPORT
For assistance, reach out to us through the app or join our active Telegram communities. We're dedicated to promptly addressing your queries and concerns.
PRO AND ULTRA SUBSCRIPTIONS
With a TabTrader PRO or ULTRA subscription, you can unlock a range of advanced crypto trading tool features and capabilities that will take your trading experience to the next level.
Compare plans here: https://tabtrader.com/pro
GROWING COMMUNITY
Join a global community of over 400,000 active users across 150 countries who trust TabTrader with their trading journey. Connect with fellow crypto traders, learn from their experiences, and level up your crypto trading skills by going here:
https://tab-trader.com/communities

bluejetty:00087916:ios.description:
This app is the command center for your Velop system and Linksys Smart WiFi routers. Use the Linksys app anywhere you have an internet connection to check connected devices, set up guest access, or keep your kids off the internet when they should be doing homework.
KEY FEATURES
• Remote Access – All you need is the internet.
• Dashboard – Your WiFi's vital stats on one page.
• Guest Access – Give friends internet access, but keep personal data secure.
• Device Prioritization – Improve streaming and online gaming by giving WiFi priority to favored devices.
• Network Security - Be proactive against network threats and malicious sites with Linksys Shield.
• Parental Controls – Encourage kids' healthy internet behavior by pausing internet access.
Privacy Policy: https://www.linksys.com/embed/lswf/en-us/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://www.linksys.com/embed/lswf/en-us/terms/
SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS*
• Velop systems and Linksys Smart WiFi routers. Full list of supported routers: http://www.LinksysSmartWiFi.com/cloud/ustatic/mobile/supportedRouters.html
• User account (created in the app or at http://www.LinksysSmartWiFi.com) connected to your Linksys product.
• iOS 14.0 and greater
For additional help, visit our support site at http://support.linksys.com

bluejetty:00185200:ios.description:
Major Mayhem is the biggest, baddest, fast, funny run-and-gun arcade shooter there is — tap to shoot, duck for cover, blast those enemies into last decade!
Meet the newest recruit in the Rocket Jump Games army: Major Mayhem. He's got an itchy trigger finger, some scratchy stubble, and a fondness for shooting first and asking no questions. Run and gun your way through gorgeous 3D environments as you embark on a mission to rescue your girlfriend from the Forces of Evil. Guns, grenades and an assortment of other tools of destruction are at your disposal, and you'll need every last one of 'em. So what are you waiting for, Major Mayhem? The future of the Free World -- and your love life -- hangs in the balance.
FEATURES:
• 45 levels of non-stop gun shooting action
• Offline gun gaming at its finest
• 100 achievements to prove your aim and shoot skills
• 150 mini mission objectives to keep the blood pumping
• 5 power ups give you arcade style action at your fingertips
• Battle your way past hordes of enemies in three picturesque 3d environments
• 20 unique weapons in your arsenal to deal out MAJOR MAYHEM! Think Rocket Launchers, Sniper Rifles, and the incredible Chicken Cannon!
• Survival Mode — last as long as you can against endless waves and climb the global leaderboards
• Master your gun slinging skills in multiple game modes, from frantic Run 'n Gun to high-score Survival
• Online leaderboards — prove you're the baddest trigger finger on the planet
• Epic boss battles await around every turn. Show them who's boss
• Pick-up-and-play arcade action — easy to learn, brutal when mastered
• 42 costumes and hats to keep the Major's fashion conscience clear when dealing massive devastation!
• Save the world, and your girlfriend
No wifi? No problem. Major Mayhem plays fully offline — frantic run-and-gun shooting anytime, anywhere. Get the best gun shooting action on the Play Store, NOW!

✔ Energy-Efficient: Optimized to track your activity smoothly without affecting battery performance.

bluejetty:00180852:ios.name: The United Methodist Hymnal
bluejetty:00180852:ios.summary: This is the official iPad edition of The United Methodist Hymnal (1989) authorized by The United Methodist Publishing House. The app includes page scans of the hymnal, powerful search capabilities, information about songs and their authors,
bluejetty:00180852:ios.description:
This is the official iPad edition of The United Methodist Hymnal (1989) authorized by The United Methodist Publishing House. The app includes page scans of the hymnal, powerful search capabilities, information about songs and their authors, and the ability to access several different versions of songs including pew, large print, lead sheet, and instrumental (strings, brass, and woodwinds).
This free app includes the 281 public domain songs in The United Methodist Hymnal. Through in-app purchases, you can add the following editions which includes all public domain and most copyrighted hymns:
 • Pew edition for the complete hymnal* ($24.99)
 • Keyboard edition for the complete hymnal** ($24.99)
 • Large Print edition for the complete hymnal** ($19.99)
 • FlexScore edition for the complete hymnal** ($99.99)
 • Transposed editions (scores for specific instruments) for the complete hymnal** ($39.99)
 • Individual FlexScores – one version of one song ($1.99)
 • Individual FlexScores – all versions of one song ($9.99)
* Hymns and services only
** Hymns only, no services or readings
Many songs include links to resources for background information and for worship planning, such as related scripture passages, topics, worship notes on the text and tune, PowerPoint slides, and available choral and instrumental arrangements. 
The search box allows you to search for songs by first line, author, composer, topic, or scripture passages quoted or alluded to. You can also jump immediately to a hymn by number.
Our revolutionary FlexScores are available for most songs. Through FlexScores you can adjust the music and text size of the scores, transpose the key, and change capo. The versions offered for FlexScores include pew, lead sheet, violin, viola, cello, bass, flute, clarinet, oboe, bassoon, alto saxophone, soprano or tenor saxophone, horn, trumpet, trombone, and tuba. For instrumental versions, the music is transposed into an appropriate range and displayed in an appropriate clef for the instrument (based on the same part arrangement of the printed hymnal).
You may use the "setlist" feature to pre-arrange hymns in your preferred order (for example, the song sequence in a worship service). When you "play" the "setlist" you can go to the next pre-determined songs with one flip!
Flip the page with a foot pedal! With an optional, Bluetooth enabled, foot pedal (bought separately) you may turn pages back and forth using a compatible foot pedal. A great convenience for instrumental players!
IMPORTANT NOTES:
 - This app does NOT play any audio of hymns.
 - A network connection is required to access hymn background information, and view most FlexScores.
 - While editions (such as the Pew Edition or FlexScore Edition) of the hymnal can be transferred to other devices, individual FlexScores -- both the $1.99 and $9.99 versions -- cannot be transferred to other devices.
 - Due to copyright permissions, we cannot display the following hymns in the app, even after you purchase one of the editions of the hymnal: 132, 161, 499, 632, and 728. We are continually working on gathering the necessary permissions to display such hymns.

bluejetty:00121561:ios.description:
Meet AstroClub, the astrology app built to help you feel ready for what’s next.
What happens next in your love life? Which opportunities are worth taking? What should you prepare for over the next 90 days? AstroClub helps you understand the patterns around you with personalized astrology, tarot, and guidance based on your birth chart, so you can move into your next chapter feeling more prepared, not just waiting for fate to decide.
WHAT IS ASTROCLUB?
AstroClub is a personal astrology and guidance app built around your birth details and the questions that matter to you. Instead of generic horoscopes, every reading, insight, and conversation is shaped by your own astrological profile. Ask Skye, your personal astrology guide, about love, relationships, timing, money, work, change, and the decisions you are facing, and get personalized perspectives and follow-up questions, not generic answers.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
Enter your birth details and AstroClub builds your astrological profile. From there, explore personalized readings, daily horoscopes, and tarot, or ask Skye the question that is already on your mind. Discover the themes, turning points, opportunities, and emotional shifts that may shape the months ahead, so you can reflect, plan, and choose your next move with more confidence.
KEY FEATURES
— Ask Skye Anything: Talk with your personal astrology guide about love, relationships, timing, money, work, and big decisions. Skye uses your astrological profile to offer personalized perspectives and follow-up questions.
— 90-Day Outlook: See the themes, turning points, and opportunities that may shape the next three months, so you can prepare instead of react.
— Love Life Insights: Explore compatibility, relationship dynamics, future possibilities, and the patterns you repeat in love, whether you are dating, committed, healing, or wondering about someone specific.
— Personalized Readings: Unlock readings about love, life chapters, timing, personal growth, money, and major decisions, shaped by your birth details and your questions.
— Daily Horoscope and Current Transits: Know what is happening in the sky today and how it connects to your chart.
— Birth Chart and Astrology Profile: Get a detailed look at your chart and what it says about you.
— Tarot Readings: Draw cards and explore their interpretations for the questions on your mind.
— Compatibility and Relationship Insights: Look at your connections from a new angle.
— Moon Phases, Affirmations, and Meditations: Pause, reset, and align with the rhythm of the moment.
— Personalized Recommendations: Get guidance for your energy and timing, tailored to you.
WHO USES ASTROCLUB?
People wondering what comes next in love and relationships. People facing a decision about work, money, or a major life change. Anyone who wants to understand the patterns they repeat and the timing around them. Curious beginners and longtime astrology fans who want guidance that feels personal, not generic.
HOW TO GET STARTED
Enter your birth details to create your astrology profile
Explore your daily horoscope, birth chart, and personalized readings
Ask Skye the question that is already on your mind
AstroClub is a place to pause, understand what may be changing, and move into your next chapter feeling more prepared. Your next chapter may start sooner than you think.
SUBSCRIPTION
AstroClub offers In-app Purchases to unlock premium content such as meditations, a detailed birth chart, and unlimited tarot readings, with price varying depending on your subscription period. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.

bluejetty:00017668:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00017668:ios.description:
No App Bradesco Cartões, você faz a gestão do seu cartão de crédito Bradesco e Bradescard de forma rápida, segura e personalizada.
Faça o parcelamento de uma compra realizada, consulte extratos futuros, limite disponível e cartão virtual. Confira essas e muitas outras funcionalidades para seu cartão Bradesco.
No aplicativo Bradesco Cartões você encontra:
- Consulta de faturas: faça a gestão dos seus gastos, consulta de parcelas do seu cartão de crédito, limite disponível do cartão para compra e saque e controle dos valores futuros da fatura.
- Parcelamento pós-compra: parcele uma compra feita à vista (nacional ou internacional) no cartão de crédito em parcelas com juros. Você pode parcelar sua compra diretamente pelo app Bradesco Cartões, na opção Fatura. É rápido, fácil e pode te ajudar a organizar melhor o orçamento.
- Pagamento programado da fatura: realize o agendamento da data de pagamento automático da fatura do seu cartão. Esse serviço é exclusivo para correntistas que têm cartão de crédito com opção de pagamento por boleto.
- Antecipação de pagamento: escolha antecipar o pagamento total ou parcial da sua fatura.
- Gerencie seus cartões Bradesco e Bradescard com praticidade. Consulte a melhor data de compra, acompanhe transações em tempo real e acesse seu histórico de compras. bluejetty:00045308:ios.summary: Coupons, nutritional scoring, prescription savings, balance inquiries, and more – LifeInCheck™ EBT helps you afford more food, save money on prescriptions, check your benefit balance, and simplifies healthy shopping with easy-to-use, produc
bluejetty:00045308:ios.description:
Coupons, nutritional scoring, prescription savings, balance inquiries, and more – LifeInCheck™ EBT helps you afford more food, save money on prescriptions, check your benefit balance, and simplifies healthy shopping with easy-to-use, product-specific nutritional information. With LifeInCheck™ EBT, you are directly connected with your State SNAP/food stamp provider – know, in real-time, if anything changes with your benefits.
Feature Overview
• Balance Inquiries – Review real-time benefit balances on the homepage
• Benefit Schedule – Know your next SNAP deposit date
• Transaction History – Remember where you last shopped and how much was spent
• Card Management – Select PIN and/or deactivate/request an EBT card
• Self-Service – Access FAQs and troubleshoots
• Retailer Locator – Find nearby SNAP-approved retailers via zip code
• Language Preferences – Available in English, Spanish and Vietnamese 
LifeInCheck™ EBT is available in the following States: Louisiana
To register, you will need your EBT card and personal information. If you have already registered through LifeInCheckEBT.com, then you are ready to use the app – simply enter in your existing username and password after downloading.
Disclosures:
• App usage is free; however, message and data rates may apply.
• LifeInCheck™ EBT is a trademark of Morse, Inc. in the United States and/or other countries.

bluejetty:00041080:ios.description:
CalScan: Your AI Calorie & Nutrition Tracker
Welcome to CalScan, the cutting-edge app designed to make calorie counting and nutrition tracking effortless and accurate. Whether you're embarking on a weight loss journey or simply aiming to maintain a balanced diet, CalScan is your perfect companion. Harness the power of advanced AI technology to instantly recognize and analyze your food, giving you precise nutritional insights in seconds.
Key Features:
Snap & Analyze: AI Food Recognition Capture a photo of your meal, and let CalScan handle the rest. Our sophisticated AI instantly identifies the food, calculating calories and key nutrients to provide you with an immediate and detailed nutritional profile.
Text Input: Quick & Accurate Food Logging Prefer typing? Simply describe your meal in text, and CalScan will accurately identify and calculate the calories and nutrients, making meal logging quick and easy.
Barcode Scanning: Instant Nutritional Data Scan the barcode on food packages to access a comprehensive database of nutritional information. Get instant calorie counts and nutrient details with just a quick scan.
Why Choose CalScan:
AI-Powered Efficiency: Leverage the latest in AI technology for fast and accurate food recognition and calorie calculation.
User-Friendly Interface: Designed for ease of use, CalScan makes tracking your diet simple and straightforward.
Comprehensive Nutritional Insights: Get detailed information on calories, macronutrients, and more, tailored to your dietary needs.
With CalScan, managing your diet and tracking your nutrition has never been easier. Start your journey towards a healthier you with the app that takes the hassle out of calorie counting and nutritional tracking.
Download CalScan today and experience the future of dietary management!
Note: We do not provide medical advice. All nutritional information and recommendations offered by CalScan should be viewed as general guidelines. Please consult with a healthcare professional before making any significant changes to your diet or nutrition plan.

Started by ordinary Joes who saw businesses stuck with dated products that were hardly used, we built the world's most inclusive and engaging health benefit platform.
By combining social connection, gamified fitness, and tangible rewards -
bluejetty:00159400:ios.description:
Started by ordinary Joes who saw businesses stuck with dated products that were hardly used, we built the world's most inclusive and engaging health benefit platform.
By combining social connection, gamified fitness, and tangible rewards - GoJoe helps organisations motivate their teams to move more, drive better health, and tackle challenges ranging from rising health costs to employee engagement.
And all while driving productivity and bottom-line ROI – because healthier businesses perform better.
From fully inclusive virtual team challenges and 'move to earn' rewards to exclusive content led by athletes and creators, we bring people closer and help them exercise on their own but never alone.
Because we believe in the power of social connection. To achieve more, together.
Ready? Set? GoJoe.
-------------------------------------------------------
Why GoJoe? We’ve built a load of great features and benefits to help boost health and fitness in organisations of all shapes and sizes:
Workplace Team Challenges
Ditch clunky old step-challenges for something that works for everyone.
Create fully inclusive and customisable virtual team fitness challenges to exercise with and against people you know. With weighted points, 50+ activities and easy ways to log any exercise session, it’s the best challenge product for global teams of any size. The jewel in the GoJoe crown (we’re rather proud of them).
On Demand Les Mills
Group fitness powerhouse Les Mills is fully integrated into GoJoe, with over 350 workouts - from yoga to bodypump - ready to stream at home or on the go. And with 30% geared for entry level, there’s something for every Joe.
Activity Clubs
Build your own communities of like-minded employees. From running and swimming to dog walking and lunchtime workouts, bring your teams closer together through part-physical, part-digital clubs.
Tangible Rewards
Move to earn buy converting activities into GoJoe points and prizes. From vouchers to coffees, everyone loves a reward and even better if you’ve earnt it via some exercise.
Journeys
Work through a fitness, mental health or nutritional journey on your own but not alone with Journeys. Led by experts, celebrities, and athletes, Journeys is a game-changing community engagement tool, driving behaviours through social.
Removing Barriers
Fully accessible no matter your location, ability or tech. GoJoe can be used by anyone, anywhere; 30+ languages, 50+ sports, multiple ways to track activity, a weighted points system to ensure anyone -from average Joes like us to fitness fanatics - can be part of the fun.
Be Social
GoJoe creates a sense of belonging, bringing people together in a shared health and fitness experience via individual profiles, followers, push notifications and chat groups. Transforming health and fitness into a vibrant social experience.
Interactive Maps
Access to fully customisable tracker maps to follow your organisation's progress from your office front door and then off around the world.
Easy Tracking
Sync any wearables, use our in-built GPS tracker or upload manually straight into the platform. GoJoe is built to be used by anyone anywhere, regardless of level, tech, location or ability. Essentially, we removed any excuse not to get active!
Data and Reporting
Empowering business leaders. With data science powered by our collaboration with Stanford University, our high engagement enables us to uniquely combine quantitative (wearable/ app) with qualitative data, to give you the most powerful employee health data possible. And it could well save you money on health costs such as PMI and absenteeism.
Learn more about us and how we help ordinary Joes around the world at www.GoJoe.com.

Ditch clunky old step-challenges for something that works for everyone.
Create fully inclusive and customisable virtual team fitness challenges to exercise with and against people you know. With weighted points, 50+ activities and easy ways to log any exercise session, it’s the best challenge product for global teams of any size. The jewel in the GoJoe crown (we’re rather proud of them).

On Demand Les Mills
Group fitness powerhouse Les Mills is fully integrated into GoJoe, with over 350 workouts - from yoga to bodypump - ready to stream at home or on the go. And with 30% geared for entry level, there’s something for every Joe.

Activity Clubs
Build your own communities of like-minded employees. From running and swimming to dog walking and lunchtime workouts, bring your teams closer together through part-physical, part-digital clubs.

Tangible Rewards
Move to earn buy converting activities into GoJoe points and prizes. From vouchers to coffees, everyone loves a reward and even better if you’ve earnt it via some exercise.

Journeys
Work through a fitness, mental health or nutritional journey on your own but not alone with Journeys. Led by experts, celebrities, and athletes, Journeys is a game-changing community engagement tool, driving behaviours through social.

Removing Barriers
Fully accessible no matter your location, ability or tech. GoJoe can be used by anyone, anywhere; 30+ languages, 50+ sports, multiple ways to track activity, a weighted points system to ensure anyone -from average Joes like us to fitness fanatics - can be part of the fun.

Be Social
GoJoe creates a sense of belonging, bringing people together in a shared health and fitness experience via individual profiles, followers, push notifications and chat groups. Transforming health and fitness into a vibrant social experience.

Interactive Maps
Access to fully customisable tracker maps to follow your organisation's progress from your office front door and then off around the world.

Easy Tracking
Sync any wearables, use our in-built GPS tracker or upload manually straight into the platform. GoJoe is built to be used by anyone anywhere, regardless of level, tech, location or ability. Essentially, we removed any excuse not to get active!

Data and Reporting
Empowering business leaders. With data science powered by our collaboration with Stanford University, our high engagement enables us to uniquely combine quantitative (wearable/ app) with qualitative data, to give you the most powerful employee health data possible. And it could well save you money on health costs such as PMI and absenteeism.

Learn more about us and how we help ordinary Joes around the world at www.GoJoe.com.

bluejetty:00092221:ios.description:
Welcome to Ovutek FitPal, the health and fitness app designed to help you manage your weight, body fat, and other body composition data while setting and achieving your health goals. With advanced data analysis and multi-user support, we provide a comprehensive solution for understanding your fitness progress and securely backing up and exporting your data. Download Ovutek FitPal now and embark on a journey towards a healthier life.
Key Features:
Device Management: Easily connect and sync your body scale with the app.
Body Composition Tracking: Record and track data on weight, body fat, muscle mass, water percentage, and more to gain a comprehensive understanding of your health.
Goal Setting: Set personal health goals and utilize the app's features and reminders to stay on track.
Multi-dimensional Chart Analysis: Visualize your health data through various charts and analysis tools, allowing you to gain insights into your fitness progress.
Data Export: Backup and export your health data, making it accessible for professionals such as doctors or fitness trainers.
Family Support: Enjoy multi-user mode, allowing your entire family, including babies and even pets, to use the app. Additionally, there is a special mode for pregnant women and individuals wearing medical devices, providing a safe experience.
After integrating the HealthKit framework, we will synchronize the weight, BMI and body fat percentage data. We take your privacy and security very seriously, so we guarantee that all data collected will be stored and used securely
The Bluetooth body fat scale we sell is not a medical device, Users need to seek advice and help from a doctor before using this app to make any medical decisions.
Download Ovutek FitPal now and let's embark on a journey towards achieving and maintaining a healthy lifestyle together!

apple-macos:6791050289.name: Keel: Budget & Expense Tracker
apple-macos:6791050289.description:
Most money apps answer one question: how much did I spend this month?
Keel answers three: what do I own, where did the money go, and did I actually gain or lose this period?
Double-entry bookkeeping underneath. No accounting jargon on top.
THREE REAL STATEMENTS — NOT A SPENDING PIE CHART
• Balance sheet: cash, savings, holdings, stored-value cards, mortgages, loans and credit cards — one net worth number
• Profit statement: income and spending plus asset gains and losses — what you actually earned or lost
• Cash flow statement: transfers aren't spending, buying an asset isn't losing money, paying a card isn't consumption
• Identity checks built in: when the books don't balance, Keel shows you where
SEE WHAT'S COMING, NOT JUST WHAT HAPPENED
• Liquidity runway: how long your cash lasts, with bills, installments and paychecks projected in (Premium)
• Net worth outlook: where net worth is heading, and when the last payment lands (Premium)
• Income and expense trend: past and future side by side — the future only shows what's scheduled
YOUR LIABILITIES, FINALLY MODELED
• Credit cards: statement cycles, statement and due dates, card installments
• Loans: draws, repayment calendars, principal and interest split per period, early payoff, refinancing (Premium)
• Buy now, pay later: orders, scheduled charges, refunds, conversion to installments (Premium)
• Settlements: money lent, borrowed, fronted or split — receivables and payables you can see
• Commitments: cash you've promised but haven't paid yet, at the foot of the balance sheet
TRACK IT IN SECONDS
• Custom number pad with built-in math and quick dates
• AI assistant: ask your ledger and draft entries from receipt photos — Apple Intelligence on device, not available in mainland China. 10 free messages a month, unlimited with Premium
• Categories, tags and projects — three dimensions you can mix freely
• Budgets: one free, any scope you like; sub-budgets with Premium
• Attachments: receipts, invoices and contracts as images or PDFs, or scanned in (Premium)
MORE THAN CASH
• Holdings and non-cash assets: buys, sells, cost basis, revaluation into the profit statement
• Stored-value and prepaid accounts, with optional amortization into expenses (Premium)
• Multi-currency: foreign-currency accounts and entries, base-currency conversion, online rates (Premium)
ON YOUR OWN, OR TOGETHER
• Multiple books for family, business or a project (1 book on the free plan)
• iCloud sync across your devices (Premium)
• Book sharing with role-based permissions — joining by invitation is free
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Full backup and restore, with optional password encryption
• On-device first — with sync on, data lives in your own private iCloud database, nowhere else
• No ads, no data selling, no third-party trackers
WHAT'S FREE
Tracking, all three statements, identity checks, credit cards, settlements, holdings, a monthly budget, this month's category breakdown, 3 goals, 10 assistant messages a month, backup and restore — unlimited entries, no time limit.
Premium adds: loans, buy now pay later, multi-currency and online rates, forward outlook charts, iCloud sync and book sharing, unlimited books, recurring transactions, goals and assistant messages, attachments, sub-budgets, full-range category analysis, and custom statement schemes.
When Premium ends, what you already built keeps calculating and stays viewable — you just can't create new ones. Everything you've recorded stays readable and backup-able.
SUBSCRIPTION
This app offers in-app purchases. Keel Premium is a monthly or yearly subscription (yearly adds a 1-month free trial) or a one-time lifetime unlock; prices are shown in the app. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends, and can be managed or canceled in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://gwongsam.github.io/keel/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://gwongsam.github.io/keel/privacy/
